### [1] [Self-Execution Simulation Improves Coding Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03253)
*Gallil Maimon,Ori Yoran,Felix Kreuk,Michael Hassid,Gal Cohen,Pierre Chambon,Yossi Adi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究训练Code LLM通过逐步模拟程序执行来改进代码生成能力，结合监督微调与强化学习，实现自我验证与自我修复，在多个编程竞赛基准上取得一致改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在生成代码时无法正确估计程序执行，导致生成的代码可能不正确，特别是在竞赛编程等需要精确输出的场景中表现不佳。

Method: 1) 结合监督微调（使用自然语言执行轨迹与文本解释）与强化学习（使用可验证奖励）；2) 引入两个互补目标：给定代码和输入的输出预测，以及使用真实或自预测执行反馈解决编程任务；3) 支持多候选解的自我验证与迭代自我修复。

Result: 在多个竞赛编程基准上，该方法相比标准推理方法获得一致改进。

Conclusion: 执行模拟能力可被有效训练并用于提升代码生成质量，自我验证与迭代修复是可行的改进方向，但仍存在局限性需要进一步研究。

Abstract: A promising research direction in enabling LLMs to generate consistently correct code involves addressing their inability to properly estimate program execution, particularly for code they generate. In this work, we demonstrate that Code LLMs can be trained to simulate program execution in a step-by-step manner and that this capability can be leveraged to improve competitive programming performance. Our approach combines supervised fine-tuning on natural language execution traces, textual explanations grounded in true execution, with reinforcement learning using verifiable rewards. We introduce two complementary objectives: output prediction given code and inputs, and solving competitive programming tasks with either ground-truth or self-predicted execution feedback. These objectives enable models to perform self-verification over multiple candidate solutions, and iterative self-fixing by simulating test execution. Across multiple competitive programming benchmarks, our method yields consistent improvements over standard reasoning approaches. We further present ablations and analysis to elucidate the role of execution simulation and its limitations.

</details>


### [2] [Robust LLM Performance Certification via Constrained Maximum Likelihood Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03257)
*Minghe Shen,Ananth Balashankar,Adam Fisch,David Madras,Miguel Rodrigues*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于约束最大似然估计（Constrained MLE）的方法，用于估计大语言模型（LLM）的失败率。该方法融合了小型人工校准集、大型LLM评判标注，以及领域特定的约束条件，在多种实验设置下均优于现有方法（如PPI），为LLM失败率认证提供了可解释且可扩展的方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前从业者在估计LLM失败率时面临两难选择：使用昂贵的人工金标准，或依赖可能有严重偏差的自动标注方案（如"LLM-as-a-Judge"）。这阻碍了LLM的安全部署。

Method: 提出基于约束最大似然估计（MLE）的新方法，整合三个信号源：（i）小型高质量人工标注校准集；（ii）大型LLM评判标注语料库；（iii）通过已知评判性能统计边界推导的领域特定约束。

Result: 在多种实验设置下（不同评判准确率、校准集规模和LLM失败率），约束MLE始终比现有最优方法（如Prediction-Powered Inference）提供更准确、更低方差的估计。

Conclusion: 该方法超越了"黑盒"式自动评判的局限，提供了原则化、可解释且可扩展的LLM失败率认证路径。

Abstract: The ability to rigorously estimate the failure rates of large language models (LLMs) is a prerequisite for their safe deployment. Currently, however, practitioners often face a tradeoff between expensive human gold standards and potentially severely-biased automatic annotation schemes such as "LLM-as-a-Judge" labeling. In this paper, we propose a new, practical, and efficient approach to LLM failure rate estimation based on constrained maximum-likelihood estimation (MLE). Our method integrates three distinct signal sources: (i) a small, high-quality human-labeled calibration set, (ii) a large corpus of LLM-judge annotations, and, most importantly, (iii) additional side information via domain-specific constraints derived from known bounds on judge performance statistics. We validate our approach through a comprehensive empirical study, benchmarking it against state-of-the-art baselines like Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI). Across diverse experimental regimes -- spanning varying judge accuracies, calibration set sizes, and LLM failure rates -- our constrained MLE consistently delivers more accurate and lower-variance estimates than existing methods. By moving beyond the "black-box" use of automated judges to a flexible framework, we provide a principled, interpretable, and scalable pathway towards LLM failure-rate certification.

</details>


### [3] [SoLA: Leveraging Soft Activation Sparsity and Low-Rank Decomposition for Large Language Model Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03258)
*Xinhao Huang,You-Liang Huang,Zeyi Wen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SoLA 是一种免训练（training-free）的 LLM 压缩方法，结合「软激活稀疏性」与「低秩分解」：在 FFN 中保留约 15% 激活范数最高的「主神经元」（Prime Neurons, PN）不压缩，其余「边缘神经元」（MN）用 SVD 做低秩分解，并通过自适应逐组件截断位置分配策略缓解分解损失。在 LLaMA-2-7B/13B/70B 与 Mistral-7B 上验证：30% 压缩率下 LLaMA-2-70B 的 WikiText2 困惑度从 SVD-LLM 的 6.95 降至 4.44，下游任务平均准确率提升约 10%，矩阵乘推理加速 1.4×–1.8×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代大语言模型参数量以十亿计，部署成本高昂。现有压缩方案各有明显短板：非结构化剪枝依赖 ReLU 产生的零激活稀疏性，而现代 LLM 已普遍改用 SiLU/GeLU 等软激活函数导致该稀疏性消失，同时通用硬件缺乏对非结构化稀疏的支持；结构化剪枝（如 LLM-Pruner、FLAP）会大幅破坏模型结构、精度下降严重且需微调恢复；量化（GPTQ、QLoRA）通常也需后续微调。相比之下低秩分解（SVD 类）无需特殊硬件与昂贵训练，但存在两个关键缺陷：一是未考虑输入/输出数据分布，二是忽视 FFN 与注意力模块中不同权重矩阵对压缩的敏感性差异，导致压缩损失过大、性能显著退化。因此需要一种既免训练、又充分利用激活信息、能差异化分配压缩预算的高效压缩方法。

Method: 方法分三部分。(1) 软激活稀疏性分析：统计 LLaMA-2-7B/13B 在 WikiText2 与 C4 上 FFN 中各神经元的激活范数 ‖XW‖_F 分布，发现其呈长尾分布——少量神经元占据绝大部分范数总和（13B 中前 15% 神经元占 95%），称为「主神经元 PN」，其余为「边缘神经元 MN」；并通过剪除实验验证高范数神经元（PN）对性能至关重要（剪 1% 即令困惑度从 4.57 升至 9665），低范数神经元（MN）则可被安全移除（剪 50% 仅升至 17.03）。(2) 稀疏性驱动的分解：沿用 SVD-LLM 的数据感知框架，用校准数据收集各层输入 X，做 Cholesky 分解得到缩放矩阵 S，对 W·S⁻¹ 做 SVD；按神经元划分为 PN/MN 两个子集，保留 PN 权重不压缩，仅对 MN 子集（并相应切分 S 为 S_PN/S_MN）做 SVD 分解，实现细粒度压缩；注意力模块不使用激活函数，故整体做低秩分解。(3) 自适应逐组件低秩分配：基于 Theorem 1 推导的截断重建损失闭式解，定义性能得分 f(r)=Σ_{i≤r}σ_i²/Σσ²，并将「在给定内存预算下最大化各组件得分之和」形式化为整数规划问题，采用自适应启发式贪心搜索求解子最优解，截断位置 r 取 16 的倍数以适配 NVIDIA 硬件。实现细节：使用 SVD-LLM 作为分解基座；从 WikiText2 与 C4 训练集随机取 256 条、序列长度 4096 的样本作校准数据；不压缩 V 投影，GQA 模型（LLaMA-2-70B、Mistral-7B）额外不压缩 K 投影，7B/13B 的 O 投影在 20% 率下不压缩；首尾两层不做压缩。

Result: 在 LLaMA-2-7B/13B/70B 与 Mistral-7B-v0.1 上的实验表明：WikiText2 困惑度上，SoLA 显著优于 LLM-Pruner、FLAP、SliceGPT、Bolaco、SVD-LLM。例如 LLaMA-2-70B 在 30% 压缩率下困惑度 4.44（SVD-LLM 为 6.95，SliceGPT 为 8.09），70B 在 20% 率下为 4.06（SVD-LLM 5.96）；Mistral-7B 在 20%/30% 下为 6.06/7.38，优于所有基线。下游任务上，除 LLaMA-2-7B 20% 场景外，SoLA 在所有配置下平均准确率均为最优，相对基线提升约 3%–10%；LLaMA-2-70B 30% 时平均 0.6625（MMLU 0.570），显著高于 SVD-LLM 的 0.6091。消融显示：保留 5% 的 PN 即可带来明显困惑度改善（20% 率下 5.8 vs 6.5），默认取 15%；自适应秩分配相比统一秩分配，困惑度改善 8%–18%，下游平均准确率最高提升 14%（如 7B-30% 困惑度 9.32 vs 11.40）。对校准数据的数量（32/64/128/256）与类型（WikiText2/C4）均不敏感，性能波动不超过 10%。推理效率上，序列长 2048、RTX4090 上 10³ 次取中位耗时：20% 率加速 1.22×–1.47×，30% 率加速 1.54×–1.77×（13B 达 1.77×）。

Conclusion: SoLA 通过「保留少数高激活范数神经元 + 对其余神经元做数据感知 SVD 低秩分解 + 自适应逐组件秩分配」，在完全免后训练（无微调/无蒸馏）的条件下，于同等压缩率下同时取得优于 SOTA 的困惑度与下游任务精度，并带来真实的矩阵乘推理加速，验证了软激活稀疏性在现代 LLM 中可被有效利用。该方法可与现有层重要性度量方法结合实现层级压缩，也具备集成进推理框架以实现端到端加速的潜力；局限在于仍依赖校准数据估计激活分布、注意力模块未利用稀疏性以及低秩分解本身的固有表达损失。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities across various tasks, but the billion-scale parameters pose deployment challenges. Although existing methods attempt to reduce the scale of LLMs, they require either special hardware support or expensive post-training to maintain model quality. To facilitate efficient and affordable model slimming, we propose a novel training-free compression method for LLMs, named "SoLA", which leverages \textbf{So}ft activation sparsity and \textbf{L}ow-r\textbf{A}nk decomposition. SoLA can identify and retain a minority of components significantly contributing to inference, while compressing the majority through low-rank decomposition, based on our analysis of the activation pattern in the feed-forward network (FFN) of modern LLMs. To alleviate the decomposition loss, SoLA is equipped with an adaptive component-wise low-rank allocation strategy to assign appropriate truncation positions for different weight matrices. We conduct extensive experiments on LLaMA-2-7B/13B/70B and Mistral-7B models across a variety of benchmarks. SoLA exhibits remarkable improvement in both language modeling and downstream task accuracy without post-training. For example, with a 30\% compression rate on the LLaMA-2-70B model, SoLA surpasses the state-of-the-art method by reducing perplexity from 6.95 to 4.44 and enhancing downstream task accuracy by 10\%.

</details>


### [4] [Why Attend to Everything? Focus is the Key](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03260)
*Hengshuai Yao,Xing Chen,Ahmed Murtadha,Jin Li,Shuai Shao,Yasin Abbasi Yadkori,Guan Wang,Mingli Yuan,William Chen,Sen Song*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Focus是一种新型高效注意力机制，通过可学习的质心将token分配到不同组，仅在组内进行全分辨率注意力，组间采用稀疏的远距离注意力。由于不修改模型权重，Focus具有纯附加性，可在多种架构和规模（124M到70B参数）上提升领域困惑度而不影响下游基准性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高效注意力方法在retrofit场景（即不改变预训练权重）下存在局限：要么无法保持下游任务性能，要么计算效率提升有限。现有方法试图逼近全注意力，但许多token对本身并不重要，因此学习哪些token对重要比近似全部更重要。

Method: 1）使用可学习的质心将token分配到不同组；2）同组token间进行全分辨率局部注意力；3）组间采用基于质心的稀疏远距离注意力；4）使用Sinkhorn归一化强制分组平衡作为硬约束；5）推理时将软路由离散化为硬稀疏模式，通过top-k最高评分分组实现加速。

Result: 1）124M参数下Focus超越全注意力（30.3 vs 31.4 PPL）；2）7B规模从头训练仍优于全注意力（13.82 vs 13.89 PPL）；3）推理时2倍加速且PPL更优（41.3 vs 42.8）；4）分解为两个FlashAttention调用实现1M tokens时8.6倍wall-clock加速；5）分组自动发现可解释的语言类别。

Conclusion: Focus作为纯附加的高效注意力方法，首次在retrofit场景下实现了在多个架构和规模上的性能提升，同时保持或超越全注意力的困惑度，并提供可解释的分组语义。不同于LoRA，质心路由在适应过程中保持对齐能力，instruction-tuned模型在适配后保持TruthfulQA分数。

Abstract: We introduce Focus, a method that learns which token pairs matter rather than approximating all of them. Learnable centroids assign tokens to groups; distant attention is restricted to same-group pairs while local attention operates at full resolution. Because all model weights stay frozen, Focus is purely additive: centroid-only training (as few as 148K parameters) improves domain perplexity with zero degradation on downstream benchmarks--from 124M to 70B parameters, across five attention architectures. No existing efficient attention method achieves this in the retrofit setting. At 124M, Focus surpasses full attention (30.3 vs 31.4 PPL); trained from scratch at 7B scale (2B tokens), Focus again beats full attention (13.82 vs 13.89 PPL). At inference, restricting each token to its top-k highest-scoring groups discretizes the soft routing into a hard sparsity pattern, yielding 2x speedup while beating the pretrained baseline (41.3 vs 42.8 PPL); decomposing this pattern into two standard FlashAttention calls reaches 8.6x wall-clock speedup at 1M tokens with no custom kernels. Unlike LoRA, centroid routing preserves alignment: instruction-tuned models retain TruthfulQA scores after adaptation, while LoRA degrades at every learning rate and rank. Sinkhorn normalization enforces balanced groups as a hard constraint, and the resulting groups discover interpretable linguistic categories without supervision.

</details>


### [5] [VIGIL: An Extensible System for Real-Time Detection and Mitigation of Cognitive Bias Triggers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03261)
*Bo Kang,Sander Noels,Tijl De Bie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: VIGIL是首个用于实时检测和缓解认知偏差触发因素的浏览器扩展插件。它提供滚动同步检测、LLM驱动的重述（完全可逆）、隐私分层推理（从完全离线到云端），并支持第三方插件扩展，已在GitHub开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI不仅通过虚假信息威胁在线信息完整性，还通过利用人类认知偏差进行说服和操纵来损害公民话语。现有的媒体素养和透明度工具仅能解决信息的事实性和来源可靠性问题，尚无工具直接检测和缓解认知偏差触发因素的存在。

Method: 开发了VIGIL浏览器扩展，实现以下功能：1) 实时认知偏差触发因素检测；2) 滚动同步的原地检测；3) LLM驱动的重述，可完全逆转；4) 隐私分层推理（从完全离线到云端）；5) 支持第三方插件扩展。

Result: VIGIL已构建完成，包含多个经NLP基准验证的插件，代码已开源。

Conclusion: VIGIL是首个专门针对认知偏差触发因素检测与缓解的工具，为保护公民话语免受基于认知偏差的操纵提供了技术解决方案。

Abstract: The rise of generative AI is posing increasing risks to online information integrity and civic discourse. Most concretely, such risks can materialise in the form of mis- and disinformation. As a mitigation, media-literacy and transparency tools have been developed to address factuality of information and the reliability and ideological leaning of information sources. However, a subtler but possibly no less harmful threat to civic discourse is to use of persuasion or manipulation by exploiting human cognitive biases and related cognitive limitations. To the best of our knowledge, no tools exist to directly detect and mitigate the presence of triggers of such cognitive biases in online information. We present VIGIL (VIrtual GuardIan angeL), the first browser extension for real-time cognitive bias trigger detection and mitigation, providing in-situ scroll-synced detection, LLM-powered reformulation with full reversibility, and privacy-tiered inference from fully offline to cloud. VIGIL is built to be extensible with third-party plugins, with several plugins that are rigorously validated against NLP benchmarks are already included. It is open-sourced at https://github.com/aida-ugent/vigil.

</details>


### [6] [LPC-SM: Local Predictive Coding and Sparse Memory for Long-Context Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03263)
*Keqin Xie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 LPC-SM：一种把「局部注意力 + 快慢双时间尺度记忆 + 显式预测校正 + 运行时稀疏控制器」在同一 block 内显式分工的混合自回归架构，并用 ONT（正交新颖性传输）约束慢记忆写入。作者在 158M 参数、GPT-2 分词器上做了三阶段训练（A: Dolma3-base 32.77M token/2048；B: OpenWebMath-10k 16.38M token/2048；C: LongMino 24.58M token/4096）。结论是：最有说服力的支持来自 mHC（移除后 Stage-A 最终 LM loss 从 12.630 升至 15.127）与自适应稀疏控制（Stage-B 相对匹配的固定比率续训把 loss 从 12.137 降到 10.787）；慢记忆与 ONT 的证据则不一致——移除 ONT/停止头/预测校正反而在 Stage-A 降低 loss（11.781/12.078/12.413），且去掉慢记忆可把吞吐从 6.8k 提到 21.9k tok/s 而损失几乎不变。作者自我定位为「架构验证」而非计算最优的优越性证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前长上下文语言模型几乎一律依赖注意力同时承担「局部交互」与「长程状态」两种职责，这使得除注意力之外的序列建模分解很少被当作可独立研究的对象；作者认为这一评判顺序过于苛刻，应先追问一种新的分工能否做到自洽、可训练且可实证解读，再去和成熟的 Transformer 基线比拼。LPC-SM 的出发点是把长程建模的职责从注意力身上「内移」到 block 级别：保留窗口化因果注意力做短程精确性，把更长寿命的状态交给快/慢双时间尺度记忆，把表示失配显式暴露为预测校正信号，并让一组小型学习控制器去调节稀疏度、记忆写入与停止行为。在此背景下，慢记忆写入方式变得格外关键——若 chunk 摘要反复沿着慢状态已有的方向移动，写入容量就被浪费在「强化」而非「累积」上，这正是 ONT 要解决的问题：保留已对齐分量、只放大正交新颖分量。附录 A 进一步为 ONT 给出变分刻画：它是约束集合 {x: ⟨x,m⟩=⟨c,m⟩} 上目标 ‖x−(1+α)c‖ 的唯一极小点（即保持与慢状态的内积不变、只沿新颖方向放大），并给出 Lean/Mathlib 形式化证明（附录 B）。

Method: 架构：L 个相同自回归 block + 末端 RMSNorm + LM 头与停止头（Stop Head 预测 EOS）。单个 block 先 RMSNorm，再融合三路信息：(1) 局部注意力——因果滑窗 Attn(h_{max(1,t−w+1):t})，默认共享投影，亦支持 MLA 变体（q=W_q h，z=W_z h，k/v 经 W↑ 从潜在瓶颈升维）；(2) 双时间尺度记忆——快状态逐 token 更新 m_t^f = d_t⊙m_{t−1}^f + (1−d_t)⊙u_t（d=σ(W_d h)，u=tanh(W_u h)），慢状态仅在 chunk 边界更新，用两个门 q^f、q^s 分别读取快/慢路径得 r_t = W_r[q^f⊙m^f ∥ q^s⊙m_{k−1}^s]；(3) 预测校正——先用 [a_t∥r_t] 预测隐状态 ĥ_t^{(0)}，再用 [a_t∥r_t∥h_t−ĥ_t^{(s)}] 迭代精化 ĥ_t^{(s+1)}，控制器把误差统计经分数归一化、可学习偏置缩放、温度与直通硬阈值转成稀疏事件掩码，稀疏比本身在给定边界内可学习。融合后走残差+FFN，可选插入 mHC（多头耦合残差路由器）：把状态提升为多流、学习预混权重、Sinkhorn 归一化残差传输、再用学习到的后混系数注回，作者将其作为 block 内的「残差传输层」而非全局重构。慢记忆写入：chunk 摘要 c_k = 平均快状态，先计算 proj(c_k|m_{k−1}^s) 与新颖分量 n_k = c_k − proj，再传输 c_k★ = c_k + α_n n_k，最后 g_k⊙m_{k−1}^s + (1−g_k)⊙tanh(W_c c_k★)。自回归生成时用逐层缓存（注意力历史、快/慢状态、部分 chunk 摘要）执行同一写入顺序，以避免训练/推理不一致。训练目标：L = L_lm + λ_pred L_pred + λ_sparse L_sparse + λ_mem L_mem + λ_stop L_stop，各辅助项用于防止显式机制「失效」。实验：Stage A 在 Dolma3-base 上做全模型 + 五个消融（去慢记忆、去预测校正、去 ONT、去停止头、去 mHC）；Stage B 从同一 Stage-A 检查点出发，在 OpenWebMath-10k 上对比「稀疏比可学习」与「固定稀疏比」两条续训路线（初始化、数据、预算完全匹配）；Stage C 将全路线延展到 4096 长度。评估指标为各阶段最终 LM loss（作者承认它无法完整反映预测校正/ONT/停止头的设计意图），辅以吞吐、学习到的稀疏比与固定提示 sanity check，以及「延迟标识符」诊断（给引入了 key 的头部 + 长干扰区 + 要求续写标识符的触发前缀，在 teacher forcing 下对正确标识符计交叉熵；Stage-A 用 6 条 2040-token 提示）。作者明确指出在 158M 规模、仅 32.77M/16.38M token 的预算下模型处于相对 scaling law 严重欠拟合状态，故定位为结构性涌现与数值稳定性的概念验证。

Result: Stage A（最终 LM loss，越低越好）：全模型 12.630、6798 tok/s、最终稀疏比 0.226；去慢记忆 12.671（+0.32%）、21938 tok/s、0.249；去预测校正 12.413（−1.72%）、7083 tok/s、0.600；去 ONT 11.781（−6.72%）、6676 tok/s、0.235；去停止头 12.078（−4.38%）、6630 tok/s、0.228；去 mHC 15.127（+19.76%）、7038 tok/s、0.234。解读：mHC 是唯一造成大幅退化的部件，应视为 block 几何的核心而非可选装饰；慢记忆收益微弱（且代价是约 3.2 倍吞吐损失）；预测校正、ONT、停止头在 Stage-A 的基础 LM loss 上反而「有害」，作者归因于这些机制在极短训练预算下尚未显现其针对续训/长程条件化的收益，且去掉预测校正使稀疏比升到 0.600，显示控制器行为与其强耦合。Stage B（2048）：自适应稀疏控制 10.787、6728 tok/s、比率 0.214；固定稀疏控制 12.137（+12.52%）、6711 tok/s、0.226——在初始化/数据/预算完全匹配下仅放开稀疏比可学习即带来 12.5% 的损失改善，是本文最干净的一项证据。Stage C（4096 长上下文续训）：最终 LM loss 11.582、3711 tok/s、稀疏比 0.215，训练全程未移除记忆、校正、路由与学习控制，说明混合 block 在序列长度翻倍下未崩溃。延迟标识符诊断（key 交叉熵，越低越好）：Stage-A 全模型 14.396、去慢记忆 13.865、去 ONT 15.427、Stage-C 全模型 12.031。两条模式：禁用 ONT 显著恶化该诊断（15.427），与「新颖性感知的写入有助于保留延迟信息」一致；Stage-C 续训后全模型从 14.396 降到 12.031，显示长上下文续训确实锐化了延迟条件化。但作者坦承去慢记忆变体在 Stage-A 的该探针上仍略优于全模型，故不能把表 4 读作对慢记忆机制的干净隔离。附录 A/B 给出了 ONT 的分解、正交性、可行性、唯一极小性、变分刻画与 Hilbert 空间推广，并附 Mathlib 形式化代码。

Conclusion: 本文的贡献是提出并验证了一种「注意力之外」的序列建模分工：局部注意力做短程精确、双时间尺度记忆承担长程持久状态、预测校正把失配暴露为一等信号、小型学习控制器调节稀疏/写入/停止，mHC 提供多流残差传输。经验上最可靠的支撑是 mHC（缺失代价最大，Δ+19.8%）与自适应稀疏控制（Stage-B 匹配对照下 Δ−12.5%）；完整路线在 4096 长度下保持可训练且延迟标识符交叉熵从 14.396 改善到 12.031。慢记忆的证据则是「有条件成立」：与长上下文续训相容，但 158M 规模的消融未能在所有指标上隔离出其一致为正的作用，去 ONT/去停止头/去预测校正在基础 LM loss 上甚至更好，作者因此把论文定位为架构验证研究而非计算最优优越性声明，并称 1B 规模实验正在进行。局限包括：绝对 loss 在 11–15 之间意味着极端欠拟合、结论对训练预算高度敏感；缺少与同规模强 Transformer 基线（含 mHC/超连接来源）的直接对比；慢记忆使吞吐下降约 3 倍而收益微弱；单作者/单次运行、种子与方差未报告；延迟标识符探针仅 6 条提示、样本极小；Stage C 未与任何基线对照。总体上，这是一个把「机制可分离性」做清楚、把「机制收益」尚未证明的工作。

Abstract: Most current long-context language models still rely on attention to handle both local interaction and long-range state, which leaves relatively little room to test alternative decompositions of sequence modeling. We propose LPC-SM, a hybrid autoregressive architecture that separates local attention, persistent memory, predictive correction, and run-time control within the same block, and we use Orthogonal Novelty Transport (ONT) to govern slow-memory writes. We evaluate a 158M-parameter model in three stages spanning base language modeling, mathematical continuation, and 4096-token continuation. Removing mHC raises the Stage-A final LM loss from 12.630 to 15.127, while adaptive sparse control improves the Stage-B final LM loss from 12.137 to 10.787 relative to a matched fixed-ratio continuation. The full route remains stable at sequence length 4096, where Stage C ends with final LM loss 11.582 and improves the delayed-identifier diagnostic from 14.396 to 12.031 in key cross-entropy. Taken together, these results show that long-context autoregressive modeling can be organized around a broader division of labor than attention alone.

</details>

*Andrey Pustovit*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"知识包"(Knowledge Packs)：通过预计算的KV缓存，在零token成本下传递知识，替代传统RAG方法。在Qwen3-8B和Llama-3.1-8B上实现700题零分歧、95% token节省，并支持RAG无法实现的行为控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG方法存在token浪费问题。核心发现：对于因果Transformer，在文本F上前向传播产生的KV缓存与在F+q上联合前向传播的结果完全等价——这直接源于因果掩码的特性。该等价性精确但脆弱：聊天模板格式错误会导致6-7pp的性能下降，这可能解释了之前研究中KV优于RAG的错误结论。

Result: 在Qwen3-8B和Llama-3.1-8B上，700道问题全部零分歧；token节省达95%；最有效引导效果位于中高层(33-66%)；知识传递与行为引导可并行运行(alpha≤0.7)无干扰；无需训练、无需权重修改。

Conclusion: KV缓存接口可完全替代RAG实现知识传递，同时解锁RAG无法实现的行为控制能力。关键技术支撑：因果掩码保证精确等价性 + RoPE对keys/values的不对称处理 + values空间的可组合性。

Abstract: RAG wastes tokens. We propose Knowledge Packs: pre-computed KV caches that deliver the same knowledge at zero token cost. For causal transformers, the KV cache from a forward pass on text F is identical to what a joint pass on F+q would produce - this follows directly from the causal mask. The equivalence is exact but fragile: wrong chat template formatting causes 6-7pp degradation, which we believe explains prior claims of KV outperforming RAG. With correct formatting: zero divergences across 700 questions on Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B, up to 95% token savings. The KV interface also enables behavioral steering that RAG cannot do. Because RoPE rotates keys but leaves values untouched, contrastive deltas on cached values can nudge model behavior while key arithmetic destroys coherence. The effect sits in mid-layer values (33-66%), independent directions are nearly orthogonal (cos~0) and compose, and both channels - knowledge and steering - run simultaneously at alpha<=0.7 without interference. No training, no weight modification.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: CresOWLve成功揭示了当前LLM在创造性问题解决方面的关键瓶颈：知识检索能力与知识整合创新能力之间的解耦。未来模型需重点提升跨领域知识的创意整合与非常规连接能力。

Abstract: Creative problem-solving requires combining multiple cognitive abilities, including logical reasoning, lateral thinking, analogy-making, and commonsense knowledge, to discover insights that connect seemingly unrelated pieces of information. However, most existing benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) evaluate only specific components of this process. Moreover, many creativity-oriented benchmarks rely on artificially constructed brainteasers or contrived scenarios that do not reflect how creative problem-solving occurs in real-world settings. To address this gap, we introduce CresOWLve, a benchmark for evaluating creative problem-solving using puzzles grounded in real-world knowledge. Problems in CresOWLve require employing multiple creative thinking strategies, retrieving facts from diverse domains, and creatively combining them to arrive at a solution. Evaluating several frontier non-thinking and thinking LLMs, we show that CresOWLve remains highly challenging. Our analysis reveals a consistent performance gap: models perform substantially better on factual questions than on creative ones (up to a -17% drop). While models can often retrieve the relevant knowledge, they struggle to form the non-obvious creative connections required to integrate this information and arrive at the correct answer.

</details>

Abstract: Generating diverse, pedagogically valid stories for Arabic early-grade reading assessments requires balancing tight constraints on vocabulary, reading level, and narrative structure against the need to avoid repetitive plots that undermine assessment validity. We investigate noise steering, injecting calibrated Gaussian perturbations into the internal representations of transformer models at inference time, as a training-free diversity method evaluated across five small Arabic-centric language models (7-9B parameters). We compare four injection strategies against high-temperature sampling baselines, measuring diversity, quality, constraint adherence, and reading grade level. Attention entropy noise injection (AENI) stabilizes the otherwise unreliable attention-logit noise while recovering quality. High-temperature sampling inflates reading grade level and causes catastrophic collapse on several models. We find internal representation-level perturbation to be a more suitable diversity strategy than output-level stochasticity for constrained educational content generation.

Abstract: We present QIMMA, a quality-assured Arabic LLM leaderboard that places systematic benchmark validation at its core. Rather than aggregating existing resources as-is, QIMMA applies a multi-model assessment pipeline combining automated LLM judgment with human review to surface and resolve systematic quality issues in well-established Arabic benchmarks before evaluation. The result is a curated, multi-domain, multi-task evaluation suite of over 52k samples, grounded predominantly in native Arabic content; code evaluation tasks are the sole exception, as they are inherently language-agnostic. TL;DR: 本文探讨名词范畴在不同语言中的实现方式差异，以Riffian语为参考点，提出"形态驱动标记"(morphology-driven marking)的正式模型，将名词组织为具有各自形态模板的模块化认知集合，并重新评估了标记性和状态概念，提议将"状态"扩展为所有综合语言的分析范畴，作为基于句法的屈折的新的子范畴。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 名词范畴在所有语言中都存在，但其实现在不同语言间差异显著，目前缺乏能统一解释这些差异的形式模型。现有研究未能充分说明同一语言内及跨语言间不同名词类型的标记差异。

Method: 1) 以Riffian语为主要参考点进行详细分析；2) 将分析扩展至其他语言进行对比；3) 提出形态驱动标记模型，将名词组织为模块化认知集合，每个集合具有独立的形态模板和无标记形式；4) 将这些模式置于句法功能中考察。

Result: 名词可按形态模板和无标记形式组织为不同的认知集合；标记差异可通过形态驱动标记模型在语言内和跨语言层面得到合理解释；"状态"应作为所有综合语言中基于句法屈折的子范畴。

Conclusion: 形态驱动标记模型为解释名词标记的跨语言变异性提供了统一框架；"状态"概念应扩展至所有综合语言，并作为与一致关系和语法格并列的基于句法屈折的子范畴重新定义。

Abstract: All languages have a noun category, but its realisation varies considerably. Depending on the language, semantic and/or morphosyntactic differences may be more or less pronounced. This paper explores these variations, using Riffian as a reference point before extending the analysis to other languages. We propose a formal model termed morphology-driven marking. Nouns are organised into modular cognitive sets, each with its own morphological template and unmarked form. This approach helps explain differences in marking among noun types within and across languages. By situating these patterns within syntactic functions, we also reassess the notions of markedness and state. It is proposed that the concept of state be extended to all synthetic languages and analysed a novel subcategory of syntax-based inflection like agreement and grammatical case.

</details>


### [12] [The Tool Illusion: Rethinking Tool Use in Web Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03465)
*Renze Lou,Baolin Peng,Wenlin Yao,Qianhui Wu,Hao Cheng,Suman Nath,Wenpeng Yin,Jianfeng Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: As web agents rapidly evolve, an increasing body of work has moved beyond conventional atomic browser interactions and explored tool use as a higher-level action paradigm. Although prior studies have shown the promise of tools, their conclusions are often drawn from limited experimental scales and sometimes non-comparable settings. As a result, several fundamental questions remain unclear: i) whether tools provide consistent gains for web agents, ii) what practical design principles characterize effective tools, and iii) what side effects tool use may introduce. To establish a stronger empirical foundation for future research, we revisit tool use in web agents through an extensive and carefully controlled study across diverse tool sources, backbone models, tool-use frameworks, and evaluation benchmarks. Our findings both revise some prior conclusions and complement others with broader evidence. We hope this study provides a more reliable empirical basis and inspires future research on tool-use web agents.

### [13] [Vocabulary Dropout for Curriculum Diversity in LLM Co-Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03472)
*Jacob Dineen,Aswin RRV,Zhikun Xu,Ben Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"词汇丢弃"方法，通过在语言模型输出logits上应用随机掩码来解决协同进化自我博弈中的多样性崩溃问题，使提议者能够持续生成多样化的数学问题，从而提升求解者的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前协同进化自我博弈方法中，提议者模型快速收敛到满足奖励函数但分布单一的狭窄问题集，导致课程学习失效，协同进化循环停滞。

Method: 在提议者的策略训练和问题生成阶段，对输出logits应用硬性、非平稳的随机掩码（词汇丢弃），防止其锁定在固定token序列上。实验基于Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B模型，采用R-Zero框架进行数学推理训练。

Result: 词汇丢弃在词法、语义和功能指标上持续维持提议者的多样性，8B模型平均提升4.4分，尤其在竞赛级基准测试上提升最为显著。

Conclusion: 显式的动作空间约束（类似于经典自我博弈中游戏规则的结构性作用）可帮助维持语言模型中富有成效的协同进化，词汇丢弃是该原则的一个简单实现。

Abstract: Co-evolutionary self-play, where one language model generates problems and another solves them, promises autonomous curriculum learning without human supervision. In practice, the proposer quickly converges to a narrow distribution of problems that satisfy the reward function. This diversity collapse renders the curriculum uninformative for the solver, stalling the co-evolutionary loop. We introduce vocabulary dropout, a random mask applied to the proposer's output logits during both policy training and curriculum generation, as a lightweight mechanism to sustain diversity. The mask is hard and non-stationary, preventing the proposer from locking into fixed token sequences. Training Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on mathematical reasoning via R-Zero, we find that vocabulary dropout sustains proposer diversity across lexical, semantic, and functional metrics throughout training, and yields solver improvements averaging +4.4 points at 8B, with the largest gains on competition-level benchmarks. Our findings suggest that explicit action-space constraints, analogous to the structural role that game rules play in classical self-play, can help sustain productive co-evolution in language. Vocabulary dropout is one simple instantiation of this principle.

</details>


### [14] [Evolutionary Search for Automated Design of Uncertainty Quantification Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03473)
*Mikhail Seleznyov,Daniil Korbut,Viktor Moskvoretskii,Oleg Somov,Alexander Panchenko,Elena Tutubalina*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出使用大语言模型驱动的进化搜索自动发现无监督的不确定性量化(UQ)方法，在原子级声明验证任务上取得了显著的ROC-AUC提升(最高6.7%)，并具有良好的分布外泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大型语言模型的不确定性量化方法主要依赖领域知识和启发式规则人工设计，面临可扩展性和通用性受限的问题。

Method: 应用LLM驱动的进化搜索算法，将UQ方法表示为Python程序，在原子级声明验证任务上进行自动发现和优化。

Result: 进化发现的方法在9个数据集上相比强基线模型实现了最高6.7%的相对ROC-AUC提升，且具有较强的分布外泛化能力。定性分析揭示不同LLM采用差异化进化策略：Claude模型倾向于设计高特征数的线性估计器，而GPT-oss-120B偏好更简单可解释的位置加权方案。仅Sonnet 4.5和Opus 4.5能可靠利用增加的方法复杂度提升性能，Opus 4.6出现意外回归。

Conclusion: LLM驱动的进化搜索是实现自动化、可解释的幻觉检测器设计的有效范式。

Abstract: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods for large language models are predominantly designed by hand based on domain knowledge and heuristics, limiting their scalability and generality. We apply LLM-powered evolutionary search to automatically discover unsupervised UQ methods represented as Python programs. On the task of atomic claim verification, our evolved methods outperform strong manually-designed baselines, achieving up to 6.7% relative ROC-AUC improvement across 9 datasets while generalizing robustly out-of-distribution. Qualitative analysis reveals that different LLMs employ qualitatively distinct evolutionary strategies: Claude models consistently design high-feature-count linear estimators, while Gpt-oss-120B gravitates toward simpler and more interpretable positional weighting schemes. Surprisingly, only Sonnet 4.5 and Opus 4.5 reliably leverage increased method complexity to improve performance -- Opus 4.6 shows an unexpected regression relative to its predecessor. Overall, our results indicate that LLM-powered evolutionary search is a promising paradigm for automated, interpretable hallucination detector design.

</details>


### [15] [Cultural Authenticity: Comparing LLM Cultural Representations to Native Human Expectations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03493)
*Erin MacMurray van Liemt,Aida Davani,Sinchana Kumbale,Neha Dixit,Sunipa Dev*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Cultural representation in Large Language Model (LLM) outputs has primarily been evaluated through the proxies of cultural diversity and factual accuracy. However, a crucial gap remains in assessing cultural alignment: the degree to which generated content mirrors how native populations perceive and prioritize their own cultural facets. In this paper, we introduce a human-centered framework to evaluate the alignment of LLM generations with local expectations. First, we establish a human-derived ground-truth baseline of importance vectors, called Cultural Importance Vectors based on an induced set of culturally significant facets from open-ended survey responses collected across nine countries. Next, we introduce a method to compute model-derived Cultural Representation Vectors of an LLM based on a syntactically diversified prompt-set and apply it to three frontier LLMs (Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-4o, and Claude 3.5 Haiku). Our investigation of the alignment between the human-derived Cultural Importance and model-derived Cultural Representations reveals a Western-centric calibration for some of the models where alignment decreases as a country's cultural distance from the US increases. Furthermore, we identify highly correlated, systemic error signatures ($ρ> 0.97$) across all models, which over-index on some cultural markers while neglecting the deep-seated social and value-based priorities of users. Our approach moves beyond simple diversity metrics toward evaluating the fidelity of AI-generated content in authentically capturing the nuanced hierarchies of global cultures.

### [16] [LangFIR: Discovering Sparse Language-Specific Features from Monolingual Data for Language Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03532)
*Sing Hieng Wong,Hassan Sajjad,A. B. Siddique*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LangFIR通过随机token序列筛选方法，仅使用单语文本即可从稀疏自编码器(SAE)中识别语言特异性特征，用于大语言模型的多语言输出控制，显著优于依赖平行数据的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多语言大语言模型难以可靠控制输出语言，基于表示层面的 steering 方法虽有潜力，但识别语言特异性方向通常依赖昂贵的多语言或平行数据，限制了方法的实用性。

Method: LangFIR 方法的核心创新在于：使用随机token序列来暴露和过滤掉语言无关的SAE特征。具体流程为：(1) 对目标语言输入收集高频激活的SAE特征；(2) 利用随机token序列（不构成自然语言）识别同样被激活但语言无关的特征；(3) 过滤这些无关特征后，保留稀疏的语言特异性特征集；(4) 利用这些特征构建 steering 向量用于生成控制。

Result: LangFIR在3个模型（Gemma 3 1B、4B 和 Llama 3.1 8B）、3个数据集、12种目标语言上取得了最佳平均 BLEU 准确率，超越了依赖平行数据的强基线方法。

Conclusion: 多语言LLM中的语言身份信息高度局部化于稀疏的特征方向中，且这些方向可通过单语文本发现，无需平行或多语言数据支持，降低了语言特异性特征识别的数据门槛。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show strong multilingual capabilities, yet reliably controlling the language of their outputs remains difficult. Representation-level steering addresses this by adding language-specific vectors to model activations at inference time, but identifying language-specific directions in the residual stream often relies on multilingual or parallel data that can be expensive to obtain. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose residual activations into interpretable, sparse feature directions and offer a natural basis for this search, yet existing SAE-based approaches face the same data constraint. We introduce LangFIR (Language Feature Identification via Random-token Filtering), a method that discovers language-specific SAE features using only a small amount of monolingual data and random-token sequences. Many SAE features consistently activated by target-language inputs do not encode language identity. Random-token sequences surface these language-agnostic features, allowing LangFIR to filter them out and isolate a sparse set of language-specific features. We show that these features are extremely sparse, highly selective for their target language, and causally important: directional ablation increases cross-entropy loss only for the corresponding language. Using these features to construct steering vectors for multilingual generation control, LangFIR achieves the best average accuracy BLEU across three models (Gemma 3 1B, Gemma 3 4B, and Llama 3.1 8B), three datasets, and twelve target languages, outperforming the strongest monolingual baseline by up to and surpassing methods that rely on parallel data. Our results suggest that language identity in multilingual LLMs is localized in a sparse set of feature directions discoverable with monolingual data. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LangFIR-C0F5/.

</details>


### [17] [Rethinking Token Prediction: Tree-Structured Diffusion Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03537)
*Zihao Wu,Haoming Yang,Juncheng Dong,Vahid Tarokh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Discrete diffusion language models have emerged as a competitive alternative to auto-regressive language models, but training them efficiently under limited parameter and memory budgets remains challenging. Modern architectures are predominantly based on a full-vocabulary token prediction layer, which accounts for a substantial fraction of model parameters (e.g., more than 20% in small scale DiT-style designs) and often dominates peak GPU memory usage. This leads to inefficient use of both parameters and memory under constrained training resources. To address this issue, we revisit the necessity of explicit full-vocabulary prediction, and instead exploit the inherent structure among tokens to build a tree-structured diffusion language model. Specifically, we model the diffusion process with intermediate latent states corresponding to a token's ancestor nodes in a pre-constructed vocabulary tree. This tree-structured factorization exponentially reduces the classification dimensionality, makes the prediction head negligible in size, and enables reallocation of parameters to deepen the attention blocks. Empirically, under the same parameter budget, our method reduces peak GPU memory usage by half while matching the perplexity performance of state-of-the-art discrete diffusion language models.

### [18] [Text Summarization With Graph Attention Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03583)
*Mohammadreza Ardestani,Yllias Chali*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: This study aimed to leverage graph information, particularly Rhetorical Structure Theory (RST) and Co-reference (Coref) graphs, to enhance the performance of our baseline summarization models. Specifically, we experimented with a Graph Attention Network architecture to incorporate graph information. However, this architecture did not enhance the performance. Subsequently, we used a simple Multi-layer Perceptron architecture, which improved the results in our proposed model on our primary dataset, CNN/DM. Additionally, we annotated XSum dataset with RST graph information, establishing a benchmark for future graph-based summarization models. This secondary dataset posed multiple challenges, revealing both the merits and limitations of our models.

### [19] [MultiPress: A Multi-Agent Framework for Interpretable Multimodal News Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03586)
*Tailong Luo,Hao Li,Rong Fu,Xinyue Jiang,Huaxuan Ding,Yiduo Zhang,Zilin Zhao,Simon Fong,Guangyin Jin,Jianyuan Ni*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MultiPress是一个用于多模态新闻分类的三阶段多智能体框架，通过整合多模态感知、智能体检索增强推理、门控融合评分和奖励驱动的迭代优化机制，显著提升新闻分类的准确性和可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常独立处理模态或采用简单的融合策略，难以捕捉复杂的跨模态交互并利用外部知识。随着多模态新闻内容的普及，需要模型能够联合理解和推理文本与图像等异构数据。

Method: MultiPress采用三阶段多智能体框架：
1. 多模态感知智能体
2. 检索增强推理智能体
3. 门控融合评分智能体
配合奖励驱动的迭代优化机制，在新构建的大规模多模态新闻数据集上进行验证。

Result: 相比强基线模型取得显著改进，验证了模块化多智能体协作和检索增强推理在提升分类准确性和可解释性方面的有效性。

Conclusion: 多智能体框架结合检索增强推理能有效解决多模态新闻分类问题，模块化设计增强了系统的可解释性，为复杂多模态理解任务提供了新思路。

Abstract: With the growing prevalence of multimodal news content, effective news topic classification demands models capable of jointly understanding and reasoning over heterogeneous data such as text and images. Existing methods often process modalities independently or employ simplistic fusion strategies, limiting their ability to capture complex cross-modal interactions and leverage external knowledge. To overcome these limitations, we propose MultiPress, a novel three-stage multi-agent framework for multimodal news classification. MultiPress integrates specialized agents for multimodal perception, retrieval-augmented reasoning, and gated fusion scoring, followed by a reward-driven iterative optimization mechanism. We validate MultiPress on a newly constructed large-scale multimodal news dataset, demonstrating significant improvements over strong baselines and highlighting the effectiveness of modular multi-agent collaboration and retrieval-augmented reasoning in enhancing classification accuracy and interpretability.

</details>


### [20] [Unveiling Language Routing Isolation in Multilingual MoE Models for Interpretable Subnetwork Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03592)
*Kening Zheng,Wei-Chieh Huang,Jiahao Huo,Zhonghao Li,Henry Peng Zou,Yibo Yan,Xin Zou,Jungang Li,Junzhuo Li,Hanrong Zhang,Xuming Hu,Philip S. Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models exhibit striking performance disparities across languages, yet the internal mechanisms driving these gaps remain poorly understood. In this work, we conduct a systematic analysis of expert routing patterns in MoE models, revealing a phenomenon we term Language Routing Isolation, in which high- and low-resource languages tend to activate largely disjoint expert sets. Through layer-stratified analysis, we further show that routing patterns exhibit a layer-wise convergence-divergence pattern across model depth. Building on these findings, we propose RISE (Routing Isolation-guided Subnetwork Enhancement), a framework that exploits routing isolation to identify and adapt language-specific expert subnetworks. RISE applies a tripartite selection strategy, using specificity scores to identify language-specific experts in shallow and deep layers and overlap scores to select universal experts in middle layers. By training only the selected subnetwork while freezing all other parameters, RISE substantially improves low-resource language performance while preserving capabilities in other languages. Experiments on 10 languages demonstrate that RISE achieves target-language F1 gains of up to 10.85% with minimal cross-lingual degradation.

### [21] [The Format Tax](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03616)
*Ivan Yee Lee,Loris D'Antoni,Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Asking a large language model to respond in JSON should be a formatting choice, not a capability tax. Yet we find that structured output requirements -- JSON, XML, LaTeX, Markdown -- substantially degrade reasoning and writing performance across open-weight models. The research response has focused on constrained decoding, but sampling bias accounts for only a fraction of the degradation. The dominant cost enters at the prompt: format-requesting instructions alone cause most of the accuracy loss, before any decoder constraint is applied. This diagnosis points to a simple principle: decouple reasoning from formatting. Whether by generating freeform first and reformatting in a second pass, or by enabling extended thinking within a single generation, separating the two concerns substantially recovers lost accuracy. Across six open-weight models, four API models, four formats, and tasks spanning math, science, logic, and writing, decoupling recovers most lost accuracy. Notably, most recent closed-weight models show little to no format tax, suggesting the problem is not inherent to structured generation but a gap that current open-weight models have yet to close. Code is available at https://github.com/ivnle/the-format-tax.

### [22] [LightThinker++: From Reasoning Compression to Memory Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03679)
*Yuqi Zhu,Jintian Zhang,Zhenjie Wan,Yujie Luo,Shuofei Qiao,Zhengke Gui,Da Zheng,Lei Liang,Huajun Chen,Ningyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出LightThinker系列方法，通过动态压缩LLM中间思考过程和显式自适应记忆管理，实现推理效率的大幅提升。LightThinker将思考内容压缩为紧凑语义表示，LightThinker++进一步引入记忆原语和行为级管理，实现上下文高效利用。实验表明，该方法可在降低60-70%令牌使用量的同时保持甚至提升推理性能，特别是在长 horizon agentic任务中效果显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在复杂推理任务中表现出色，但其效率受到长思维轨迹带来的认知开销（大量token消耗）的严重限制。现有静态压缩方法在复杂推理场景中面临中间细节不可逆丢失导致的逻辑瓶颈问题。

Method: 本文提出两阶段方法：(1) LightThinker：动态将中间思考压缩为紧凑语义表示；(2) LightThinker++：引入显式自适应记忆管理（Explicit Adaptive Memory Management），通过显式记忆原语实现行为级管理，并配合专门的轨迹合成pipeline训练有目的的记忆调度策略。

Result: 实验验证了方法在三个维度的有效性：(1) LightThinker：峰值token使用量减少70%，推理时间减少26%，精度损失极小；(2) LightThinker++标准推理：峰值token减少69.9%，相同上下文预算下精度提升2.42%；(3) 长周期agentic任务：80轮以上保持稳定开销（减少60-70%），各复杂场景平均性能提升14.8%。

Conclusion: 本文为在最小开销下维持LLM跨扩展视野的深度推理能力提供了可扩展的方向，特别是在长周期、复杂场景的agentic任务中展现出显著的效率和性能优势。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at complex reasoning, yet their efficiency is limited by the surging cognitive overhead of long thought traces. In this paper, we propose LightThinker, a method that enables LLMs to dynamically compress intermediate thoughts into compact semantic representations. However, static compression often struggles with complex reasoning where the irreversible loss of intermediate details can lead to logical bottlenecks. To address this, we evolve the framework into LightThinker++, introducing Explicit Adaptive Memory Management. This paradigm shifts to behavioral-level management by incorporating explicit memory primitives, supported by a specialized trajectory synthesis pipeline to train purposeful memory scheduling. Extensive experiments demonstrate the framework's versatility across three dimensions. (1) LightThinker reduces peak token usage by 70% and inference time by 26% with minimal accuracy loss. (2) In standard reasoning, LightThinker++ slashes peak token usage by 69.9% while yielding a +2.42% accuracy gain under the same context budget for maximum performance. (3) Most notably, in long-horizon agentic tasks, it maintains a stable footprint beyond 80 rounds (a 60%-70% reduction), achieving an average performance gain of 14.8% across different complex scenarios. Overall, our work provides a scalable direction for sustaining deep LLM reasoning over extended horizons with minimal overhead.

</details>


### [23] [CAGMamba: Context-Aware Gated Cross-Modal Mamba Network for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03650)
*Minghai Jiao,Jing Xiao,Peng Xiao,Ende Zhang,Shuang Kan,Wenyan Jiang,Jinyao Li,Yixian Liu,Haidong Xin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) requires effective modeling of cross-modal interactions and contextual dependencies while remaining computationally efficient. Existing fusion approaches predominantly rely on Transformer-based cross-modal attention, which incurs quadratic complexity with respect to sequence length and limits scalability. Moreover, contextual information from preceding utterances is often incorporated through concatenation or independent fusion, without explicit temporal modeling that captures sentiment evolution across dialogue turns. To address these limitations, we propose CAGMamba, a context-aware gated cross-modal Mamba framework for dialogue-based sentiment analysis. Specifically, we organize the contextual and the current-utterance features into a temporally ordered binary sequence, which provides Mamba with explicit temporal structure for modeling sentiment evolution. To further enable controllable cross-modal integration, we propose a Gated Cross-Modal Mamba Network (GCMN) that integrates cross-modal and unimodal paths via learnable gating to balance information fusion and modality preservation, and is trained with a three-branch multi-task objective over text, audio, and fused predictions. Experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that CAGMamba achieves state-of-the-art or competitive results across multiple evaluation metrics. All codes are available at https://github.com/User2024-xj/CAGMamba.

*Avish Vijayaraghavan,Jaskaran Singh Kawatra,Sebin Sabu,Jonny Sheldon,Will Poulett,Alex Eze,Daniel Key,John Booth,Shiren Patel,Jonny Pearson,Dan Schofield,Jonathan Hope,Pavithra Rajendran,Neil Sebire*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究开发了一种基于小型语言模型（SLM）的资源高效半自动标注工作流，用于从结构化文本中提取儿科肾脏活检报告中的信息。Gemma 2 2B在CPU基础设施上达到84.3%的准确率，优于传统的spaCy、BioBERT-SQuAD等模型，且仅需最少临床医生参与即可运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子病历系统中的临床数据大多被困在非结构化文本中，难以用于研究和决策支持。虽然大型语言模型可以提取这些信息，但本地运行需要大量计算资源，而将敏感临床数据发送到云端即使已脱敏也引发严重的患者隐私问题。因此需要一种资源高效且保护隐私的解决方案。

Method: 研究迭代开发工作流，经过3次临床监督会议，使用Great Ormond Street Hospital的2,111份报告中的400份作为金标准手动标注。将信息提取任务框架化为问答任务，结合临床医生指导的实体指南和少样本示例。评估了5种指令调优的SLM，并使用分歧建模框架优先处理需要临床审查的报告。

Result: Gemma 2 2B达到最高准确率84.3%，优于现成模型：spaCy (74.3%)、BioBERT-SQuAD (62.3%)、RoBERTa-SQuAD (59.7%) 和 GLiNER (60.2%)。实体指南相比零样本基线提升7-19%，少样本示例提升6-38%，但两者结合使用时不产生叠加效应。

Conclusion: SLM可在CPU基础设施上从专业临床领域提取结构化信息，且仅需最少临床医生参与。该方法在隐私敏感场景中具有实际应用价值，为医疗NLP任务提供了一种平衡性能与资源消耗的可行方案。

Abstract: Electronic Patient Record (EPR) systems contain valuable clinical information, but much of it is trapped in unstructured text, limiting its use for research and decision-making. Large language models can extract such information but require substantial computational resources to run locally, and sending sensitive clinical data to cloud-based services, even when deidentified, raises significant patient privacy concerns. In this study, we develop a resource-efficient semi-automated annotation workflow using small language models (SLMs) to extract structured information from unstructured EPR data, focusing on paediatric histopathology reports. As a proof-of-concept, we apply the workflow to paediatric renal biopsy reports, a domain chosen for its constrained diagnostic scope and well-defined underlying biology. We develop the workflow iteratively with clinical oversight across three meetings, manually annotating 400 reports from a dataset of 2,111 at Great Ormond Street Hospital as a gold standard, while developing an automated information extraction approach using SLMs. We frame extraction as a Question-Answering task grounded by clinician-guided entity guidelines and few-shot examples, evaluating five instruction-tuned SLMs with a disagreement modelling framework to prioritise reports for clinical review. Gemma 2 2B achieves the highest accuracy at 84.3%, outperforming off-the-shelf models including spaCy (74.3%), BioBERT-SQuAD (62.3%), RoBERTa-SQuAD (59.7%), and GLiNER (60.2%). Entity guidelines improved performance by 7-19% over the zero-shot baseline, and few-shot examples by 6-38%, though their benefits do not compound when combined. These results demonstrate that SLMs can extract structured information from specialised clinical domains on CPU-only infrastructure with minimal clinician involvement. Our code is available at https://github.com/gosh-dre/nlp_renal_biopsy.

</details>


### [25] [SkillX: Automatically Constructing Skill Knowledge Bases for Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04804)
*Chenxi Wang,Zhuoyun Yu,Xin Xie,Wuguannan Yao,Runnan Fang,Shuofei Qiao,Kexin Cao,Guozhou Zheng,Xiang Qi,Peng Zhang,Shumin Deng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Learning from experience is critical for building capable large language model (LLM) agents, yet prevailing self-evolving paradigms remain inefficient: agents learn in isolation, repeatedly rediscover similar behaviors from limited experience, resulting in redundant exploration and poor generalization. To address this problem, we propose SkillX, a fully automated framework for constructing a \textbf{plug-and-play skill knowledge base} that can be reused across agents and environments. SkillX operates through a fully automated pipeline built on three synergistic innovations: \textit{(i) Multi-Level Skills Design}, which distills raw trajectories into three-tiered hierarchy of strategic plans, functional skills, and atomic skills; \textit{(ii) Iterative Skills Refinement}, which automatically revises skills based on execution feedback to continuously improve library quality; and \textit{(iii) Exploratory Skills Expansion}, which proactively generates and validates novel skills to expand coverage beyond seed training data. Using a strong backbone agent (GLM-4.6), we automatically build a reusable skill library and evaluate its transferability on challenging long-horizon, user-interactive benchmarks, including AppWorld, BFCL-v3, and $τ^2$-Bench. Experiments show that SkillKB consistently improves task success and execution efficiency when plugged into weaker base agents, highlighting the importance of structured, hierarchical experience representations for generalizable agent learning. Our code will be publicly available soon at https://github.com/zjunlp/SkillX.

### [26] [Document-Level Numerical Reasoning across Single and Multiple Tables in Financial Reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03664)
*Yi-Cheng Wang,Wei-An Wang,Chu-Song Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了FinLongDocQA数据集，用于评估LLM在长金融文档中进行单表和跨表数值推理问答的能力，并发现现有LLM存在上下文长度限制和多步数值推理错误两大瓶颈。为解决这些问题，提出了FinLongDocAgent多智能体多轮检索增强生成方法，通过迭代检索证据、执行中间计算和验证结果来提升数值问答的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM基准测试主要关注单表场景，缺乏对跨表文档级数值推理的评估。金融年报通常超过129k tokens，分析师需要整合分散在多个表格和文本中的证据进行数值计算，但现有方法难以有效处理这类长文档跨表数值推理任务。

Method: 1) 构建FinLongDocQA数据集，包含单表和跨表金融数值推理问题；2) 提出FinLongDocAgent方法，采用Multi-Agent Multi-Round RAG架构，迭代执行证据检索、中间计算和结果验证。

Result: 评估了闭源和开源LLM在FinLongDocQA上的表现，发现两个主要瓶颈：1) 年报常超过129k tokens，加剧上下文衰减问题，难以定位相关表格；2) 即使定位到相关证据，LLM在多步数值推理中仍易出错。

Conclusion: 迭代式检索和验证对长金融文档中的可靠数值问答至关重要。FinLongDocAgent通过多轮迭代检索和验证机制，有效提升了金融文档数值推理的准确性。

Abstract: Despite the strong language understanding abilities of large language models (LLMs), they still struggle with reliable question answering (QA) over long, structured documents, particularly for numerical reasoning. Financial annual reports exemplify this difficulty: financial statement analysis often hinges on accurate arithmetic, and analysts derive key indicators by integrating evidence scattered across multiple tables and narrative text. However, existing benchmarks focus largely on single-table settings, leaving cross-table document-level numerical reasoning underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce FinLongDocQA, a dataset for both single-table and cross-table financial numerical reasoning in long-context reports. Evaluating both closed-source and open-source LLMs on FinLongDocQA reveals two bottlenecks: (1) annual reports often exceed 129k tokens, exacerbating the context rot problem for locating relevant tables; and (2) even when relevant evidence is located, LLMs remain prone to errors in multi-step numerical reasoning. We propose FinLongDocAgent, a Multi-Agent Multi-Round Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) approach that iteratively retrieves evidence, performs intermediate calculations, and verifies results across rounds. Experiments highlight the importance of iterative retrieval and verification for reliable numerical QA in long financial documents.

</details>


### [27] [AI Appeals Processor: A Deep Learning Approach to Automated Classification of Citizen Appeals in Government Services](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03672)
*Vladimir Beskorovainyi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Government agencies worldwide face growing volumes of citizen appeals, with electronic submissions increasing significantly over recent years. Traditional manual processing averages 20 minutes per appeal with only 67% classification accuracy, creating significant bottlenecks in public service delivery. This paper presents AI Appeals Processor, a microservice-based system that integrates natural language processing and deep learning techniques for automated classification and routing of citizen appeals. We evaluate multiple approaches -- including Bag-of-Words with SVM, TF-IDF with SVM, fastText, Word2Vec with LSTM, and BERT -- on a representative dataset of 10,000 real citizen appeals across three primary categories (complaints, applications, and proposals) and seven thematic domains. Our experiments demonstrate that a Word2Vec+LSTM architecture achieves 78% classification accuracy while reducing processing time by 54%, offering an optimal balance between accuracy and computational efficiency compared to transformer-based models.

### [28] ['Layer su Layer': Identifying and Disambiguating the Italian NPN Construction in BERT's family](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03673)
*Greta Gorzoni,Ludovica Pannitto,Francesca Masini*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究评估BERT的上下文嵌入是否编码意大利语NPN（名词-介词-名词）构式家族的语言信息，通过层级探测分类器分析模型各层对构式形式和意义的编码程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可解释性研究需要评估预训练语言模型（PLM）的上下文嵌入是否编码与显性语言理论相对应的语言信息，但现有实验设计存在理论和方法论假设问题，且研究多集中于英语等主流语言。

Method: 使用BERT提取上下文向量表示，输入层级探测分类器（layer-wise probing classifiers），系统评估模型内部各层编码的信息。

Result: 研究揭示了构式形式和意义在上下文嵌入中的反映程度，为构式理论与神经语言建模之间的对话提供了实证证据。

Conclusion: 研究扩展了构式研究至意大利语这一较少被关注的语言，并对现有实验设计的方法论假设提出了挑战。

Abstract: Interpretability research has highlighted the importance of evaluating Pretrained Language Models (PLMs) and in particular contextual embeddings against explicit linguistic theories to determine what linguistic information they encode. This study focuses on the Italian NPN (noun-preposition-noun) constructional family, challenging some of the theoretical and methodological assumptions underlying previous experimental designs and extending this type of research to a lesser-investigated language. Contextual vector representations are extracted from BERT and used as input to layer-wise probing classifiers, systematically evaluating information encoded across the model's internal layers. The results shed light on the extent to which constructional form and meaning are reflected in contextual embeddings, contributing empirical evidence to the dialogue between constructionist theory and neural language modelling

</details>


### [29] [Unlocking Prompt Infilling Capability for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03677)
*Yoshinari Fujinuma,Keisuke Sakaguchi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文解决了掩码扩散语言模型(dLMs)无法进行提示填充(infilling)的限制。核心发现是：现有SFT训练只对响应部分进行掩码，而非提示部分，导致模型丧失提示填充能力。通过在SFT阶段对提示和响应联合掩码，可解锁模型的提示填充能力，使其能够基于少样本示例自动生成高质量提示模板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型通过双向去噪生成文本，但在提示填充场景下能力受限。这一限制并非架构问题，而是当前SFT训练范式的artifact——仅对响应部分应用掩码，限制了模型对提示模板的填充能力。

Method: 在SFT阶段采用全序列掩码策略，对提示和响应联合掩码，使模型学习在给定少样本示例条件下，对提示模板中的掩码位置进行填充。

Result: 模型自动填充的提示可匹配或超越人工设计的提示模板，并具有良好的跨模型迁移性，且与现有提示优化方法互补。

Conclusion: 训练实践（而非架构限制）是阻止掩码扩散语言模型进行有效提示填充的主要瓶颈。通过改进掩码策略即可解锁其提示填充能力。

Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLMs) generate text through bidirectional denoising, yet this capability remains locked for infilling prompts. This limitation is an artifact of the current supervised finetuning (SFT) convention of applying response-only masking. To unlock this capability, we extend full-sequence masking during SFT, where both prompts and responses are masked jointly. Once unlocked, the model infills masked portions of a prompt template conditioned on few-shot examples. We show that such model-infilled prompts match or surpass manually designed templates, transfer effectively across models, and are complementary to existing prompt optimization methods. Our results suggest that training practices, not architectural limitations, are the primary bottleneck preventing masked diffusion language models from infilling effective prompts

</details>


### [30] [Researchers waste 80% of LLM annotation costs by classifying one text at a time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03684)
*Christian Pipal,Eva-Maria Vogel,Morgan Wack,Frank Esser*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究测试了批量处理和变量堆叠是否能减少大语言模型（LLM）进行文本分类时的API调用次数和成本，同时保持编码质量。研究发现，6/8个模型在批量大小≤100、堆叠变量≤10时，精度损失在2个百分点以内，且该误差小于人工编码者之间的典型分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交科学研究者使用LLM进行文本分类时，传统方法对每个变量的每条文本单独调用API，导致大量资源消耗（如100,000条文本×4个变量需要400,000次API调用）。研究者试图通过批量处理和变量堆叠降低成本，但尚不清楚这是否会影响编码质量。

Method: 使用4家提供商提供的8个生产级LLM，对3,962条专家编码的推文进行测试，涵盖4项任务。实验中变化了批量大小（1至1,000条）和每提示堆叠的编码维度数量（最多25个）。

Result: 6/8的模型在批量大小≤100时保持了与单条基线相近的精度（偏差在2个百分点内）。变量堆叠在≤10个维度时产生与单变量编码相当的结果。性能下降主要由任务复杂度驱动，而非提示长度。在安全操作范围内，批量处理和堆叠带来的测量误差小于专家标注数据中的典型人工编码者间分歧。

Conclusion: 在合理范围内（批量≤100、堆叠变量≤10），批量处理和变量堆叠可大幅降低LLM文本分类的API调用次数和成本（减少80%以上），同时保持可接受的编码质量，为大规模社会科学文本分类任务提供了高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used for text classification across the social sciences, yet researchers overwhelmingly classify one text per variable per prompt. Coding 100,000 texts on four variables requires 400,000 API calls. Batching 25 items and stacking all variables into a single prompt reduces this to 4,000 calls, cutting token costs by over 80%. Whether this degrades coding quality is unknown. We tested eight production LLMs from four providers on 3,962 expert-coded tweets across four tasks, varying batch size from 1 to 1,000 items and stacking up to 25 coding dimensions per prompt. Six of eight models maintained accuracy within 2 pp of the single-item baseline through batch sizes of 100. Variable stacking with up to 10 dimensions produced results comparable to single-variable coding, with degradation driven by task complexity rather than prompt length. Within this safe operating range, the measurement error from batching and stacking is smaller than typical inter-coder disagreement in the ground-truth data.

</details>


### [31] [POEMetric: The Last Stanza of Humanity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03695)
*Bingru Li,Han Wang,Hazel Wilkinson*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: POEMetric框架通过3个维度评估诗歌生成能力：基础指令遵循、高级创意能力、整体质量。实验涵盖30个LLM和203首人类诗歌，结果显示LLM在形式准确性(4.26/5)和主题对齐(4.99)上表现良好，但在创造力(4.02)、独特性(3.95)、情感共鸣(4.06)、意象(4.49)和修辞(4.67)等高级能力上均未能达到人类水平，整体质量评估也以4.22 vs 3.20落后于人类，表明诗歌生成仍是LLM的重大挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型(LLM)虽能创作诗歌，但与人类诗人之间仍存在显著差距。当前缺乏全面系统的诗歌评估框架来量化这种差距，因此需要构建多维度的评估体系以准确衡量LLM的诗歌生成能力。

Method: 构建POEMetric评估框架，包含3个评估维度：1)基础指令遵循能力(形式、主题)；2)高级能力(创造力、词汇多样性、独特性、情感共鸣、意象、修辞手法)；3)整体质量与作者归属。同时构建人类诗歌数据集(203首英文诗歌，7种固定诗体，带韵律和主题标注)，对30个LLM进行诗歌生成实验(共6,090首)。采用规则评估与LLM-as-judge相结合的方法，并通过人类专家验证结果。

Result: 顶级LLM在形式准确性(4.26/5)和主题对齐(4.99)上表现优异，但在高级能力上全面落后于人类诗人：创造力(4.02)、独特性(3.95)、情感共鸣(4.06)、意象运用(4.49)、修辞手法(4.67)。整体质量评估中人类(4.22)显著优于最佳LLM(3.20)。

Conclusion: 诗歌生成对LLM而言仍是极具挑战性的任务。尽管LLM能够掌握诗歌的形式规范和主题要求，但在创意性、情感表达和艺术表现力等高级诗歌素养方面与人类诗人存在本质差距。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can compose poetry, but how far are they from human poets? In this paper, we introduce POEMetric, the first comprehensive framework for poetry evaluation, examining 1) basic instruction-following abilities in generating poems according to a certain form and theme, 2) advanced abilities of showing creativity, lexical diversity, and idiosyncrasy, evoking emotional resonance, and using imagery and literary devices, and 3) general appraisal of the overall poem quality and estimation of authorship. We curated a human poem dataset - 203 English poems of 7 fixed forms annotated with meter, rhyme patterns and themes - and experimented with 30 LLMs for poetry generation based on the same forms and themes of the human data, totaling 6,090 LLM poems. Based on POEMetric, we assessed the performance of both human poets and LLMs through rule-based evaluation and LLM-as-a-judge, whose results were validated by human experts. Results show that, though the top model achieved high form accuracy (4.26 out of 5.00, with Gemini-2.5-Pro as a judge; same below) and theme alignment (4.99), all models failed to reach the same level of advanced abilities as human poets, who achieved unparalleled creativity (4.02), idiosyncrasy (3.95), emotional resonance (4.06), and skillful use of imagery (4.49) and literary devices (4.67). Humans also defeated the best-performing LLM in overall poem quality (4.22 vs. 3.20). As such, poetry generation remains a formidable challenge for LLMs. Data and codes are released at https://github.com/Bingru-Li/POEMetric.

</details>


### [32] [Testing the Limits of Truth Directions in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03754)
*Angelos Poulis,Mark Crovella,Evimaria Terzi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型(LLM)中"真值方向"(truth direction)的普遍性(universality)问题。研究发现，真值方向并非普遍存在，而是受到多层依赖、任务类型、任务复杂度和提示模板的显著影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究声称真值方向具有普遍性，但近期工作基于有限设置质疑了这一结论。本文旨在系统性地识别和理解真值方向普遍性的边界和限制。

Method: 作者从四个维度探测真值方向：(1)跨多层探测模型激活空间；(2)区分任务类型（事实型 vs 推理型）；(3)评估不同任务复杂度；(4)分析指令模板变化的影响。

Result: 研究发现：(1)真值方向高度依赖模型层——事实任务在浅层出现，推理任务在深层出现；(2)任务类型影响真值方向的形成位置；(3)任务复杂度影响探针性能；(4)指令模板显著影响探针泛化能力。

Conclusion: 真值方向的普遍性主张比先前所知更为有限，需在多个模型层、任务难度、任务类型和提示模板条件下进行系统评估。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to encode truth of statements in their activation space along a linear truth direction. Previous studies have argued that these directions are universal in certain aspects, while more recent work has questioned this conclusion drawing on limited generalization across some settings. In this work, we identify a number of limits of truth-direction universality that have not been previously understood. We first show that truth directions are highly layer-dependent, and that a full understanding of universality requires probing at many layers in the model. We then show that truth directions depend heavily on task type, emerging in earlier layers for factual and later layers for reasoning tasks; they also vary in performance across levels of task complexity. Finally, we show that model instructions dramatically affect truth directions; simple correctness evaluation instructions significantly affect the generalization ability of truth probes. Our findings indicate that universality claims for truth directions are more limited than previously known, with significant differences observable for various model layers, task difficulties, task types, and prompt templates.

</details>


### [33] [Your Agent is More Brittle Than You Think: Uncovering Indirect Injection Vulnerabilities in Agentic LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03870)
*Wenhui Zhu,Xuanzhao Dong,Xiwen Chen,Rui Cai,Peijie Qiu,Zhipeng Wang,Oana Frunza,Shao Tang,Jindong Gu,Yalin Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: The rapid deployment of open-source frameworks has significantly advanced the development of modern multi-agent systems. However, expanded action spaces, including uncontrolled privilege exposure and hidden inter-system interactions, pose severe security challenges. Specifically, Indirect Prompt Injections (IPI), which conceal malicious instructions within third-party content, can trigger unauthorized actions such as data exfiltration during normal operations. While current security evaluations predominantly rely on isolated single-turn benchmarks, the systemic vulnerabilities of these agents within complex dynamic environments remain critically underexplored. To bridge this gap, we systematically evaluate six defense strategies against four sophisticated IPI attack vectors across nine LLM backbones. Crucially, we conduct our evaluation entirely within dynamic multi-step tool-calling environments to capture the true attack surface of modern autonomous agents. Moving beyond binary success rates, our multidimensional analysis reveals a pronounced fragility. Advanced injections successfully bypass nearly all baseline defenses, and some surface-level mitigations even produce counterproductive side effects. Furthermore, while agents execute malicious instructions almost instantaneously, their internal states exhibit abnormally high decision entropy. Motivated by this latent hesitation, we investigate Representation Engineering (RepE) as a robust detection strategy. By extracting hidden states at the tool-input position, we revealed that the RepE-based circuit breaker successfully identifies and intercepts unauthorized actions before the agent commits to them, achieving high detection accuracy across diverse LLM backbones. This study exposes the limitations of current IPI defenses and provides a highly practical paradigm for building resilient multi-agent architectures.

### [34] [When Models Know More Than They Say: Probing Analogical Reasoning in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03877)
*Hope McGovern,Caroline Craig,Thomas Lippincott,Hale Sirin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LLM在表层线索与结构线索一致时表现良好，但在需要潜在信息的类比检测中表现不佳。通过比较模型探针表示与提示性能，发现对于修辞类比，开源模型的探针显著优于提示，但对于叙事类比，两者表现相似（均较低），表明内部表示与提示行为的关系受任务影响，且提示可能无法有效访问可用信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在类比推理中存在局限性：表面线索与结构线索一致时表现好，但在需要抽象和泛化的潜在类比检测中表现差，暗示其表征与行为之间可能存在解耦。

Method: 比较模型的探针表示（probed representations）与提示性能（prompted performance）在检测叙事类比和修辞类比任务上的表现。

Result: 发现显著不对称性：对于修辞类比，探针方法显著优于开源模型的提示方法；而对于叙事类比，两种方法表现相似（均较低）。

Conclusion: 内部表征与提示行为之间的关系是任务依赖的；提示方法可能存在访问可用信息的局限性，无法充分发挥模型内部已编码的知识。

Abstract: Analogical reasoning is a core cognitive faculty essential for narrative understanding. While LLMs perform well when surface and structural cues align, they struggle in cases where an analogy is not apparent on the surface but requires latent information, suggesting limitations in abstraction and generalisation. In this paper we compare a model's probed representations with its prompted performance at detecting narrative analogies, revealing an asymmetry: for rhetorical analogies, probing significantly outperforms prompting in open-source models, while for narrative analogies, they achieve a similar (low) performance. This suggests that the relationship between internal representations and prompted behavior is task-dependent and may reflect limitations in how prompting accesses available information.

</details>


### [35] [I-CALM: Incentivizing Confidence-Aware Abstention for LLM Hallucination Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03904)
*Haotian Zong,Binze Li,Yufei Long,Sinyin Chang,Jialong Wu,Gillian K. Hadfield*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究提出I-CALM框架，通过提示工程（显式声明奖惩机制+规范性原则）让大语言模型在不确定时选择弃答，从而减少幻觉。该框架在GPT-5 mini和PopQA数据集上有效降低了错误回答率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）常产生自信但错误的答案（幻觉），部分原因是传统的二元评分机制（仅评价回答正确与否）奖励回答行为而非诚实表达不确定性。当前LLM在事实性问题上往往无法在不确定时选择弃答。

Method: 1) 验证自报告口头置信度作为不确定性信号的有效性；2) 提出I-CALM提示框架，包含三个核心要素：(i) 激发口头置信度，(ii) 通过显式奖惩机制部分奖励弃答行为，(iii) 添加强调真实性、谦逊和责任感的轻量级规范性原则。主要实验使用GPT-5 mini和PopQA数据集。

Result: 置信度激发和弃答奖励提示（尤其是结合规范性原则时）主要通过识别并转移易出错案例至弃答，以及重新校准置信度来降低已答案例的错误率。这以覆盖率为代价提升了可靠性，而强制回答表现基本不变。调整弃答奖励参数可得到清晰的弃答-幻觉权衡曲线。

Conclusion: I-CALM框架可在无需重训练的情况下改善事实性问题的选择性回答能力，效果幅度因模型和数据集而异。代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) frequently produce confident but incorrect answers, partly because common binary scoring conventions reward answering over honestly expressing uncertainty. We study whether prompt-only interventions -- explicitly announcing reward schemes for answer-versus-abstain decisions plus humility-oriented normative principles -- can reduce hallucination risk without modifying the model. Our focus is epistemic abstention on factual questions with a verifiable answer, where current LLMs often fail to abstain despite being uncertain about their answers. We first assess self-reported verbal confidence as a usable uncertainty signal, showing stability under prompt paraphrasing and reasonable calibration against a token-probability baseline. We then study I-CALM, a prompt-based framework that (i) elicits verbal confidence, (ii) partially rewards abstention through explicit reward schemes, and (iii) adds lightweight normative principles emphasizing truthfulness, humility, and responsibility. Using GPT-5 mini on PopQA as the main setting, we find that confidence-eliciting, abstention-rewarding prompts, especially with norms, reduce the false-answer rate on answered cases mainly by identifying and shifting error-prone cases to abstention and re-calibrating their confidence. This trades coverage for reliability while leaving forced-answer performance largely unchanged. Varying the abstention reward yields a clear abstention-hallucination frontier. Overall, results show the framework can improve selective answering on factual questions without retraining, with the magnitude of effect varying across models and datasets. Code is available at the following https://github.com/binzeli/hallucinationControl.

</details>


### [36] [From Plausible to Causal: Counterfactual Semantics for Policy Evaluation in Simulated Online Communities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03920)
*Agam Goyal,Yian Wang,Eshwar Chandrasekharan,Hari Sundaram*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LLM-based social simulations can generate believable community interactions, enabling ``policy wind tunnels'' where governance interventions are tested before deployment. But believability is not causality. Claims like ``intervention $A$ reduces escalation'' require causal semantics that current simulation work typically does not specify. We propose adopting the causal counterfactual framework, distinguishing \textit{necessary causation} (would the outcome have occurred without the intervention?) from \textit{sufficient causation} (does the intervention reliably produce the outcome?). This distinction maps onto different stakeholder needs: moderators diagnosing incidents require evidence about necessity, while platform designers choosing policies require evidence about sufficiency. We formalize this mapping, show how simulation design can support estimation under explicit assumptions, and argue that the resulting quantities should be interpreted as simulator-conditional causal estimates whose policy relevance depends on simulator fidelity. Establishing this framework now is essential: it helps define what adequate fidelity means and moves the field from simulations that look realistic toward simulations that can support policy changes.

### [37] [Embedding Enhancement via Fine-Tuned Language Models for Learner-Item Cognitive Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04088)
*Yuanhao Liu,Zihan Zhou,Kaiying Wu,Shuo Liu,Yiyang Huang,Jiajun Guo,Aimin Zhou,Hong Qian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Learner-item cognitive modeling plays a central role in the web-based online intelligent education system by enabling cognitive diagnosis (CD) across diverse online educational scenarios. Although ID embedding remains the mainstream approach in cognitive modeling due to its effectiveness and flexibility, recent advances in language models (LMs) have introduced new possibilities for incorporating rich semantic representations to enhance CD performance. This highlights the need for a comprehensive analysis of how LMs enhance embeddings through semantic integration across mainstream CD tasks. This paper identifies two key challenges in fully leveraging LMs in existing work: Misalignment between the training objectives of LMs and CD models creates a distribution gap in feature spaces; A unified framework is essential for integrating textual embeddings across varied CD tasks while preserving the strengths of existing cognitive modeling paradigms to ensure the robustness of embedding enhancement. To address these challenges, this paper introduces EduEmbed, a unified embedding enhancement framework that leverages fine-tuned LMs to enrich learner-item cognitive modeling across diverse CD tasks. EduEmbed operates in two stages. In the first stage, we fine-tune LMs based on role-specific representations and an interaction diagnoser to bridge the semantic gap of CD models. In the second stage, we employ a textual adapter to extract task-relevant semantics and integrate them with existing modeling paradigms to improve generalization. We evaluate the proposed framework on four CD tasks and computerized adaptive testing (CAT) task, achieving robust performance. Further analysis reveals the impact of semantic information across diverse tasks, offering key insights for future research on the application of LMs in CD for online intelligent education systems.

### [38] [Uncertainty as a Planning Signal: Multi-Turn Decision Making for Goal-Oriented Conversation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03924)
*Xinyi Ling,Ye Liu,Reza Averly,Xia Ning*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Goal-oriented conversational systems require making sequential decisions under uncertainty about the user's intent, where the algorithm must balance information acquisition and target commitment over multiple turns. Existing approaches address this challenge from different perspectives: structured methods enable multi-step planning but rely on predefined schemas, while LLM-based approaches support flexible interactions but lack long-horizon decision making, resulting in poor coordination between information acquisition and target commitment. To address this limitation, we formulate goal-oriented conversation as an uncertainty-aware sequential decision problem, where uncertainty serves as a guiding signal for multi-turn decision making. We propose a Conversation Uncertainty-aware Planning framework (CUP) that integrates language models with structured planning: a language model proposes feasible actions, and a planner evaluates their long-term impact on uncertainty reduction. Experiments on multiple conversational benchmarks show that CUP consistently improves success rates while requiring fewer interaction turns. Further analysis demonstrates that uncertainty-aware planning contributes to more efficient information acquisition and earlier confident commitment.

### [39] [AdaptFuse: Training-Free Sequential Preference Learning via Externalized Bayesian Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03925)
*Fangzhou Lin,Peiran Li,Shuo Xing,Siyuan Yang,Qianwen Ge,Kazunori Yamada,Ziming Zhang,Haichong Zhang,Zhengzhong Tu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Large language models struggle to accumulate evidence across multiple rounds of user interaction, failing to update their beliefs in a manner consistent with Bayesian inference. Existing solutions require fine-tuning on sensitive user interaction data, limiting their applicability in privacy-conscious settings. We propose AdaptFuse, a training-free framework that externalizes probabilistic computation entirely from the LLM: a symbolic module maintains a Bayesian posterior over a discrete hypothesis set, while a frozen LLM contributes semantic reasoning via multi-sample Dirichlet aggregation. The two signals are combined through entropy-adaptive fusion, which automatically weights each source by its predictive confidence, shifting reliance from the LLM to the symbolic posterior as evidence accumulates. We evaluate across three domains: flight recommendation, hotel recommendation, and web shopping; on Gemma 2 9B, Llama 3 8B, and Qwen 2.5 7B. AdaptFuse consistently outperforms both prompting baselines and fine-tuned Bayesian Teaching models on all tasks, with accuracy improving monotonically over interaction rounds. These results demonstrate that principled inference-time algorithms can substitute for fine-tuning in personalized recommendation, without storing or training on sensitive user data. All the code and materials will be open-sourced.

### [40] [Which English Do LLMs Prefer? Triangulating Structural Bias Towards American English in Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04204)
*Mir Tafseer Nayeem,Davood Rafiei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains, yet they expose only limited language settings, most notably "English (US)," despite the global diversity and colonial history of English. Through a postcolonial framing to explain the broader significance, we investigate how geopolitical histories of data curation, digital dominance, and linguistic standardization shape the LLM development pipeline. Focusing on two dominant standard varieties, American English (AmE) and British English (BrE), we construct a curated corpus of 1,813 AmE--BrE variants and introduce DiAlign, a dynamic, training-free method for estimating dialectal alignment using distributional evidence. We operationalize structural bias by triangulating evidence across three stages: (i) audits of six major pretraining corpora reveal systematic skew toward AmE, (ii) tokenizer analyses show that BrE forms incur higher segmentation costs, and (iii) generative evaluations show a persistent AmE preference in model outputs. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic and multi-faceted examination of dialectal asymmetries in standard English varieties across the phases of LLM development. We find that contemporary LLMs privilege AmE as the de facto norm, raising concerns about linguistic homogenization, epistemic injustice, and inequity in global AI deployment, while motivating practical steps toward more dialectally inclusive language technologies.
