### [89] [Emergent Compositional Communication for Latent World Properties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03266)
*Tomek Kaszyński*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 多智能体通信通过Gumbel-Softmax瓶颈和迭代学习，可从冻结视频特征中提取物理属性的离散组合表征，在无监督情况下实现近完美的位置解耦（PosDis=0.999）和组合性，在真实视频上验证了85.6%的质量比较准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索多智能体通信是否能够从冻结视频特征中提取不可见物理属性（弹性、摩擦、质量比）的离散组合表征，实现无监督的物理属性提取和通信协议学习。

Method: 使用Gumbel-Softmax瓶颈约束的多智能体通信框架，结合迭代学习（iterated learning）机制，使4个智能体通过无监督方式学习位置解耦的通信协议。控制实验排除了带宽和时间覆盖的干扰。因果干预实验验证单个属性的独立影响。对比DINOv2和V-JEPA 2两种视觉backbone在空间可视物理和动力学物理上的表现差异。

Result: 80个种子100%收敛到近完美组合性（PosDis=0.999，保留集98.3%）。因果干预显示目标属性约15%下降，非目标属性<3%。DINOv2在空间可视 ramp 物理上优于V-JEPA 2（98.3% vs 95.1%），V-JEPA 2在纯动力学碰撞物理上显著领先（87.4% vs 77.7%，d=2.74）。视频原生预训练是性能差异的根本原因（尺度匹配d=3.37，帧匹配d=6.53）。支持91.5%动作条件规划和反事实速度推理（r=0.780）。Physics 101真实视频验证：85.6%质量比较准确率，时间动力学贡献+11.2%，智能体缩放组合性达90%，因果干预扩展到真实视频（d=1.87, p=0.022）。

Conclusion: 多智能体结构和视频原生预训练是关键驱动力，而非带宽或时间覆盖。感知先验决定可通信内容：DINOv2擅长空间可视属性，V-JEPA 2擅长纯动态属性。该方法成功实现从冻结视频特征中无监督提取物理属性的组合式、表征学习。框架支持下游规划和反事实推理任务。

Abstract: Can multi-agent communication pressure extract discrete, compositional representations of invisible physical properties from frozen video features? We show that agents communicating through a Gumbel-Softmax bottleneck with iterated learning develop positionally disentangled protocols for latent properties (elasticity, friction, mass ratio) without property labels or supervision on message structure. With 4 agents, 100% of 80 seeds converge to near-perfect compositionality (PosDis=0.999, holdout 98.3%). Controls confirm multi-agent structure -- not bandwidth or temporal coverage -- drives this effect. Causal intervention shows surgical property disruption (~15% drop on targeted property, <3% on others). A controlled backbone comparison reveals that the perceptual prior determines what is communicable: DINOv2 dominates on spatially-visible ramp physics (98.3% vs 95.1%), while V-JEPA 2 dominates on dynamics-only collision physics (87.4% vs 77.7%, d=2.74). Scale-matched (d=3.37) and frame-matched (d=6.53) controls attribute this gap entirely to video-native pretraining. The frozen protocol supports action-conditioned planning (91.5%) with counterfactual velocity reasoning (r=0.780). Validation on Physics 101 real camera footage confirms 85.6% mass-comparison accuracy on unseen objects, temporal dynamics contributing +11.2% beyond static appearance, agent-scaling compositionality replicating at 90% for 4 agents, and causal intervention extending to real video (d=1.87, p=0.022).

</details>


### [90] [Multi-Agent Training-free Urban Food Delivery System using Resilient UMST Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03280)
*Md Nahid Hasan,Vishwam Tiwari,Aditya Challa,Vaskar Raychoudhury,Snehanshu Saha*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出「最小生成树并集」（UMST）网络，用于城市在线餐饮配送的多智能体路径规划。通过对完全图随机删边并多次计算MST后取并集，UMST以O(k|H|)的稀疏边数（比完全图少20–40倍）提供多路径冗余，配合贪心机会式订单捆绑，在俄亥俄州哥伦布与芝加哥两城市仿真中取得88–96%成功率、44–53%车辆行驶距离节省（最高节约2.2万公里），同时零训练开销、相比MADDPG/GNN/注意力MADDPG基线快30–280倍，并保持可解释的路由结构。作者论证：在动态城市配送中，精心设计的稀疏冗余图结构可在多数指标上匹敌甚至超越复杂学习系统，是可扩展、有韧性的免训练配送网络基座。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线餐饮配送（OFD）已成为城市基础设施，2030年全球市场规模预计超5050亿美元，但现有配送网络在拓扑结构上存在两难困境：一方面，完全连通图能提供最大路由灵活性，但需要 O(|H|²) 条边，城市级规模（数百个热点）下计算上不可行，且单条最短路虽短却无法为多订单共乘提供替代路径；另一方面，单棵最小生成树（MST）虽高效稀疏，但几乎无冗余，一条边失效即可能割裂关键区域并造成长距离绕行。同时，真实城市需求高度非均匀（商圈午间峰值、社区晚间峰值），路网封闭、事故、天气会突然改变，进一步加剧脆弱性。强化学习类方法（如 DeliverAI 的 MARL）虽已引入多跳路径共享，但仍依赖集中式 critic 与完全图，且仅支持成对捆绑交互，需求或路况一变就需重新训练；GNN 类方法依赖大量训练数据、跨城市泛化差、计算开销高，且作为黑箱模型无法给出连通性与抗边失效的结构性保证。因此需要一个既稀疏又鲁棒、可在无训练前提下即时适应网络变化的多智能体配送网络结构。

Method: 整体框架分四阶段：数据获取与预处理（OpenStreetMap 提取路网与生产者/消费者点位、普查区（census tract）划分城市、GraphHopper 获取真实路网距离与行程时间）、空间分解与热点识别（每个普查区以其生产者/消费者点位质心为一个热点节点）、完全加权图构建（所有热点两两连边，权重为路网最短路距离/时间）、UMST 生成。UMST 构造算法（Algorithm 1）为随机删边扰动：在 G=(H,E) 上迭代 K 次，每次随机删除比例 ρ 的边后计算 MST 并把该树边并入累积集合 E_UMST，最终返回稀疏图 G_UMST=(H,E_UMST)，边数 O(k|H|)；超参取 K∈{10,20,40,100}、ρ∈{0.1,0.2,0.5,0.7}。理论依据：O(log|E|) 次采样即可良好逼近稠密图，且「stretch」（最短路近似误差）随 K 以 exp(−cK) 指数衰减。边按在 MST 集合中出现频率分层：≥80% 为高频骨干、40–80% 为次级替代、<40% 为兜底链路。形式化定义基于 UMST 图 G'=(H,E') 的多智能体配送模型：车辆集合 𝒱 各有容量 C(k)，请求 r=(p_r,d_r,τ_p,τ_d)，可行性要求取货不早于 τ_p、送达不晚于 τ_d；UMST 为任意两点对定义唯一 next-hop 方向。调度采用热点级贪心局部派发：在热点 h 处所有 next(h)=v 的活跃请求构成候选捆绑 B(h,v)，车辆可载其任一不超过容量的子集，实现无需绕行的「机会式捆绑」；并支持「捆绑合并」B_out = B_in ∪ B(h,v)，|B_out| ≤ C(k)。约束包括指派唯一性、取货先于送达的先后关系、容量约束、路径仅限 E'（R_k ⊆ E'）。目标为最大化成功交付数 |S| 的同时最小化车队总行程时间 T = Σ_k T(R_k)。仿真环境：1 小时窗口、9234 条请求（哥伦布）/11550 条（哥伦布 bundling 场景），到达过程为双峰高斯混合（峰值在 0.25 与 0.75 窗口处，σ=10），单次配送最长 1800 秒，使用 rangewise 缓冲时间；对比基线包括完全图（Clique）、单棵 MST、MADDPG、GNN（均置于 UMST 骨干之上）以及注意力增强 MADDPG。

Result: 结构层面：哥伦布市中心 26 个普查区 → 26 热点 → 完全图 325 条边；按 50% 删边率生成 20 棵 MST 取并集得 90 条边，密度仅为完全图的 28%（约缩减 72%），总体比完全图少 20–40 倍边数；频率分析显示无论采用距离、时间或可靠性加权，关键边均稳定存在，说明 UMST 捕获了城市级稳定路由结构。图表对比（芝加哥）：MST 成功率最高（≈0.99）但完成时间最长（>800 s），Clique 完成时间最低（≈440 s）但成功率仅 ≈0.78，UMST 位于其间形成清晰权衡曲线，其中 umst_m20_d50 最佳（约 0.92 成功率、480 s 完成时间），经成本/可靠性指标归一化后的 Nash 权衡解（NBS）为最优平衡点。表 1（10 次运行均值±标准差，每场景 9234 单）：芝加哥 UMST 成功率 88.07%、平均时间 500.37 s、车辆距离 13480 km、打包距离 22953 km、节约 10427 km、捆绑参与 7690；MST 成功率 98.78% 但时间 810 s、距离节省 23401 km；Clique 成功率仅 73.82%。哥伦布 UMST 成功率 96.05%（显著优于 Clique 的 82.07%）、时间 642.72 s（快于 MST 的 944.78 s）、车辆距离 26827 km、捆绑参与 7670；MST 成功率 99.55%、节省 396 km。表 2（bundling 对比）：芝加哥捆绑使成功率由 100% 降至 96.08%、平均时间由 591.97 s 增至 641.13 s（+8.3%），车辆距离由 48942 km 降至 27147 km（−44.5%），平均延迟仍为 −312 s；哥伦布成功率 97.72%→92.53%、时间 578.43→653.43 s（+13.0%）、车辆距离 27492→12917 km（−53.0%）、平均延迟 −175 s；捆绑率分别为 82.89%（7654 单合入 7555 捆）与 74.65%（8621 单合入 6909 捆）。经济性：以每日 1 万单计，可少行驶 2–2.5 万公里，日省燃油与维护约 1–2.5 万美元，年化数百万美元并等比例减少排放。表 3（与学习基线对比，均基于 UMST 骨干）：MADDPG 训练需 277–293 min，GNN 需 29–34 min，UMST 为 0 min（30×–280× 部署就绪优势）；成功率 UMST 哥伦布 0.960、芝加哥 0.944，MADDPG 分别为 0.918/0.947，GNN 达 1.0/1.0；平均时间 UMST 635 s（哥伦布）/468 s（芝加哥），显著优于 GNN 的 2859 s/1356 s（慢 4–6 倍）并优于 MADDPG 的 903 s/768 s；距离节省率 UMST 43.5%/41.2%，GNN 最高 58.9%/56.9%（但仅生成 1094/1079 捆、延迟接近 0），MADDPG 仅 11.1%/11.0%；UMST 生成 5120/5175 捆提供更细粒度路由灵活性，且保持负平均延迟（−311/−254 s）。表 4（注意力 MADDPG）：注意力机制把 MADDPG 成功率由 0.918 提升至 0.972（哥伦布）、0.947→0.986（芝加哥），但训练时间从 293 min 增至 983 min、1108 min（约 3 倍），距离节省仍仅 1947/1487 km，远低于 UMST 的 20754/9479 km。

Conclusion: 论文主张：经过精心设计的图结构可以取得许多原本被认为必须依赖复杂学习系统才能获得的收益，同时规避其训练开销、黑箱性、跨域泛化差与再适应延迟。其核心洞见是「配送系统需要既高效又不脆弱」——通过稀疏性与冗余度的显式权衡（UMST），在保持 MST 级低成本特性的同时引入足以支撑可靠路由与订单捆绑的结构多样性，使得网络在常态下高效运行、在路网封闭/拥堵/需求漂移等扰动下仍能工作。UMST 的确定性构造带来可解释路由，便于调试、分析与人工监督；其可通过快速图重建即时响应道路封闭与需求变化，天然具备韧性。特别适合时效敏感、资源受限、需要快速部署与可预测性能的真实运营场景。局限与未来工作：当前实现使用均匀（uniform）扰动策略生成树、采用热点级贪心捆绑决策；未来可引入空间自适应扰动与时变边权以刻画交通动态，并扩展到异质车队、集成轻量在线学习以应对高波动需求。作者定位于「多智能体免训练城市配送系统的可扩展、有韧性、可解释网络基座」。

Abstract: Delivery systems have become a core part of urban life, supporting the demand for food, medicine, and other goods. Yet traditional logistics networks remain fragile, often struggling to adapt to road closures, accidents, and shifting demand. Online Food Delivery (OFD) platforms now represent a cornerstone of urban logistics, with the global market projected to grow to over 500 billion USD by 2030. Designing delivery networks that are efficient and resilient remains a major challenge: fully connected graphs provide flexibility but are computationally infeasible at scale, while single Minimum Spanning Trees (MSTs) are efficient but easily disrupted.
  We propose the Union of Minimum Spanning Trees (UMST) approach to construct delivery networks that are sparse yet robust. UMST generates multiple MSTs through randomized edge perturbations and unites them, producing graphs with far fewer edges than fully connected networks while maintaining multiple alternative routes between delivery hotspots. Across multiple U.S. cities, UMST achieves 20--40$\times$ fewer edges than fully connected graphs while enabling substantial order bundling with 75--83% participation rates. Compared to learning-based baselines including MADDPG and Graph Neural Networks, UMST delivers competitive performance (88-96% success rates, 44-53% distance savings) without requiring training, achieving 30$\times$ faster execution while maintaining interpretable routing structures. Its combination of structural efficiency and operational flexibility offers a scalable and resilient foundation for urban delivery networks.

</details>


### [91] [Scaling Teams or Scaling Time? Memory Enabled Lifelong Learning in LLM Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03295)
*Shanglin Wu,Yuyang Luo,Yueqing Liang,Kaiwen Shi,Yanfang Ye,Ali Payani,Kai Shu*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出LLMA-Mem，一个支持灵活记忆拓扑的LLM多智能体终身记忆框架，在MultiAgentBench上验证其在长期任务中一致优于基线且降低成本。核心发现：团队规模与长期性能呈非单调关系，良好的记忆设计可使小团队超越大团队，凸显了记忆设计作为多智能体系统高效扩展路径的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前研究分别探讨了多智能体系统的两条扩展路径（增加智能体数量和积累经验），但缺乏对两者在现实成本约束下交互作用的理解。

Method: 提出LLMA-Mem终身记忆框架，支持灵活的记忆拓扑设计；在MultiAgentBench的编码、研究和数据库三类环境中进行评估。

Result: LLMA-Mem在长期任务中一致优于基线方法，同时降低计算成本。

Conclusion: 团队规模与长期性能呈非单调关系；较小的团队在记忆设计优化的情况下可以超越较大的团队；记忆设计是实现多智能体系统更有效、更高效扩展的实用路径。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) multi-agent systems can scale along two distinct dimensions: by increasing the number of agents and by improving through accumulated experience over time. Although prior work has studied these dimensions separately, their interaction under realistic cost constraints remains unclear. In this paper, we introduce a conceptual scaling view of multi-agent systems that jointly considers team size and lifelong learning ability, and we study how memory design shares this landscape. To this end, we propose \textbf{LLMA-Mem}, a lifelong memory framework for LLM multi-agent systems under flexible memory topologies. We evaluate LLMA-Mem on \textsc{MultiAgentBench} across coding, research, and database environments. Empirically, LLMA-Mem consistently improves long-horizon performance over baselines while reducing cost. Our analysis further reveals a non-monotonic scaling landscape: larger teams do not always produce better long-term performance, and smaller teams can outperform larger ones when memory better supports the reuse of experience. These findings position memory design as a practical path for scaling multi-agent systems more effectively and more efficiently over time.

</details>


### [92] [Scaling Multi-agent Systems: A Smart Middleware for Improving Agent Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03430)
*Charles Fleming,Ramana Kompella,Peter Bosch,Vijoy Pandey*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出Cognitive Fabric Nodes (CFN)——一种新型中间件层，通过将Memory提升为活跃功能基质，并结合Topology Selection、Semantic Grounding、Security Policy Enforcement和Prompt Transformation四项能力，实现LLM多智能体系统间的智能通信协调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM多智能体系统存在四大局限：上下文碎片化、随机性幻觉、安全边界僵化、拓扑管理低效。传统消息队列或服务网格仅作为被动传输机制，无法满足复杂生态系统需求。

Method: CFN作为主动智能中介拦截并重写智能体间通信。核心创新在于将Memory从存储单元升级为功能基质，驱动五项协同能力：Memory、Topology Selection、Semantic Grounding、Security Policy Enforcement、Prompt Transformation。各功能模块采用强化学习(RL)和优化算法实现动态性能调优。

Result: 在HotPotQA和MuSiQue多智能体环境下，CFN相比直接通信提升性能超过10%。

Conclusion: CFN使个体智能体保持轻量化，同时确保生态系统具备一致性、安全性和语义对齐能力。

Abstract: As Large Language Model (LLM) based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) evolve from experimental pilots to complex, persistent ecosystems, the limitations of direct agent-to-agent communication have become increasingly apparent. Current architectures suffer from fragmented context, stochastic hallucinations, rigid security boundaries, and inefficient topology management. This paper introduces Cognitive Fabric Nodes (CFN), a novel middleware layer that creates an omnipresent "Cognitive Fabric" between agents. Unlike traditional message queues or service meshes, CFNs are not merely pass-through mechanisms; they are active, intelligent intermediaries.
  Central to this architecture is the elevation of Memory from simple storage to an active functional substrate that informs four other critical capabilities: Topology Selection, Semantic Grounding, Security Policy Enforcement, and Prompt Transformation. We propose that each of these functions be governed by learning modules utilizing Reinforcement Learning (RL) and optimization algorithms to improve system performance dynamically. By intercepting, analyzing, and rewriting inter-agent communication, the Cognitive Fabric ensures that individual agents remain lightweight while the ecosystem achieves coherence, safety, and semantic alignment.
  We evaluate the effectiveness of the CFN on the HotPotQA and MuSiQue datasets in a multi-agent environment and demonstrate that the CFN improves performance by more than 10\% on both datasets over direct agent to agent communication.

</details>


### [93] [When AI Agents Disagree Like Humans: Reasoning Trace Analysis for Human-AI Collaborative Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03796)
*Michał Wawer,Jarosław A. Chudziak*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 论文提出在LLM多智能体系统中，分歧可以被视为有价值的信号而非需要消除的噪音。研究聚焦仇恨言论审核领域，使用包含推理痕迹的五个视角差异化智能体，通过基于推理相似性和结论一致性的四类 Taxonomy 对分歧进行分类，发现智能体是否达成一致裁决这一结构化特征比推理发散程度更能预测人类标注者之间的冲突（效应量大，d>0.8）。研究结论支持从"寻求共识"向"暴露不确定性"的智能体设计范式转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统多智能体系统中，分歧被视为需要通过共识机制消除的噪音。然而在仇恨言论审核这类依赖文化语境和个人价值判断的任务中，人类标注者本身也存在高度合法分歧。作者假设：若智能体推理过程相似但结论不同（收敛性分歧），则表明存在真实的价值多元性——这正是人类也难以裁决的问题。这一视角挑战了当前追求共识的多智能体设计范式。

Method: 研究使用Measuring Hate Speech语料库，嵌入五个视角差异化智能体的推理痕迹，依据推理相似性（相似/不同）和结论一致性（一致/不一致）构建四类分歧分类法，对智能体分歧模式进行分类和分析。

Result: 推理发散程度对人类标注者冲突的预测能力较弱，但智能体分歧的结构特征具有额外预测力：智能体对裁决达成一致时，人类分歧明显低于未达成一致时，效应量大（d>0.8），经多重比较校正后仍显著。Taxonomy分类与人类分歧模式呈现相关性。

Conclusion: 多智能体系统设计应从"共识寻求"转向"不确定性暴露"，分歧的结构特征（而非程度）应指导何时需要人类介入判断。

Abstract: When LLM-based multi-agent systems disagree, current practice treats this as noise to be resolved through consensus. We propose it can be signal. We focus on hate speech moderation, a domain where judgments depend on cultural context and individual value weightings, producing high legitimate disagreement among human annotators. We hypothesize that convergent disagreement, where agents reason similarly but conclude differently, indicates genuine value pluralism that humans also struggle to resolve. Using the Measuring Hate Speech corpus, we embed reasoning traces from five perspective-differentiated agents and classify disagreement patterns using a four-category taxonomy based on reasoning similarity and conclusion agreement. We find that raw reasoning divergence weakly predicts human annotator conflict, but the structure of agent discord carries additional signal: cases where agents agree on a verdict show markedly lower human disagreement than cases where they do not, with large effect sizes (d>0.8) surviving correction for multiple comparisons. Our taxonomy-based ordering correlates with human disagreement patterns. These preliminary findings motivate a shift from consensus-seeking to uncertainty-surfacing multi-agent design, where disagreement structure - not magnitude - guides when human judgment is needed.

</details>


### [94] [Investigating the Impact of Subgraph Social Structure Preference on the Strategic Behavior of Networked Mixed-Motive Learning Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03818)
*Xinqi Gao,Mario Ventresca*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出"社会关系内在动机"（SRIM）模型，让网络化混合动机学习智能体对子图社会结构（度数邻居、团邻居、关键连接邻居）持有异质偏好，从而在时序社会困境（Harvest 与 Cleanup）中产生可区分的战略行为。作者新提出"桥接能力指数"（BCI）度量，将 Burt 约束与个体环境奖励耦合，量化"谁在何种结构位置获取了资源"。结果显示不同子图偏好导致显著不同的个体侵略性（Harvest）、公共品贡献努力（Cleanup）与资源分配轨迹；同一拓扑下 BCI 的相对排序（NN < CN < HBN）在两个环境中一致，说明子图结构效应跨环境稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合动机博弈（mixed-motive）在两人博弈中占比高达 80.6%，引出集体行动问题（CAP）。序列社会困境（SSD）下的 MARL 研究（好奇心、不平等厌恶、利他性、反事实因果影响、自利程度奖励整形等）虽能重塑奖励，但均假设智能体同质、缺乏复杂社会结构，无法刻画人口异质性与关系/空间拓扑约束下的群体互动动态。既有以网络为关系结构的工作（RSRN、graphical dilemmas 等）要么只研究合作设定，要么规模很小（2–5 智能体），从未在混合动机域系统考察不同子图结构（团、关键连接、结构洞）的作用。作者因此提出研究问题：智能体对子图社会结构的偏好是否会在 SSD 收敛后产生反复出现的结构性战略模式，并由此带来竞争与联盟的群体间动态。

Method: 形式化：将 SSD 马尔可夫博弈扩展为 N 玩家"社会关系网络化 POMG"（含无向图 G=(V,E)、邻居集 N_G(i)）；定义"偏好邻居组合"（preferred neighborhood portfolio）——最近邻 N_G(i)、团邻居 N_G^clique(i)（同属 size-3 团）、关键连接邻居 N_G^hbn(i)（位于通往最高介数中心节点的短路径上，满足 d(i,j)=d(i,m)+d(m,j)），并以权重 θ=(α,β,ω) 表示个体对三类子图结构的偏好（one-hot / 混合 / 动态调度）。SRIM 将智能体对偏好邻居的环境奖励加权求和作为内在社会关系影响奖励，与环境外在奖励相加，形成子图结构依赖的奖励整形（outcome transformation）。度量体系：①结构层——新提出 BCI = Σ_i(1−C_i)R_env^i / Σ_i R_env^i，其中 C_i 为 Burt 约束、1−C_i 表征节点的桥接/结构洞跨越能力，BCI 为奖励加权的桥接能力均值，并给出拓扑约束理论区间 (TCTR)；②个体层——基础奖励、个体侵略性（FIRE 次数）、公共品贡献努力（CLEAN 次数）与有界指标 Social Contribution Index (SCI)。实验：Harvest（8 动作、FIRE 惩罚 -1、被击中 -50）与 Cleanup 基准；PPO + 卷积编码器 + LSTM Actor-Critic(128)、γ=0.99、Ray RLlib、每 trial 20 并行环境；5 智能体的 Complete/Wheel/House/Bipartite/Symmetric/Star/Cycle 及定制 A1(N=9)、A2(N=7)、SBM(N=20) 共 10 种拓扑，1×10^8 步、5 随机种子；采用 Bonferroni 校正的 t 检验做偏好间两两比较；并用 PBT 做动态权重调度（DWT）鲁棒性验证与人口规模（5→9→20）、密度保持的地图缩放实验。

Result: 1) BCI 与偏好：不同偏好产生显著不同的 BCI（Star 拓扑 Harvest：NN 95%CI [0.0149,0.0345]、CN [0.1409,0.1587]、HBN [0.2631,0.3114]，两两 p_adj 均 <0.05）；Star、A1、A2、SBM(20) 在 Harvest/Cleanup 下均显著，House 下 NN vs HBN（Harvest, p=0.0643）及 CN vs HBN（Cleanup, p=1）不显著。同一拓扑下 BCI 排序 NN<CN<HBN 在 Harvest 与 Cleanup 中一致，且 HBN/团偏好下经纪人（broker）获得最多资源，而传统最近邻偏好下连接最多的节点被剥削最多。2) 个体基奖励：偏好最近邻时最高度数中心性且最利他的智能体获得最低资源，模式在 House/Bipartite/Symmetric/Star 及 A1/A2、5 个种子上稳健；Wheel 因照顾邻居集合高度重叠而变异更大、趋于随机。3) 个体侵略性（Harvest）：团偏好下联盟内智能体在探索期最快降低侵略性，联盟外智能体持续更高侵略性（House 20.25、A2 23.17、A1 22.25），联盟内出现 3×（2×–5×）的"利他性惩罚"型高侵略个体；关键连接偏好下处于策略位置的 broker（Wheel/Star 的 Agent 0、A2 的 Agent 2/4）侵略性最低（收敛期均值 1.6、3.43、2.13、1.62）。4) 个体贡献努力（Cleanup）：团偏好下联盟内智能体 SCI≈0.98–0.999（近乎纯清洁者），联盟外≈0.007–0.166（近乎纯采集者），Star 无团结构则角色随机（SCI≈0.67）；关键连接偏好下最高介数智能体 SCI≈0.0075–0.0322，表现为纯粹的利己采集者。5) 鲁棒性：动态权重调度（DWT）在 House 拓扑取得平均功利指标 150.549（SD 3.799），显著优于单一偏好（NN ≈112、CN ≈65、HBN ≈81，p_adj<0.0003）；SBM(N=20) 在密度受控下偏好间 BCI 与功利指标仍显著差异，轨迹模式与 N=5–9 一致。

Conclusion: 子图结构约束确实产生区别性的"结构驱动行为"：偏好组合的变化导致一致且可区分的资源获取模式与个体战略行为位移（Harvest 的侵略性、Cleanup 的贡献努力），验证了研究假设，且该效应在 Harvest 与 Cleanup 两个不同 SSD 下表现出环境不变性（BCI 相对排序一致）与规模鲁棒性（人口 5–20、密度保持地图）。BCI 将网络结构洞/经纪能力与实际奖励分配耦合，是适用于任何带个体奖励的网络化 MARL 的群体级指标。研究的贡献在于首次将图博弈、子图社会学与奖励整形 MARL 结合，提供了结构与行为可解释性，并表明动态/混合权重调度能提升集体社会福利（虽非本文主要目标），为设计由异质社会偏好智能体组成的多智能体生态提供了新视角与基础。局限与展望：实验集中于同质偏好场景（异质组合主要在 DWT 中探索）、以环境层奖励整形实现、拓扑数量有限，作者指出动态权重、团队选择与社会福利优化值得后续研究。

Abstract: Limited work has examined the strategic behaviors of relational networked learning agents under social dilemmas, and has overlooked the intricate social dynamics of complex systems. We address the challenge with Socio-Relational Intrinsic Motivation (SRIM), which endows agents with diverse preferences over sub-graphical social structures in order to study the impact of agents' personal preferences over their sub-graphical relations on their strategic decision-making under sequential social dilemmas. Our results in the Harvest and Cleanup environments demonstrate that preferences over different subgraph structures (degree-, clique-, and critical connection-based) lead to distinct variations in agents' reward gathering and strategic behavior: individual aggressiveness in Harvest and individual contribution effort in Cleanup. Moreover, agents with different subgraphical structural positions consistently exhibit similar strategic behavioral shifts. Our proposed BCI metric captures structural variation within the population, and the relative ordering of BCI across social preferences is consistent in Harvest and Cleanup games for the same topology, suggesting the subgraphical structural impact is robust across environments. These results provide a new lens for examining agents' behavior in social dilemmas and insight for designing effective multi-agent ecosystems composed of heterogeneous social agents.

</details>


### [95] [Symbolic-Vector Attention Fusion for Collective Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03955)
*Hongwei Xu*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出 Symbolic-Vector Attention Fusion (SVAF)，一种用于多智能体集体智能的两级耦合引擎的内容评估组件。SVAF 将智能体间信号分解为7个语义字段，通过学习到的融合门评估各字段，生成跨域知识融合。实验在237K样本、273个叙事场景上达到78.7%三类分类准确率，并在7节点异构平台（macOS/iOS/web）上完成实时部署验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机制无法让接收方评估哪些信号维度值得关注。当自主智能体观察共享环境时，它们交换的信号混合了相关和不相关维度。现有方法缺乏选择性机制来处理这种信息过载问题。

Method: SVAF 将每个智能体间信号分解为7种类型化语义字段，通过学习到的融合门独立评估每个字段，生成"混音"（remix）——来自两个域交叉的新知识。采用带通模型产生四种结果：冗余、对齐、守卫、拒绝，解决选择性和冗余问题。融合门独立发现跨域相关性层级：情绪字段在epoch 1即成为最高权重字段。

Result: 在237K样本、273个叙事场景训练后，SVAF达到78.7%三类分类准确率。情绪作为最高权重字段的发现与独立机制证据一致——LLM情绪表示沿效价-唤醒轴结构嵌入。完整网格认知循环在7节点异构平台上实时验证成功。

Conclusion: SVAF 成功解决了多智能体通信中的选择性信息吸收问题。情绪作为首要关注维度的发现表明，情感计算在跨域知识融合中具有核心地位。该工作为集体智能系统中内容评估与时序动力学的解耦设计提供了有效范式。

Abstract: When autonomous agents observe different domains of a shared environment, each signal they exchange mixes relevant and irrelevant dimensions. No existing mechanism lets the receiver evaluate which dimensions to absorb. We introduce Symbolic-Vector Attention Fusion (SVAF), the content-evaluation half of a two-level coupling engine for collective intelligence. SVAF decomposes each inter-agent signal into 7 typed semantic fields, evaluates each through a learned fusion gate, and produces a remix -- new knowledge from the intersection of two domains. A band-pass model yields four outcomes (redundant, aligned, guarded, rejected), solving both selectivity and redundancy. The fusion gate independently discovers a cross-domain relevance hierarchy: mood emerges as the highest-weight field by epoch 1, before accuracy plateaus -- consistent with independent mechanistic evidence that LLM emotion representations are structurally embedded along valence-arousal axes. SVAF forms Layer 4 of the Mesh Memory Protocol (MMP); the other half of the coupling engine is a per-agent Closed-form Continuous-time (CfC) neural network at Layer 6, whose learned per-neuron time constants (tau) create the temporal dynamics from which collective intelligence emerges: fast neurons synchronise affect across agents in seconds, while slow neurons preserve domain expertise indefinitely. SVAF determines what enters each agent's cognitive state; CfC determines how that state evolves. Trained on 237K samples from 273 narrative scenarios, SVAF achieves 78.7% three-class accuracy. We verify the complete mesh cognition loop -- from per-field evaluation through remix, CfC state evolution, tau-modulated peer blending, and autonomous action -- in a live deployment with 7 nodes across macOS, iOS, and web.

</details>


### [96] [Agentization of Digital Assets for the Agentic Web: Concepts, Techniques, and Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04226)
*Linyao Chen,Bo Huang,Qinlao Zhao,Shuai Shao,Zhi Han,Zicai Cui,Ziheng Zhang,Guangtao Zeng,Wenzheng Tang,Yikun Wang,Yuanjian Zhou,Zimian Peng,Yong Yu,Weiwen Liu,Hiroki Kobayashi,Weinan Zhang*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出A2A-Agentization框架，将数字资产自动转化为Agent以推动Agentic Web发展，并构建了首个评估Agent化质量的基准测试A2A-Agentization Bench。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic Web作为通过自主、目标驱动交互重新定义互联网的新范式，数字资产作为其基础语义原语至关重要。然而，缺乏自动化Agent生成方法限制了数字资产的广泛使用和Agentic Web的推进。

Method: 1) 形式化定义A2A-Agentization过程，将其分解为关键阶段并识别技术障碍；2) 在A2A协议基础上开发Agentization Agent；3) 提出A2A-Agentization Bench基准测试，从保真度和互操作性两个维度评估Agent化质量。

Result: 实验表明该方法能有效激活数字资产的功能能力，并实现可互操作的A2A多Agent协作。

Conclusion: 该工作将进一步促进数字资产向Agentic Web生态系统的可扩展、标准化集成。

Abstract: Agentic Web, as a new paradigm that redefines the internet through autonomous, goal-driven interactions, plays an important role in group intelligence. As the foundational semantic primitives of the Agentic Web, digital assets encapsulate interactive web elements into agents, which expand the capacities and coverage of agents in agentic web. The lack of automated methodologies for agent generation limits the wider usage of digital assets and the advancement of the Agentic Web. In this paper, we first formalize these challenges by strictly defining the A2A-Agentization process, decomposing it into critical stages and identifying key technical hurdles on top of the A2A protocol. Based on this framework, we develop an Agentization Agent to agentize digital assets for the Agentic Web. To rigorously evaluate this capability, we propose A2A-Agentization Bench, the first benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate agentization quality in terms of fidelity and interoperability. Our experiments demonstrate that our approach effectively activates the functional capabilities of digital assets and enables interoperable A2A multi-agent collaboration. We believe this work will further facilitate scalable and standardized integration of digital assets into the Agentic Web ecosystem.

</details>


### [97] [Agents for Agents: An Interrogator-Based Secure Framework for Autonomous Internet of Underwater Things](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04262)
*Ali Akarma,Toqeer Ali Syed,Abdul Khadar Jilani,Salman Jan,Hammad Muneer,Muazzam A. Khan,Changli Yu*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向"水下物联网"（IoUT）的 interrogator 架构，将行为信任监控嵌入水下多智能体自主运行：在不干预自主性的前提下，由特权 interrogator 模块被动分析通信元数据，利用轻量级 Transformer 计算动态信任分数，据此授权任务关键数据的转发；对可疑节点实施比例化监控与条件限制以实现快速遏制，同时用许可链（permissioned blockchain）联盟存储信任凭证，提供防篡改、去中心化的身份管理而无需公有共识开销。仿真结果显示，相对静态信任基线检测准确率提升 21.7%，且能耗开销有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IoUT 中的 AUV 与传感器节点已支持去中心化感知与协同，但现有部署在认证建立后普遍依赖静态信任，长时任务中一旦节点被攻陷或行为偏离（掉线、伪装、恶意转发、篡改数据），缺乏持续的动态信任评估与快速隔离机制。需要在不破坏多智能体自主性、适应水下高延迟高误码链路与严格能量预算的前提下，实现持续的行为级信任监控、任务关键数据的访问控制，以及可信、抗篡改的身份与信任证据管理。此外，公有链的共识开销在带宽/算力受限的水下环境中难以接受。

Method: 1) 架构：将特权 interrogator 模块嵌入水下多智能体网络，作为被动通信元数据分析器（不主动探测、不改变任务逻辑），仅旁路收集元数据特征，从而实现信任监控与自主性的解耦。2) 动态信任建模：以轻量级 Transformer 模型对节点的时序行为元数据（如通信时序、模式偏离度、交互结构特征）进行序列建模，输出连续动态信任分数，替代静态的"一次认证、终身可信"范式。3) 分级响应：将信任分数映射为授权决策，对任务关键数据的转发进行门控；对可疑智能体施加与可疑度成比例的监控强度与条件性限制（如降低转发权限、加大采样频率），实现渐进式遏制而非硬性断连，以保持网络连通性。4) 信任证据与身份管理：信任证据写入许可链联盟（无公有共识，成员准入受控、去中心化账本），提供不可篡改、可审计的信任状态与身份锚定。5) 验证：基于仿真（模拟水下拓扑、链路与节点行为，包括被攻陷/偏离节点）进行对比评估，以静态信任基线为参照衡量检测准确率与能耗开销。

Result: 仿真对比静态信任基线，检测准确率取得 21.7% 的相对提升；可疑节点的识别更快，且干预采取比例化监控与条件限制，使网络在遏制的同时保持连通性与任务连续性；引入轻量级 Transformer 与旁路元数据采集带来的额外能量与计算开销处于有限水平，符合水下平台的能量约束；许可链仅承担信任凭证存储与身份管理，不引入公有共识的时延与带宽代价。

Conclusion: 行为驱动（behavior-driven）的信任验证机制能够有效强化水下多智能体协同：把信任评估从静态认证转向持续动态监控，可显著提升对被攻陷或行为偏离智能体的检测能力；采用旁路 interrogator + 轻量级 Transformer + 许可链信任凭证的组合，可在不牺牲自主性、可扩展性与部署可行性的前提下提供快速遏制手段。文中亦表明该机制有望在不显著增加能耗的情况下为 IoUT 长时任务提供更具韧性的信任管理与身份治理基础。

Abstract: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) and sensor nodes increasingly support decentralized sensing and coordination in the Internet of Underwater Things (IoUT), yet most deployments rely on static trust once authentication is established, leaving long-duration missions vulnerable to compromised or behaviorally deviating agents. In this paper, an interrogator based structure is presented that incorporates the idea of behavioral trust monitoring into underwater multi-agent operation without interfering with autonomy. Privileged interrogator module is a passive communication metadata analyzer that uses a lightweight transformer model to calculate dynamic trust scores, which are used to authorize the forwarding of mission critical data. Suspicious agents cause proportional monitoring and conditional restrictions, which allow fast containment and maintain network continuity. The evidence of trust is stored in a permissioned blockchain consortium which offers identity management which is not tampered and is decentralized without causing the overhead of public consensus mechanisms. Simulation based analysis shows that the evaluation of the result compares to a relative improvement of 21.7% in the detection accuracy compared to the static trust baselines with limited energy overhead. These findings suggest that behavior driven validation has the capability of reinforcing underwater coordination without compromising scalability and deployment.

</details>


### [98] [Decentralized Ergodic Coverage Control in Unknown Time-Varying Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04280)
*Maria G. Mendoza,Victoria Marie Tuck,Chinmay Maheshwari,Shankar Sastry*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种去中心化多智能体覆盖框架，用于在部分可观测的未知时变环境中进行自适应覆盖控制。该框架通过高斯过程更新重要性地图的信念，并利用马尔可夫链转移模型实现自适应遍历策略，使智能体能够动态平衡探索与利用，应对灾难场景中的环境演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾难响应中的态势感知需要在探索未观测区域与持续监控感兴趣区域(ROI)之间取得平衡。现有方法假设重要性地图已知、需要集中协调或假设环境静态，难以应对现实灾难场景中有限感知、时变信息地图和动态演化的挑战。

Method: 提出去中心化多智能体覆盖框架，包含：(1)基于高斯过程的在线信念更新，用于追踪时变重要性地图；(2)马尔可夫链转移模型实现的适应性遍历策略，使智能体按估计重要性比例分配时间，同时保持足够探索以检测环境变化。

Result: 与替代覆盖策略相比，该框架在模拟灾难演化场景中展现出更好的适应性和瞬态性能，能够有效响应环境变化。

Conclusion: 该框架成功解决了未知时变分布与部分可观测环境下多智能体覆盖的联合挑战，在去中心化设置中实现了对动态场景的自适应响应。

Abstract: A key challenge in disaster response is maintaining situational awareness of an evolving landscape, which requires balancing exploration of unobserved regions with sustained monitoring of changing Regions of Interest (ROIs). Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have emerged as an effective response tool, particularly in applications like environmental monitoring and search-and-rescue, due to their ability to provide aerial coverage, withstand hazardous conditions, and navigate quickly and flexibly. However, efficient and adaptable multi-robot coverage with limited sensing in disaster settings and evolving time-varying information maps remains a significant challenge, necessitating better methods for UAVs to continuously adapt their trajectories in response to changes. In this paper, we propose a decentralized multi-agent coverage framework that serves as a high-level planning strategy for adaptive coverage in unknown, time-varying environments under partial observability. Each agent computes an adaptive ergodic policy, implemented via a Markov-chain transition model, that tracks a continuously updated belief over the underlying importance map. Gaussian Processes are used to perform those online belief updates. The resulting policy drives agents to spend time in ROIs proportional to their estimated importance, while preserving sufficient exploration to detect and adapt to time-varying environmental changes. Unlike existing approaches that assume known importance maps, require centralized coordination, or assume a static environment, our framework addresses the combined challenges of unknown, time-varying distributions in a more realistic decentralized and partially observable setting. We compare against alternative coverage strategies and analyze our method's response to simulated disaster evolution, highlighting its improved adaptability and transient performance in dynamic scenarios.

</details>


### [99] [Statistical Model Checking of the Island Model: An Established Economic Agent-Based Model of Endogenous Growth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04543)
*Stefano Blando,Giorgio Fagiolo,Daniele Giachini,Andrea Vandin,Ernest Ivanaj*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: Agent-based models (ABMs) are increasingly used to study complex economic phenomena such as endogenous growth, but their analysis typically relies on ad-hoc Monte Carlo exercises without formal statistical guarantees. We show how statistical model checking (SMC), and in particular Multi-VeStA, can automate and enrich the analysis of a seminal ABM: the Island Model of Fagiolo and Dosi, which captures the exploration-exploitation trade-off in technological search. We reproduce key stylized facts from the original model with formal confidence intervals, confirm the optimality of moderate exploration rates, and perform a counterfactual sensitivity analysis across returns to scale, skill transfer, and knowledge locality. Using MultiVeStA's built-in Welch's t-test, 6 out of 7 pairwise parameter comparisons yield statistically different growth trajectories, while the exception reveals a saturation effect in knowledge locality. Our results demonstrate that SMC offers a principled, reproducible methodology for the quantitative analysis of agent-based economic models.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Result: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Conclusion: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Abstract: Agent-based models (ABMs) are increasingly used to study complex economic phenomena such as endogenous growth, but their analysis typically relies on ad-hoc Monte Carlo exercises without formal statistical guarantees. We show how statistical model checking (SMC), and in particular Multi-VeStA, can automate and enrich the analysis of a seminal ABM: the Island Model of Fagiolo and Dosi, which captures the exploration-exploitation trade-off in technological search. We reproduce key stylized facts from the original model with formal confidence intervals, confirm the optimality of moderate exploration rates, and perform a counterfactual sensitivity analysis across returns to scale, skill transfer, and knowledge locality. Using MultiVeStA's built-in Welch's t-test, 6 out of 7 pairwise parameter comparisons yield statistically different growth trajectories, while the exception reveals a saturation effect in knowledge locality. ### [100] [Agentic Federated Learning: The Future of Distributed Training Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04895)
*Rafael O. Jarczewski,Gabriel U. Talasso,Leandro Villas,Allan M. de Souza*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: Agentic-FL通过引入基于大语言模型的智能体(Agent)来革新联邦学习范式,实现服务器端偏差缓解和客户端隐私预算动态管理,同时指出多智能体系统的可靠性与安全挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统联邦学习采用静态优化方法,无法适应客户端的随机异构性和系统动态变化,导致资源利用不足和系统性偏差。

Method: 提出Agentic-FL框架,部署基于语言模型的智能体:服务器端智能体通过情境推理缓解选择偏差;客户端智能体作为本地守护者,动态管理隐私预算并根据硬件约束调整模型复杂度。

Result: 证明了智能体驱动的自主编排可有效解决技术低效问题,推动FL向去中心化生态系统演进。

Conclusion: Agentic-FL为联邦学习开辟了新方向,支持自主协商协作、激励模型市场和算法公平,但需解决大模型幻觉问题和多智能体系统的安全挑战。

Abstract: Although Federated Learning (FL) promises privacy and distributed collaboration, its effectiveness in real-world scenarios is often hampered by the stochastic heterogeneity of clients and unpredictable system dynamics. Existing static optimization approaches fail to adapt to these fluctuations, resulting in resource underutilization and systemic bias. In this work, we propose a paradigm shift towards Agentic-FL, a framework where Language Model-based Agents (LMagents) assume autonomous orchestration roles. Unlike rigid protocols, we demonstrate how server-side agents can mitigate selection bias through contextual reasoning, while client-side agents act as local guardians, dynamically managing privacy budgets and adapting model complexity to hardware constraints. More than just resolving technical inefficiencies, this integration signals the evolution of FL towards decentralized ecosystems, where collaboration is negotiated autonomously, paving the way for future markets of incentive-based models and algorithmic justice. We discuss the reliability (hallucinations) and security challenges of this approach, outlining a roadmap for resilient multi-agent systems in federated environments.

</details>

### [101] [Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03412)
*Greg Bodwin,Luba Samborska*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文证明 n 节点有向图的 flow-cut gap 至多 Õ(n^{1/3})，这是自 Agarwal–Alon–Charikar (STOC'07) 的 Õ(n^{11/23}) 以来的首次改进，并把上下界差距缩小到 n^{1/7} (Chuzhoy–Khanna) 与 n^{1/3} 之间；同时给出按总分数割权重 W 参数化的 Õ(W^{1/2}) 上界，并证明边版本与点版本 flow-cut gap 近等价（n 相差 O(log n)、W 相差 O(1)），且在按 W 参数化时可无损假设单位代价与统一权重。证明为构造性随机多项式时间算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多对 (multi-pair) 的 MCMF 推广中，最小分数多割的容量等于最大多流值（LP 对偶），但最小整数多割可大得多，这一比值即 flow-cut gap。无向情形已被 Leighton–Rao 解决到 Θ(log n)；有向情形则不然：2007 年 Agarwal、Alon、Charikar 给出 Õ(n^{11/23}) 的上界，2009 年 Chuzhoy、Khanna 给出 Ω̃(n^{1/7}) 的下界，二者存在显著指数差距，二十年来在一般情形下该上界未被改进（仅在平面图、minor-free、有界树宽等特殊类有更好结果）。因此改进有向 flow-cut gap 的通用上界是长期开放的核心问题，且现有方法均基于“计算分数割再取整”的路线，需要新的分析技术。

Method: 证明路线：先做一系列归约把问题化简——(i) 点 flow-cut gap 的 W 参数化界 W^c 可推出 n 参数化界 n^{c/(1+c)}（Theorem 32 自归约：先切掉权重 ≥ n^{-c/(1+c)} 的高权点，再在剩余图上用 2w 递归）；(ii) 当按 W 参数化时，可无损化归到单位代价与统一权重（Theorem 28/29，通过顶点分裂与按平均权重复制顶点实现，节点数膨胀为 O(n)、O(n^2)）；(iii) 边版本与点版本互相归约（Theorem 30 用 2^{-i} 标号的双部图替换顶点把边割化为点割，Theorem 31 用 in/out 拆分把点割化为边割），于是只需证明顶点情形。核心引理 Lemma 9：n 节点有向图中，对所有点距离 ≥ L 的需求对，可在随机多项式时间内构造积分点割，|X| ≤ Õ((n/L)^{3/2})；参数限制 L ≥ n^{1/3}。主算法 Algorithm 2 (VertexCut) 是 Gupta 算法的推广：维护每个需求对的分数割权重 w_{s,t}（初始 1/L），按质量函数 mass({w}) 为势函数划分 epoch（mass 每下降 log n 倍开新 epoch，epoch 数 O(log n/log log n)，权重膨胀 n^{o(1)}/L），每轮随机选需求对并做“随机 level cut”。分析上以 Gupta 的两两连通性分析为出发点，改用“三角结构”分析（Lemma 25 的路径系统结构）：若某轮期望割规模大，则存在节点 u 使许多路径的前缀含 u、后缀与基路径 π_b 相交；配合 val 函数（Lemma 24 的三角不等式与 Lemma 16 的 Maclaurin 集中不等式）、以 shortcut-set 式结构 S（dist_S ≤ 2，|S| = Õ(L)）为中介的充电方案（Lemma 19–23）、路径见证结构（Lemma 18，路径长 Ω̃(L)、路径数 Ω̃(mass)），并通过 MCMF 定理在传递闭包中恢复带权上界的路径见证，最终平衡参数 σ = L^{3/2}n^{-1/2} 得到 Lemma 17 的 val 下界，进而给出每 epoch 轮数上界 Õ(|P|·n^{3/2}/(mass·L^{3/2}))，乘以 epoch 数与每轮期望新增节点数即得 Õ((n/L)^{3/2})。

Result: 定理 1：n 节点有向图的 flow-cut gap ≤ Õ(n^{1/3})，边版本与点版本均成立。定理 2：按总分数割权重 W 参数化时 flow-cut gap ≤ Õ(W^{1/2})（边/点版本均成立）。定理 3（folklore）：顶点版本 W^c 界可推出 n^{c/(1+c)} 界，故定理 2 蕴含定理 1。定理 4：按 W 参数化时，单位代价与统一权重视为一般情形（点版本）。定理 5：边与点 flow-cut gap 近等价——n 上相差 O(log n)、W 上相差 O(1)（点→边方向为 folklore，边→点方向为新结果）。推论 6：最小代价边/点多割存在近似比 min{Õ(n^{1/3}), Õ(W^{1/2})} 的随机多项式时间算法，改进此前 Õ(n^{11/23})。推论 7：sparsest cut gap 同样 ≤ min{Õ(n^{1/3}), Õ(W^{1/2})}。推论 8：任意 n 节点有向图存在弱 LDD，其 loss ≤ min{Õ(n^{1/3}), Õ(W^{1/2})}（即单向意义下的有向 LDD；roundtrip 情形仍为 Θ(log n log log n) 级别）。另给出完整的归约网络图（efg / vfg / vufg / vuufg 之间的转换）。

Conclusion: 本文把有向 flow-cut gap 的上界指数从 11/23 降到 1/3，是二十年来一般有向情形的首次实质性改进，把已知上下界从 n^{1/7}–n^{11/23} 收窄到 n^{1/7}–n^{1/3}；同时首次给出按总分数割权重 W 参数化的 Õ(W^{1/2}) 界，并系统化建立了 flow-cut gap 各版本（边/点、单位代价、统一权重、n/W 参数化）之间的归约网络，附带 min-cut 近似算法、sparsest cut gap 与弱 LDD 的相应推论。技术上，核心贡献是以“三角结构 + val 函数集中 + 充电方案 + 路径见证”取代 Gupta 的两两连通性分析，把指数从 2 降到 3/2。遗留问题包括：指数 1/7 与 1/3 之间的差距仍未闭合，W 参数化与 n 参数化之间的反向归约尚不存在，且一般情形与无容量/统一权重情形在边版本下是否真正等价仍未知。

Abstract: We prove that the flow-cut gap for $n$-node directed graphs is at most $n^{1/3 + o(1)}$. This is the first improvement since a previous upper bound of $\widetilde{O}(n^{11/23})$ by Agarwal, Alon, and Charikar (STOC '07), and it narrows the gap to the current lower bound of $\widetildeΩ(n^{1/7})$ by Chuzhoy and Khanna (JACM '09). We also show an upper bound on the directed flow-cut gap of $W^{1/2}n^{o(1)}$, where $W$ is the sum of the minimum fractional cut weights.
  As an auxiliary contribution, we significantly expand the network of reductions among various versions of the directed flow-cut gap problem. In particular, we prove near-equivalence between the edge and vertex directed flow-cut gaps, and we show that when parametrizing by $W$, one can assume unit capacities and uniform fractional cut weights without loss of generality.

</details>


### [102] [Approximation Algorithms for Matroid-Intersection Coloring with Applications to Rota's Basis Conjecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03735)
*Stephen Arndt,Benjamin Moseley,Kirk Pruhs,Chaitanya Swamy,Michael Zlatin*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 研究拟阵交集着色问题，给定k个拟阵，目标是将其公共元素集划分最少的颜色类，使得每个颜色类在所有拟阵中都是独立的。论文给出了首个多项式时间算法，对两个拟阵达到2-近似，对k个拟阵达到(k²-k)χ_max着色，并给出FPRAS算法，同时构造性地证明了Rota基猜想的一个渐近版本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已知2χ_max和(2k-1)χ_max的颜色上界存在，但证明依赖拓扑霍尔定理和Sperner引理等非构造性技术，缺乏多项式时间算法。该研究旨在将这些存在性结果算法化，并首次给出逼近比仅依赖k（与n无关）的多项式时间算法。

Method: 引入"灵活分解"(flexible decomposition)这一新的拟阵结构，将一般拟阵交集着色问题形式化地归约为图着色问题，避免了分区归约技术的局限性，且不依赖非构造性的拓扑方法。

Result: 1) 两个拟阵：构造性地达到2χ_max上界，获得2-近似算法；2) k个拟阵：得到(k²-k)χ_max着色，是常数k下首个O(1)-近似算法；3) 两个拟阵在χ_max较大时给出FPRAS；4) 首次给出Rota基猜想渐近版本的多项式时间构造性算法，推广了Montgomery和Sauermann的结果到任意拟阵。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了拟阵交集着色问题的算法空白，首次实现了与n无关的多项式时间近似算法，并通过灵活分解概念建立了从拟阵着色到图着样的形式化归约框架，为该领域后续研究提供了新的技术工具。

Abstract: We study algorithmic matroid intersection coloring. Given $k$ matroids on a common ground set $U$ of $n$ elements, the goal is to partition $U$ into the fewest number of color classes, where each color class is independent in all matroids. It is known that $2χ_{\max}$ colors suffice to color the intersection of two matroids, $(2k-1)χ_{\max}$ colors suffice for general $k$, where $χ_{\max}$ is the maximum chromatic number of the individual matroids. However, these results are non-constructive, leveraging techniques such as topological Hall's theorem and Sperner's Lemma.
  We provide the first polynomial-time algorithms to color two or more general matroids where the approximation ratio depends only on $k$ and, in particular, is independent of $n$. For two matroids, we constructively match the $2χ_{\max}$ existential bound, yielding a 2-approximation for the Matroid Intersection Coloring problem. For $k$ matroids we achieve a $(k^2-k)χ_{\max}$ coloring, which is the first $O(1)$-approximation for constant $k$. Our approach introduces a novel matroidal structure we call a \emph{flexible decomposition}. We use this to formally reduce general matroid intersection coloring to graph coloring while avoiding the limitations of partition reduction techniques, and without relying on non-constructive topological machinery.
  Furthermore, we give a \emph{fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme} (FPRAS) for coloring the intersection of two matroids when $χ_{\max}$ is large. This yields the first polynomial-time constructive algorithm for an asymptotic variant of Rota's Basis Conjecture. This constructivizes Montgomery and Sauermann's recent asymptotic breakthrough and generalizes it to arbitrary matroids.

</details>


### [103] [On the Efficiency of Sinkhorn-Knopp for Entropically Regularized Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03787)
*Kun He*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究了Sinkhorn-Knopp算法在处理含异常值矩阵时的收敛性理论，通过引入"well-boundedness"（良边界）概念，证明了在温和条件下算法收敛可达O(log n - log ε)迭代复杂度，完全独立于正则化参数与成本矩阵范数的乘积η||C||∞，远优于现有最坏情况界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Sinkhorn-Knopp算法的理论收敛保证在存在异常值时严重恶化，受限于全局最大正则化成本η||C||∞或矩阵最小-最大元素比ν，导致理论与实践之间存在根本性脱节。

Method: 引入"well-boundedness"（良边界）概念，这是一种局部批量质量属性，可将从极端异常值中严格隔离数据中行为良好的部分。通过预缩放（pre-scaling）步骤消除维度依赖，以及分析矩阵密度临界阈值来建立一般(u,v)缩放的相变理论。

Result: 1. 对于EOT，算法在O(log n - log ε)次迭代内恢复目标传输计划，完全独立于η||C||∞
2. 通过成本可忽略的预缩放步骤，可加速至严格维度无关的O(log(1/ε))
3. 对于一般(u,v)缩放，建立了由临界矩阵密度阈值主导的尖锐相变：密度超过阈值时，迭代复杂度严格独立于ν；低于阈值时，复杂度下界为Ω(n/ε)

Conclusion: Well-boundedness为异常值鲁棒的矩阵缩放提供了坚实的理论基础，揭示了矩阵密度与算法收敛行为之间的深层联系，并弥合了Sinkhorn-Knopp算法理论与实践之间的差距。

Abstract: The Sinkhorn--Knopp (SK) algorithm is a cornerstone method for matrix scaling and entropically regularized optimal transport (EOT). Despite its empirical efficiency, existing theoretical guarantees to achieve a target marginal accuracy $\varepsilon$ deteriorate severely in the presence of outliers, bottlenecked either by the global maximum regularized cost $η\|C\|_\infty$ (where $η$ is the regularization parameter and $C$ the cost matrix) or the matrix's minimum-to-maximum entry ratio $ν$. This creates a fundamental disconnect between theory and practice.
  In this paper, we resolve this discrepancy. For EOT, we introduce the novel concept of well-boundedness, a local bulk mass property that rigorously isolates the well-behaved portion of the data from extreme outliers. We prove that governed by this fundamental notion, SK recovers the target transport plan for a problem of dimension $n$ in $O(\log n - \log \varepsilon)$ iterations, completely independent of the regularized cost $η\|C\|_\infty$. Furthermore, we show that a virtually cost-free pre-scaling step eliminates the dimensional dependence entirely, accelerating convergence to a strictly dimension-free $O(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ iterations.
  Beyond EOT, we establish a sharp phase transition for general $(\boldsymbol{u},\boldsymbol{v})$-scaling governed by a critical matrix density threshold. We prove that when a matrix's density exceeds this threshold, the iteration complexity is strictly independent of $ν$. Conversely, when the density falls below this threshold, the dependence on $ν$ becomes unavoidable; in this sub-critical regime, we construct instances where SK requires $Ω(n/\varepsilon)$ iterations.

</details>


### [104] [SVD Provably Denoises Nearest Neighbor Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03831)
*Ravindran Kannan,Kijun Shin,David Woodruff*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究高维低 subspace 中带有高斯噪声的最近邻搜索(NNS)问题。当数据位于 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 中未知 $k$ 维子空间($k \ll d$)且被方差为 $\sigma^2$ 的高斯噪声污染时，在假设第二最近邻距离至少是最近邻 $(1+\varepsilon)$ 倍的条件下，证明了三类结果：1) 当 $\sigma \in O(1/k^{1/4})$ 时，SVD 去噪即可正确恢复最近邻；2) 当 $\sigma \gg 1/k^{1/4}$ 时，最近邻不可识别，给出匹配下界；3) 当 $\sigma \gg 1/\sqrt{k}$ 时，噪声会主导 inter-point 距离，导致噪声数据中的最近邻与原始数据不同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最近邻搜索是机器学习和数据挖掘中的基础问题。现有方法在低维子空间结构的高维数据中面临挑战，特别是在噪声存在时如何可靠地恢复真实的最近邻关

Method: 使用奇异空间扰动边界、高斯集中性和球面对称性进行分析，通过 SVD 对低维子空间数据进行去噪处理。

Result: 1. 当 $\sigma \in O(1/k^{1/4})$ 时，SVD 去噪可证明恢复正确最近邻；2. 当 $\sigma \gg 1/k^{1/4}$ 时，最近邻不可识别（下界）；3. 当 $\sigma \gg 1/\sqrt{k}$ 时，噪声 $\sigma\sqrt{d}$ 超过数据点间距离，噪声数据最近邻与原始数据不同。

Conclusion: SVD 可在 naive 最近邻搜索失效的 regime 下识别正确最近邻。相比 Abdullah et al. 2014，不需要 $\sigma$ 至少为 $d$ 的逆多项式。

Abstract: We study the Nearest Neighbor Search (NNS) problem in a high-dimensional setting where data lies in a low-dimensional subspace and is corrupted by Gaussian noise. Specifically, we consider a semi-random model in which $n$ points from an unknown $k$-dimensional subspace of $\mathbb{R}^d$ ($k \ll d$) are perturbed by zero-mean $d$-dimensional Gaussian noise with variance $σ^2$ per coordinate. Assuming the second-nearest neighbor is at least a factor $(1+\varepsilon)$ farther from the query than the nearest neighbor, and given only the noisy data, our goal is to recover the nearest neighbor in the uncorrupted data. We prove three results. First, for $σ\in O(1/k^{1/4})$, simply performing SVD denoises the data and provably recovers the correct nearest neighbor of the uncorrupted data. Second, for $σ\gg 1/k^{1/4}$, the nearest neighbor in the uncorrupted data is not even identifiable from the noisy data in general, giving a matching lower bound and showing the necessity of this threshold for NNS. Third, for $σ\gg 1/\sqrt{k}$, the noise magnitude $σ\sqrt d$ significantly exceeds inter-point distances in the unperturbed data, and the nearest neighbor in the noisy data generally differs from that in the uncorrupted data. Thus, the first and third results together imply that SVD can identify the correct nearest neighbor even in regimes where naive nearest neighbor search on the noisy data fails. Compared to \citep{abdullah2014spectral}, our result does not require $σ$ to be at least an inverse polynomial in the ambient dimension $d$. Our analysis uses perturbation bounds for singular spaces together with Gaussian concentration and spherical symmetry. We also provide empirical results on real datasets supporting our theory.

</details>


### [105] [Uniform Sampling of Proper Graph Colorings via Soft Coloring and Partial Rejection Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03947)
*Sarat Moka,Ava Vahedi*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于部分拒绝采样（PRS）的精确均匀采样算法，用于生成图的合法k-着色样本。与CFTP方法不同，该算法本质上是可并行的。通过引入"复杂度简化器"的混合变体，将全局采样问题分解为O(log n)规模的独立子问题，从而改进现有精确采样运行时间。递归应用可达O(L^{log* n} · nΔ)的时间复杂度，并猜测L有常数上界，暗示存在线性时间的并行精确着色算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图着色的精确均匀采样是组合采样领域的基本问题。传统方法如CFTP难以并行化，且运行时间受限于全局耦合开销。本文旨在突破这一瓶颈，设计一种可并行化的精确采样框架。

Method: 1) 核心方法：部分拒绝采样（PRS）框架；2) 创新点：引入"软松弛"技术，逐步收紧着色约束直至获得精确样本；3) 混合变体：将问题分解为O(log n)规模的独立子问题，形成"复杂度简化器"；4) 递归应用驱动运行时间优化。

Result: 运行时间达O(L^{log* n} · nΔ)，其中L为松弛层级数。对于k > 3Δ的情况，改进了现有最佳精确采样运行时间。模拟实验强有力支持L有常数上界的猜想——这将意味着存在线性时间的并行化精确着色算法。

Conclusion: 该工作为图着色精确采样提供了一条可并行化的新路径。"复杂度简化器"的设计思想具有一般性意义，可与其他精确采样器结合。L有常数上界的猜想若被证实，将是该领域的重大突破。

Abstract: We present a new algorithm for the exact uniform sampling of proper \(k\)-colorings of a graph on \(n\) vertices with maximum degree~\(Δ\). The algorithm is based on partial rejection sampling (PRS) and introduces a soft relaxation of the proper coloring constraint that is progressively tightened until an exact sample is obtained. Unlike coupling from the past (CFTP), the method is inherently parallelizable. We propose a hybrid variant that decomposes the global sampling problem into independent subproblems of size \(O(\log n)\), each solved by any existing exact sampler. This decomposition acts as a {\em complexity reducer}: it replaces the input size~\(n\) with \(O(\log n)\) in the component solver's runtime, so that any improvement in direct methods automatically yields a stronger result. Using an existing CFTP method as the component solver, this improves upon the best known exact sampling runtime for \(k>3Δ\). Recursive application of the hybrid drives the runtime to \(O(L^{\log^* n}\cdot nΔ)\), where \(L\) is the number of relaxation levels. We conjecture that \(L\) is bounded independently of~\(n\), which would yield a linear-time parallelizable algorithm for general graphs. Our simulations strongly support this conjecture.

</details>


### [106] [Online Graph Balancing and the Power of Two Choices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04159)
*Nikhil Bansal,Milind Prabhu,Sahil Singla,Siddharth M. Sundaram*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 研究在线图均衡问题在i.i.d.模型下，针对任意基准图G，设计O(log log n)竞争比的算法。证明了贪婪算法对某些不规则图表现不佳，但通过引入log-skewness概念和图分解技术，可将任意图分解为skew-biregular子结构，从而设计出最优的在线算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在经典在线图均衡问题中，贪婪算法对对抗性到达是O(log n)最优的，对完全图Kn的i.i.d.到达可达O(log log n)。研究者想知道：对任意基准图G，是否也能达到O(log log n)的竞争比？

Method: 引入log-skewness概念刻画图的不规则子结构；证明任意图可在O(log log n)个log-skewness尺度上分解为skew-biregular片；基于分解设计贪婪算法的变体

Result: 负面结果：存在轻度不规则图G，贪婪算法在i.i.d.到达下竞争比为Ω̃(log n)。正面结果：对任意基准图G，存在O(log log n)竞争比的在线算法，且该界在完全图Kn上下界已知不可改进。

Conclusion: 贪婪算法仅在正则图（如Kn）和对抗性到达模型下最优。通过图的log-skewness分解技术，可克服图的不规则性，在一般基准图上达到最优的O(log log n)竞争比。

Abstract: In the classic online graph balancing problem, edges arrive sequentially and must be oriented immediately upon arrival, to minimize the maximum in-degree. For adversarial arrivals, the natural greedy algorithm is $O(\log n)$-competitive, and this bound is the best possible for any algorithm, even with randomization. We study this problem in the i.i.d. model where a base graph $G$ is known in advance and each arrival is an independent uniformly random edge of $G$. This model generalizes the standard power-of-two choices setting, corresponding to $G = K_n$, where the greedy algorithm achieves an $O(\log\!\log n)$ guarantee. We ask whether a similar bound is possible for arbitrary base graphs.
  While the greedy algorithm is optimal for adversarial arrivals and also for i.i.d. arrivals from regular base graphs (such as $G = K_n$), we show that it can perform poorly in general: there exist mildly irregular graphs $G$ for which greedy is $\widetildeΩ(\log n)$-competitive under i.i.d. arrivals. In sharp contrast, our main result is an $O(\log\!\log n)$-competitive online algorithm for every base graph $G$; this is optimal up to constant factors, since an $Ω(\log\!\log n)$ lower bound already holds even for the complete graph $G = K_n$. The key new idea is a notion of log-skewness for graphs, which captures the irregular substructures in $G$ that force the offline optimum to be large. Moreover, we show that any base graph can be decomposed into ``skew-biregular'' pieces at only $O(\log\!\log n)$ scales of log-skewness, and use this to design a decomposition-based variant of greedy that is $O(\log\!\log n)$-competitive.

</details>


### [107] [DAG Covers: The Steiner Point Effect](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04186)
*Sujoy Bhore,Hsien-Chih Chang,Jonathan Conroy,Arnold Filtser,Eunjin Oh,Nicole Wein,Da Wei Zheng*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究Steiner DAG cover问题，即允许在DAG中添加Steiner点的DAG覆盖。对于 planar 有向图和低树宽有向图，给出了(1,2, Õ(n·tw))和(1+ε, 2, Õ_ε(n))的Steiner DAG cover构造，并证明Steiner与non-Steiner DAG cover之间存在显著差距——树宽为1的图若stretch t<2且额外边为亚二次，则需要Ω(log n)个DAG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DAG cover研究（Assadi等STOC 25, Filtser SODA 26）仅考虑一般有向图，不允许Steiner点。本文认为在planar digraph和低树宽digraph这两类重要图类上，引入Steiner点可能带来更紧凑的覆盖，因此启动对Steiner DAG cover的系统研究。

Method: 对于低树宽有向图：利用树宽分解构造DAG；对于planar digraph：利用planar分离定理与多尺度分解技术；对于lower bound：利用树宽为1的特殊图类（近似为路或圈），通过信息论/组合论证证明non-Steiner的限制。

Result: 树宽为tw的任意有向图存在(1, 2, Õ(n·tw))-Steiner DAG cover；planar digraph存在(1+ε, 2, Õ_ε(n))-Steiner DAG cover。Lower bound：树宽为1的图若t<2且额外边为亚二次，则需要Ω(log n)个DAG。

Conclusion: Steiner点的引入在planar和低树宽图类上实现了常数stretch和线性额外边界，显著优于non-Steiner情况。Non-Steiner需要Ω(log n)个DAG才能达到t<2的stretch，凸显了Steiner点的关键作用。

Abstract: Given a weighted digraph $G$, a $(t,g,μ)$-DAG cover is a collection of $g$ dominating DAGs $D_1,\dots,D_g$ such that all distances are approximately preserved: for every pair $(u,v)$ of vertices, $\min_id_{D_i}(u,v)\le t\cdot d_{G}(u,v)$, and the total number of non-$G$ edges is bounded by $|(\cup_i D_i)\setminus G|\le μ$. Assadi, Hoppenworth, and Wein [STOC 25] and Filtser [SODA 26] studied DAG covers for general digraphs. This paper initiates the study of \emph{Steiner} DAG cover, where the DAGs are allowed to contain Steiner points.
  We obtain Steiner DAG covers on the important classes of planar digraphs and low-treewidth digraphs. Specifically, we show that any digraph with treewidth tw admits a $(1,2,\tilde{O}(n\cdot tw))$-Steiner DAG cover. For planar digraphs we provide a $(1+\varepsilon,2,\tilde{O}_\varepsilon(n))$-Steiner DAG cover.
  We also demonstrate a stark difference between Steiner and non-Steiner DAG covers. As a lower bound, we show that any non-Steiner DAG cover for graphs with treewidth $1$ with stretch $t<2$ and sub-quadratic number of extra edges requires $Ω(\log n)$ DAGs.

</details>


### [108] [String Representation in Suffixient Set Size Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04377)
*Hiroki Shibata,Hideo Bannai*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究了字符串的重复性度量χ（定义为最小suffixient集的大小），并首次证明了每个字符串都存在大小为O(χ(w))的表示方案，填补了该领域长期以来的开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复性度量是压缩表示和索引数据结构的重要参数。χ已被广泛研究，但其可达性（reachability）问题——即每个字符串是否都存在大小为O(χ(w))的表示——长期悬而未决，这是一个理论与应用的关键问题。

Method: 提出了一个新的形式化模型——子串方程系统（Substring Equation System, SES），作为表示字符串重复结构的核心工具。

Result: 证明了每个字符串都存在一个大小为O(χ(w))的SES表示，这是该问题的首个解决方案。

Conclusion: 肯定地回答了χ的可达性问题，为压缩表示和字符串索引领域提供了新的理论基础和实用工具。

Abstract: Repetitiveness measures quantify how much repetitive structure a string contains and serve as parameters for compressed representations and indexing data structures. We study the measure $χ$, defined as the size of the smallest suffixient set. Although $χ$ has been studied extensively, its reachability, whether every string $w$ admits a string representation of size $O(χ(w))$ words, has remained an important open problem. We answer this question affirmatively by presenting the first such representation scheme. Our construction is based on a new model, the substring equation system (SES), and we show that every string admits an SES of size $O(χ(w))$.

</details>


### [109] [A characterization of one-sided error testable graph properties in bounded degeneracy graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04466)
*Oded Lachish,Amit Levi,Ilan Newman,Felix Reidl*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文完全刻画了p-退化图中可被单边错误测试器测试的图性质。研究表明，测试性本质上由禁止结构的连通性决定：当且仅当违规结构不能被分散到不相交的高度数邻域时，相应性质才是可测试的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: minor-closed族性质的单边错误可测试性已被完全刻画（恰好是那些可由有界大小禁止子图定义的性质），但更广泛的p-退化图类允许存在高度"hub"顶点，这些hub可以从局部探索中结构性地隐藏禁止子图，使得已有的刻画不再适用。

Method: 结构化刻画方法。通过分析禁止结构在p-退化图中的分布特性，特别是研究违规如何通过高连通性区域（hub）被隐藏或分散。

Result: 给出了p-退化图中单边错误可测试性质的完整结构化刻画。核心结论：测试性由禁止结构的连通性根本决定——当且仅当违规结构不能被分散到不相交的高度数邻域时，相应性质才是可测试的。

Conclusion: 精确划定了在随机邻居预言机模型下p-退化图中可测试性的结构边界，同时考虑了单个禁止子图的连通性及其定义性质的综合行为。这为理解局部探索范式下的图性质测试提供了完整的理论框架。

Abstract: We consider graph property testing in $p$-degenerate graphs under the random neighbor oracle model (Czumaj and Sohler, FOCS 2019). In this framework, a tester explores a graph by sampling uniform neighbors of vertices, and a property is testable with one-sided error if its query complexity is independent of the graph size. It is known that one-sided error testable properties for minor-closed families are exactly those that can be defined by forbidden subgraphs of bounded size. However, the much broader class of $p$-degenerate graphs allows for high-degree ``hubs" that can structurally hide forbidden subgraphs from local exploration.
  In this work, we provide a complete structural characterization of all properties testable with one-sided error in $p$-degenerate graphs. We show that testability is fundamentally determined by the connectivity of the forbidden structures: a property is testable if and only if its violations cannot be fragmented across disjoint high-degree neighborhoods. Our results define the exact structural boundary for testability under these constraints, accounting for both the connectivity of individual forbidden subgraphs and the collective behavior of the properties they define.

</details>


### [110] [Subset Balancing and Generalized Subset Sum via Lattices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04656)
*Yiming Gao,Yansong Feng,Honggang Hu,Yanbin Pan*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究子集平衡问题（Subset Balancing）和广义子集和问题（Generalized Subset Sum），通过将这些问题归约到格上的SVP_∞和CVP_∞问题，获得确定性算法时间复杂度为$\tilde{O}(2^{4.632n})$，随机算法为$\tilde{O}(2^{2.443n})$。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 子集平衡问题是计算数论和密码学中的基础问题。传统的中途相遇算法时间复杂度为$\tilde{O}(2^{n\log|C|/2})$，本文旨在突破这一已知下界限制。

Method: 通过将Subset Balancing问题归约到格上的SVP_∞（最短向量问题）和CVP_∞（最近向量问题）问题，利用格算法的指数级加速特性。

Result: 确定性算法运行时间为$\tilde{O}((6\sqrt{2\pi e})^n) \approx \tilde{O}(2^{4.632n})$，随机算法运行时间为$\tilde{O}(2^{2.443n})$。对于足够大的$d$，Subset Balancing可在多项式时间内求解。

Conclusion: 成功突破了传统中途相遇算法的$\tilde{O}(2^{n\log|C|/2})$下界，将系数集约束从box形式推广到任意中心对称凸体，为格密码分析提供新工具。

Abstract: We study the \emph{Subset Balancing} problem: given $\mathbf{x} \in \mathbb{Z}^n$ and a coefficient set $C \subseteq \mathbb{Z}$, find a nonzero vector $\mathbf{c} \in C^n$ such that $\mathbf{c}\cdot\mathbf{x} = 0$. The standard meet-in-the-middle algorithm runs in time $\tilde{O}(|C|^{n/2})=\tilde{O}(2^{n\log |C|/2})$, and recent improvements (SODA~2022, Chen, Jin, Randolph, and Servedio; STOC~2026, Randolph and Węgrzycki) beyond this barrier apply mainly when $d$ is constant.
  We give a reduction from Subset Balancing with $C = \{-d, \dots, d\}$ to a single instance of $\mathrm{SVP}_{\infty}$ in dimension $n+1$, which yields a deterministic algorithm with running time $\tilde{O}((6\sqrt{2πe})^n) \approx \tilde{O}(2^{4.632n})$, and a randomized algorithm with running time $\tilde{O}(2^{2.443n})$ (here $\tilde{O}$ suppresses $\operatorname{poly}(n)$ factors). We also show that for sufficiently large $d$, Subset Balancing is solvable in polynomial time. More generally, we extend the box constraint $[-d,d]^n$ to an arbitrary centrally symmetric convex body $K \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ with a deterministic $\tilde{O}(2^{c_K n})$-time algorithm, where $c_K$ depends only on the shape of $K$.
  We further study the \emph{Generalized Subset Sum} problem of finding $\mathbf{c} \in C^n$ such that $\mathbf{c} \cdot \mathbf{x} = τ$. For $C = \{-d, \dots, d\}$, we reduce the worst-case problem to a single instance of $\mathrm{CVP}_{\infty}$. Although no general single exponential time algorithm is known for exact $\mathrm{CVP}_{\infty}$, we show that in the average-case setting, for both $C = \{-d, \dots, d\}$ and $C = \{-d, \dots, d\} \setminus \{0\}$, the embedded instance satisfies a bounded-distance promise with high probability. This yields a deterministic algorithm running in time $\tilde{O}((18\sqrt{2πe})^n) \approx \tilde{O}(2^{6.217n})$.

</details>


### [111] [DAG Projections: Reducing Distance and Flow Problems to DAGs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04752)
*Bernhard Haeupler,Yonggang Jiang,Thatchaphol Saranurak*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文提出DAG投影概念——一种可对原图距离或最大流进行近似的有向无环图。对于含n个顶点、m条边的有向图G，可构造仅需m^{1+o(1)}条边的DAG投影，实现(1+1/polylog(n))-近似全点对距离或n^{o(1)}-近似最大流，优于此前Ω(log n)的距离近似因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有类似结果在距离近似上存在Ω(log n)的近似因子瓶颈，且无最大流类型的先验结果。本文旨在构建更紧凑、更精确的DAG投影，以简化有向图算法并将困难问题归约为更简单的DAG问题。

Method: 构造性地给出DAG投影的O(m^{1+o(1)})时间算法，以及近乎最优的并行算法（m^{1+o(1)}工作量和m^{o(1)}深度）。通过DAG投影将有向图上的算法问题归约为DAG上的对应问题。

Result: 1. 距离近似：实现(1+1/polylog(n))-近似，优于此前Ω(log n)因子；2. 最大流：首次给出n^{o(1)}-近似类型结果；3. 应用：改进了距离保持器和单源最小割的最优结果，简化了跳点集和组合最大流算法的构造；4. 理论归约：将精确有向SSSP和最大流问题分别归约为更简单的无向SSSP、DAG近似等问题。

Conclusion: DAG投影可作为有向图到有向无环图的"桥梁"，将DAG上的高效算法移植到一般有向图，同时揭示了精确有向最短路径和最大流问题的计算复杂度下界可从相应DAG问题推导。

Abstract: We show that every directed graph $G$ with $n$ vertices and $m$ edges admits a directed acyclic graph (DAG) with $m^{1+o(1)}$ edges, called a DAG projection, that can either $(1+1/\text{polylog} (n))$-approximate distances between all pairs of vertices $(s,t)$ in $G$, or $n^{o(1)}$-approximate maximum flow between all pairs of vertex subsets $(S,T)$ in $G$. Previous similar results suffer a $Ω(\log n)$ approximation factor for distances [Assadi, Hoppenworth, Wein, STOC'25] [Filtser, SODA'26] and, for maximum flow, no prior result of this type is known.
  Our DAG projections admit $m^{1+o(1)}$-time constructions. Further, they admit almost-optimal parallel constructions, i.e., algorithms with $m^{1+o(1)}$ work and $m^{o(1)}$ depth, assuming the ones for approximate shortest path or maximum flow on DAGs, even when the input $G$ is not a DAG.
  DAG projections immediately transfer results on DAGs, usually simpler and more efficient, to directed graphs. As examples, we improve the state-of-the-art of $(1+ε)$-approximate distance preservers [Hoppenworth, Xu, Xu, SODA'25] and single-source minimum cut [Cheung, Lau, Leung, SICOMP'13], and obtain simpler construction of $(n^{1/3},ε)$-hop-set [Kogan, Parter, SODA'22] [Bernstein, Wein, SODA'23] and combinatorial max flow algorithms [Bernstein, Blikstad, Saranurak, Tu, FOCS'24] [Bernstein, Blikstad, Li, Saranurak, Tu, FOCS'25].
  Finally, via DAG projections, we reduce major open problems on almost-optimal parallel algorithms for exact single-source shortest paths (SSSP) and maximum flow to easier settings: (1) From exact directed SSSP to exact undirected ones, (2) From exact directed SSSP to $(1+1/\text{polylog}(n))$-approximation on DAGs, and (3) From exact directed maximum flow to $n^{o(1)}$-approximation on DAGs.

</details>


### [112] [Dominating Set with Quotas: Balancing Coverage and Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04912)
*Sobyasachi Chatterjee,Sushmita Gupta,Saket Saurabh,Sanjay Seetharaman,Anannya Upasana*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文提出并系统研究了 Dominating Set with Quotas (DSQ)：给定图 G、解大小 k 及每个顶点的下/上配额 lo_v, up_v，判定是否存在 |S|≤k 使每个顶点 v 的闭邻域中被 S 覆盖的顶点数 |N[v]∩S| 落在 [lo_v, up_v] 内。主要结论：(1) DSQ 参数化 k 在退化度 2 图上已是 W[1]-难（从而在 K_{3,3}-free 图上也难），而经典 DS 在这些类上是 FPT；(2) 参数化 tw 也是 W[1]-难（源自 Exact-Equitable Coloring 的归约）；(3) 参数化 tw+k 可 FPT，先得 2^{tw}(k+1)^{2tw}·n^{O(1)}，经"子集卷积式"改进为 ((2k+2)^{tw}+2^{O(k)})·n^{O(1)}；(4) 在 nowhere dense 图类上参数化 k 是 FPT（通过 quota  gadget + FO 模型检测）；(5) 在 apex-minor-free 图上有 2^{O(√k log k)}·n^{O(1)} 的亚指数算法（bidimensionality + 3-dominating set 下界）；(6) 推广问题 Set Cover with Quotas 在集合大小≤d 时有确定性的 2^{O(kd)} 算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 Dominating Set 只要求每个顶点至少被覆盖一次（下界 1、无上界），无法表达"覆盖不足"与"覆盖过度"都不可接受的应用场景（容错基础设施、负载均衡的设施部署、受限通信网络、资源/公平分配）。作者引入每顶点的下配额与上配额来刻画这类"既要足够、又不许过量"的覆盖需求，并借用 DS 在稀疏图类上的参数化复杂性成果（planar、bounded genus、minor-free、bounded expansion、nowhere dense、biclique-free 等均 FPT）作为研究 DSQ 可解性的参照系，目标是刻画 DSQ 在这些图类上的可解/不可解边界。

Method: (1) 树宽硬度：从 Exact-Equitable Coloring (H,r) 归约，构造"r 条竖线 n 条横线"结构：x^i_v(配额⟨1,2⟩)、y^i_uv(⟨1,2⟩)、M(⟨1,1⟩)、c^i(⟨ℓ+1,h+1⟩，ℓ=⌊n/r⌋, h=⌈n/r⌉)、α_v(⟨2,2⟩)，并给 M、c^i、α_v 各挂 2n+r+2 个配额⟨1,1⟩的叶子以强制被选；k=2n+r+1；并证明 tw(G)≤(2r+2)tw(H)。(2) 退化度硬度：从 Independent Set (H,r) 归约，x_v(⟨0,1⟩)、y_uv(⟨0,1⟩)、α(⟨r,r⟩)、p^α(⟨0,0⟩)，k=r；顶点序 p^α, {y_uv}, {x_v}, α 给出退化度 2。(3) 树分解 DP：nice tree decomposition 上的表 c[t,f,S]，f 记录袋中顶点被覆盖次数、S 记录解与袋的交集；introduce vertex/edge、forget vertex（在配额区间内取 min）、join（兼容映射 f=f1+f2-|{v}∩S|）四类转移，得 2^{tw}(k+1)^{2tw}；再把状态改为 g:X_t→[0,û]（û=max up_v≤k）并引入 w=Σg(v) 维度、按 (û+1) 取模的加法卷积，借 van Rooij 的技术得 ((2û+2)^{tw}+2^{O(û)})。(4) nowhere dense：给每个顶点接 quota gadget（K_{f(0)} – 路径(lo_v+1) – K_{f(0)} – 路径(up_v+1) – K_{f(0)}），证明 G' 排除 K_{g(r)} 为 r-shallow minor（g(r)=max(f(r),3f(0)+2)），再用 FO 公式（Dom/Distinct/Clique/Path/Check_{ℓ,u}/SatLQ/SatUQ/φ_s，长度 O(2^k k^4)）表达并调用 Grohe 等的 nowhere dense FO 模型检测算法。(5) apex-minor-free：归约规则 1 删去"2-邻域内下配额全为 0"的顶点，使任一 DSQ 同时是 3-dominating set；用 bidimensionality 得到 Γ_{15√k} 收缩，由 3-DS 大小下界 (>k) 提前否定，否则 tw=O(√k)，代入树宽 DP。(6) SCQ：color-coding + perfect hash family 随机/确定化，配合计数 DP 表 T[j,X]。

Result: 硬度：DSQ 参数化 k 在 2-退化图上 W[1]-难（Thm 3.1），因 d-退化图是 K_{d+1,d+1}-free，故 DSQ 在 K_{3,3}-free 图上也 W[1]-难（与 DS 在这些类 FPT 形成鲜明对比）；DSQ 参数化 tw 为 W[1]-难（Thm 2.1），而 DS 有 3^{tw}·n^{O(1)} 算法。算法：DSQ 参数化 tw+k 为 FPT，先 2^{tw}(k+1)^{2tw}·n^{O(1)}（Thm 2.2），用子集卷积式方法改进到 ((2k+2)^{tw}+2^{O(k)})·n^{O(1)}；DSQ 在 nowhere dense 图类上参数化 k 为 FPT(k)（Thm 4.1，FO 模型检测，公式长 O(2^k k^4)）；DSQ 在 apex-minor-free 图上可在 2^{O(√k log k)}·n^{O(1)} 时间内求解（Thm 5.1）；作为特例 SCQ 在集合大小 ≤d 时有 2^{O(kd)}·(|U|+|F|)^{O(1)} 确定算法（Thm 6.1），且 SCQ 即使 f=2 也 NP-难、但参数化 (k,f) 为 FPT；DSQ 在最大度为 d 的图上亦由 SCQ 结果得到算法。整体图景：DSQ 的可解性边界由" nowhere dense 性"与"树宽+解大小"共同决定，而非 DS 的稀疏性判据。

Conclusion: DSQ 虽在一般图上继承 DS 的 W[2]-难与不可近似性，但每顶点配额带来的表达力使它在退化度 2、K_{3,3}-free 等 DS 视为 FPT 的稀疏类上依然 W[1]-难，且参数化树宽也难；可解性出现在 nowhere dense（含 minor-free、bounded expansion）、树宽+解大小、以及 apex-minor-free 上的亚指数时间这些"更精细"的维度上，说明下界/上界的分离点并不在稀疏性本身，而在是否存在额外的全局结构（如低树宽或 nowhere dense）。作者列出三个开放方向：(i) 为 nowhere dense 类寻找不依赖 FO 模型检测的直接组合式 FPT 算法，并推广逻辑方法到更广图类（脚注还提到经由单色稳定类推广的可能）；(ii) 研究 DSQ 的近似算法（目前基本空白）；(iii) 预处理与核化（kernelization）问题，尤其在受限图类上。

Abstract: We study a natural generalization of the classical \textsc{Dominating Set} problem, called \textsc{Dominating Set with Quotas} (DSQ). In this problem, we are given a graph \( G \), an integer \( k \), and for each vertex \( v \in V(G) \), a lower quota \( \mathrm{lo}_v \) and an upper quota \( \mathrm{up}_v \). The goal is to determine whether there exists a set \( S \subseteq V(G) \) of size at most \( k \) such that for every vertex \( v \in V(G) \), the number of vertices in its closed neighborhood that belong to \( S \), i.e., \( |N[v] \cap S| \), lies within the range \( [\mathrm{lo}_v, \mathrm{up}_v] \). This richer model captures a variety of practical settings where both under- and over-coverage must be avoided -- such as in fault-tolerant infrastructure, load-balanced facility placement, or constrained communication networks.
  While DS is already known to be computationally hard, we show that the added expressiveness of per-vertex quotas in DSQ introduces additional algorithmic challenges. In particular, we prove that DSQ becomes \W[1]-hard even on structurally sparse graphs -- such as those with degeneracy 2, or excluding \( K_{3,3} \) as a subgraph -- despite these classes admitting FPT algorithms for DS. On the positive side, we show that DSQ is fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by solution size and treewidth, and more generally, on nowhere dense graph classes. Furthermore, we design a subexponential-time algorithm for DSQ on apex-minor-free graphs using the bidimensionality framework. These results collectively offer a refined view of the algorithmic landscape of DSQ, revealing a sharp contrast with the classical DS problem and identifying the key structural properties that govern tractability.

</details>
