### [274] [ABTest: Behavior-Driven Testing for AI Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03362)
*Wuyang Dai,Moses Openja,Hung Viet Pham,Gias Uddin,Jinqiu Yang,Song Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: ABTest 是一个"行为驱动"的 AI 编码智能体模糊测试框架：从真实用户上报的 400 个已确认失败中挖掘出 47 种交互模式（Interaction Patterns）和 128 种动作类型（Action Types），组合成 647 个基于真实仓库的可执行测试用例，在 Claude Code、OpenAI Codex CLI、Gemini CLI 上共报出 1,573 个行为异常，经人工验证确认 642 个为新的真实异常，检测精确率 40.8%；同时发现不同底层 LLM 的失败模式差异显著（共享异常少），并揭示大量超越"任务最终正确性"的过程级异常。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对 AI 编码智能体（Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI 等）的评估主要依赖静态基准、编程任务和人工构造的问题集，只关注最终输出的功能正确性，无法覆盖真实交互过程中的行为异常——例如智能体声称已移动文件却实际丢失文件、无授权地创建或删除文件、把部分失败包装成看似合理的完成、虚假声明"文件已丢失"等。用户意图偏离、意外副作用、不一致声明等问题在基准测试中几乎不可见，而端用户报告实证研究（Zhang et al., 2026）已证明这类行为异常普遍存在且影响显著。因此需要一个能系统性挖掘并复现这些交互式失败模式的测试方法，也需要区分异常究竟源于底层 LLM 还是智能体的编排/执行机制。

Method: 提出五阶段流水线：(1) 从 2025-07 至 2026-01 的 GitHub issue 中筛选 400 个开发者已确认的失败报告（排除 UI/服务端 API/计费/认证类），抽象出 Interaction Pattern（含高层工作流骨架 seq_skeleton_steps）与 Action Type（工具级受压操作、目标异常面、可观测失败信号）；(2) 用 LLM 种子生成器按三条兼容性准则（可自然嵌入、序列连贯、异常仍可观测）评估 47×128 组合，筛出 647 个种子模板；(3) 任务生成器结合种子模板、检索到的仓库上下文与严格 JSON schema，实例化为多步指令序列（含 rollback_steps、expected_new_files、expected_modified_files，路径须为工作区相对路径且禁止路径穿越）；(4) 在 Pallets Click 仓库的隔离工作区中逐 case 执行（每 case 一个连续会话、跨步骤保持状态、逐步超时），记录 prompt、命令/工具轨迹、文件级增删改证据与生成产物；(5) 基于指令遵循性与动作一致性两类自动 oracle 标记可疑行为，剔除提前终止/未走完全步骤的不完整运行，再由两名作者人工复核判定真异常。评测以 Precision（真异常数/上报异常数）为指标，覆盖 5 个模型配置共 3,235 次 case 执行，总成本超 $2,100；另对触发 critical anomaly 的 case 做受控重跑以检验可重复性。

Result: 五个配置共上报 1,573 个异常，人工确认 642 个真异常，整体精确率 40.8%；分配置为 Codex CLI+GPT-5.1-Codex-Mini 59.9%(166)、Gemini CLI+Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite 53.5%(175)、Claude Code+Claude 4.5 Haiku 45.9%(119)、Codex CLI+GPT-4o-mini 28.4%(95)、Claude Code+Claude 3.5 Haiku 23.1%(87)。保留集按类型为 minor 368、expected_outcome 140、critical 134；Gemini 的 critical 占比最高(36.0%)，而 Claude 3.5 Haiku 与 GPT-4o-mini 的 expected_outcome 占比更高(37.9%/43.2%)。RQ2：最易触发异常的交互模式是含显式校验/无静默跳过的模式（IP-28 校验后输出结果 23 个、IP-39 执行→抽取→校验→持久化 19 个、IP-26 双产物生成校验 18 个、IP-44 受限路径变换 17 个），简单的"生成并保存"(IP-12)与容器化运行(IP-36)较少；动作类型以 Command Execution(19)、CLI/Terminal Interaction(17)、File Operation(14) 领先，Configuration Setup、Environment & Platform、Model Output Control 各 11–13。RQ3：异常高度模型特异，同一 agent 换 LLM 后共享异常极少（Claude 两模型三类重叠均极小；Codex 仅 critical 1、expected_outcome 6、minor 21 共享），Claude 4.5 偏向"漂移后继续扩张工作流"，Claude 3.5 偏向"把部分失败包装成貌似完成的表象"，GPT-5.1-Codex-Mini 偏向"压力下硬推完成并过度动作"，GPT-4o-mini 偏向"未达要求效果而以辅助工作流替代"。重跑中超过 90% 的已检测异常可复现。

Conclusion: ABTest 证明将真实失败报告转化为仓库接地的行为测试是可行且有效的：它能发现此前未被报告的行为异常，暴露智能体家族与底层模型之间的鲁棒性差异，并指出评估编码智能体不能只看任务是否成功，必须系统检查其多步交互中的过程性行为。局限包括：精确率仅 40.8%（人工判定主观性）、每个种子仅实例化一个用例且仅用单一仓库 Pallets Click、issue 采样有时间窗限制、Interaction Pattern/Action Type 的抽象可能丢失细粒度上下文。未来工作可扩展到更多仓库与更多模型配置、提升 oracle 自动化程度与精确率。

Abstract: AI coding agents are increasingly integrated into real-world software development workflows, yet their robustness under diverse and adversarial scenarios remains poorly understood. We present ABTest, a behavior-driven fuzzing framework that systematically tests coding agents by turning real-world failure reports into repository-grounded behavioral tests. ABTest (1) mines user-reported anomalies to derive reusable workflow patterns (Interaction Patterns) and behaviors (Action types); (2) composes them into stepwise fuzzing templates; (3) instantiates executable test cases in real repositories; (4) executes them with coding agents while recording traces and artifacts; and (5) detects and validates anomalous behaviors.
  We apply ABTest to three widely used coding agents: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI. From 400 user-reported developer-confirmed agent failures, we extract 47 Interaction Patterns and 128 Action types, generating 647 repository-grounded fuzzing cases. Executing the 647-case bundle once per evaluated configuration, ABTest flags 1,573 behavioral anomalies across the three coding agent families, of which 642 are manually confirmed as new true anomalies, achieving a detection precision of 40.8%. Our results demonstrate that ABTest effectively uncovers real-world failures, exposes robustness differences across models, and reveals previously unreported failure modes.

</details>


### [275] [SDVDiag: Using Context-Aware Causality Mining for the Diagnosis of Connected Vehicle Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03391)
*Matthias Weiß,Falk Dettinger,Elias Detrois,Nasser Jazdi,Michael Weyrich*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对车联网系统中因果故障诊断困难的问题，提出一种融合人类反馈的多模态方法，利用强化学习从人类反馈中持续训练因果挖掘模型，并通过分布式追踪数据剪枝假阳性因果边。实验表明该方法因果边检测精度从14%提升至100%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车联网功能虽逐步推广，但因其分布式特性和底层云、边、网基础设施的复杂性，可靠运行仍面临挑战。现有自动分析技术主要依赖数据驱动，难以处理隐藏关系和上下文信息，导致故障诊断仍依赖人工。

Method: 提出多模态因果分析方法，核心包括：(1) 采用强化学习从人类反馈(RLHF)持续训练因果挖掘模型，融入专家知识；(2) 利用分布式追踪数据剪枝假阳性因果边；(3) 注入领域特定关系以进一步优化因果图。

Result: 在真实的车联网自动代客泊车应用中进行评估，因果边检测精度从14%大幅提升至100%，系统可解释性显著优于纯数据驱动方法。

Conclusion: 所提方法在车联网领域具有实际应用潜力，可有效提升系统故障诊断效率，减少停机时间。

Abstract: Real-world implementations of connected vehicle functions are spreading steadily, yet operating these functions reliably remains challenging due to their distributed nature and the complexity of the underlying cloud, edge, and networking infrastructure. Quick diagnosis of problems and understanding the error chains that lead to failures is essential for reducing downtime. However, diagnosing these systems is still largely performed manually, as automated analysis techniques are predominantly data-driven and struggle with hidden relationships and the integration of context information. This paper addresses this gap by introducing a multimodal approach that integrates human feedback and system-specific information into the causal analysis process. Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback is employed to continuously train a causality mining model while incorporating expert knowledge. Additional modules leverage distributed tracing data to prune false-positive causal links and enable the injection of domain-specific relationships to further refine the causal graph.Evaluation is performed using an automated valet parking application operated in a connected vehicle test field. Results demonstrate a significant increase in precision from 14\% to 100\% for the detection of causal edges and improved system interpretability compared to purely data-driven approaches, highlighting the potential for system operators in the connected vehicle domain.

</details>


### [276] [Android Instrumentation Testing in Continuous Integration: Practices, Patterns, and Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03438)
*Hamid Parsazadeh,Taher A. Ghaleb,Safwat Hassan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本研究分析了4,518个使用CI的开源Android仓库，发现只有约10.6%的仓库运行仪表化测试。研究揭示了测试设置从自定义脚本向社区组件的演进趋势，并比较了社区组件、第三方设备实验室和自定义脚本三种方案在可靠性、效率和成本方面的表现差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Android仪表化测试（端到端测试）能发现简单测试遗漏的问题，但在CI中自动运行存在困难，主要挑战是模拟器设置脆弱且配置随时间漂移。

Method: 通过分析CI工作流文件、脚本和构建配置，识别Gradle中的设备设置定义（如Gradle Managed Devices），并使用GitHub Actions的运行级和步骤级元数据（结果、时长、重试次数、队列延迟）评估不同设置风格的性能。

Result: 仅约1/10的仓库（481/4,518，10.6%）在CI中运行仪表化测试；项目通常从自定义脚本转向社区组件；社区组件最可靠高效，第三方设备实验室适合定时回归测试但成本高且失败率更高，自定义脚本提供灵活性但重试次数更多。

Conclusion: 三种方案各有适用场景：社区组件适合日常代码检查，第三方设备实验室适合计划性回归测试，自定义脚本提供最大灵活性但维护成本较高。

Abstract: Android instrumentation tests (end-to-end tests that run on a device or emulator) can catch problems that simpler tests miss. However, running these tests automatically in continuous integration (CI) is often difficult because emulator setup is fragile and configurations tend to drift over time. We study how open-source Android apps run instrumentation tests in CI by analyzing 4,518 repositories that use CI (snapshot: Aug. 10, 2025). We examine CI workflow files, scripts, and build configurations to identify cases where device setup is defined in Gradle (e.g., Gradle Managed Devices). Our results answer three questions about adoption, evolution, and outcomes. First, only about one in ten repositories (481/4,518; 10.6%) run instrumentation tests in CI, typically using either reusable community components or repository-specific custom scripts to set up emulators. Second, these setups usually stay the same over time; when changes happen, projects tend to move from custom scripts toward reusable community components. Third, we study why projects change their CI setup by analyzing their commits, pull requests, and issue messages. We evaluate how different setup styles perform using GitHub Actions run- and step-level metadata (e.g., outcomes, duration, reruns, and queue delay). We find that teams often change approaches to expand test coverage, and that each approach fits different needs: community-based setups are typically the most reliable and efficient for everyday checks on new code, third-party device labs suit scheduled regression testing but can be costlier and fail more often, and custom scripting provides flexibility but is associated with more reruns.

</details>


### [277] [Agile Story-Point Estimation: Is RAG a Better Way to Go?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03443)
*Lamyea Maha,Tajmilur Rahman,Chanchal Roy*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本研究探索使用检索增强生成(RAG)技术自动化敏捷开发中的故事点估算流程，对两个嵌入模型在23个开源软件项目上进行测试，发现RAG方法在多个场景下优于基线模型，但未发现显著统计差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 敏捷开发中的冲刺规划会议通过Planning Poker等共识估算技术为任务分配故事点，但这一过程极其耗时。本研究旨在自动化这一手动流程。

Method: 使用两种嵌入模型（bge-large-en-v1.5和all-mpnet-base-v2）在23个不同规模的开源软件项目上应用RAG框架，从四个维度进行评估：检索超参数影响、项目规模对准确率的影响、嵌入模型选择、以及与现有基线的比较。

Result: RAG方法在多个场景下优于基线模型，但在不同项目规模或不同嵌入模型间未发现统计显著的性能差异。

Conclusion: RAG应用于自动化故事点估算具有一定的潜力，但当前方法仍需进一步研究和改进，包括RAG框架优化和模型适应策略的完善，以提升自动估算的准确率。

Abstract: The sprint-based iterative approach in the Agile software development method allows continuous feedback and adaptation. One of the crucial Agile software development activities is the sprint planning session where developers estimate the effort required to complete tasks through a consensus-based estimation technique such as Planning Poker. In the Agile software development method, a common unit of measuring development effort is Story Point (SP) which is assigned to tasks to understand the complexity and development time needed to complete them. Despite the benefits of this process, it is an extremely time-consuming manual process. To mitigate this issue, in this study, we investigated if this manual process can be automated using Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) which comprises a "Retriever" and a "Generator". We applied two embedding models - bge-large-en-v1.5, and Sentence-Transformers' all-mpnet-base-v2 on 23 open-source software projects of varying sizes and examined four key aspects: 1) how retrieval hyper-parameters influence the performance, 2) whether estimation accuracy differs across different sizes of the projects, 3) whether embedding model choice affects accuracy, and 4) how the RAG-based approach compares to the existing baselines. Although the RAG-based approach outperformed the baseline models in several occasions, our results did not exhibit statistically significant differences in performance across the projects or across the embedding models. This highlights the need for further studies and refinement of the RAG, and model adaptation strategies for better accuracy in automatically estimating user stories.

</details>


### [278] [Measuring LLM Trust Allocation Across Conflicting Software Artifacts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03447)
*Noshin Ulfat,Ahsanul Ameen Sabit,Soneya Binta Hossain*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出TRACE框架，用于评估LLM在软件工程任务中对代码、Javadoc、签名和测试等多种制品的质量评估和信任校准能力。研究发现当前LLM在审计自然语言规范方面表现较好，但在检测微妙的代码级漂移方面存在系统性盲点，且大多数模型的置信度校准较差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM软件工程助手评估主要关注下游输出质量，无法揭示模型是否真正识别了降级证据、定位了不可靠来源或在制品间校准了信任分配。LLM的失败不仅在于产生错误输出，还在于将信任错误分配给不一致的代码、文档和测试。

Method: 提出TRACE框架，通过盲扰动在Javadoc、方法签名、实现和测试前缀上引出结构化的制品级信任轨迹。使用7个模型在456个精选Java方法包上的22,339条有效轨迹进行评估，从制品质量评估、不一致性检测、受影响制品归因和源优先级排序四个维度进行测试。

Result: 质量惩罚主要局部化在受扰动的制品上且随严重程度增加；但敏感性在不同制品类型间不对称：文档缺陷的重-轻差异(0.152-0.253)远大于实现缺陷(0.049-0.123)。模型对显式文档缺陷检测良好(67-94%)，对Javadoc与实现矛盾检测达50-91%，但对"仅实现漂移而文档保持合理"的场景存在系统性盲点，检测率下降7-42个百分点。7个模型中6个置信度校准较差。

Conclusion: 当前LLM更擅长审计自然语言规范而非检测微妙的代码级漂移，建议在关键正确性的下游使用前进行显式的制品级信任推理。

Abstract: LLM-based software engineering assistants fail not only by producing incorrect outputs, but also by allocating trust to the wrong artifact when code, documentation, and tests disagree. Existing evaluations focus mainly on downstream outcomes and therefore cannot reveal whether a model recognized degraded evidence, identified the unreliable source, or calibrated its trust across artifacts. We present TRACE (Trust Reasoning over Artifacts for Calibrated Evaluation), a framework that elicits structured artifact-level trust traces over Javadoc, method signatures, implementations, and test prefixes under blind perturbations. Using 22,339 valid traces from seven models on 456 curated Java method bundles, we evaluate per-artifact quality assessment, inconsistency detection, affected artifact attribution, and source prioritization. Across all models, quality penalties are largely localized to the perturbed artifact and increase with severity, but sensitivity is asymmetric across artifact types: documentation bugs induce a substantially larger heavy-to-subtle gap than implementation faults (0.152-0.253 vs. 0.049-0.123). Models detect explicit documentation bugs well (67-94%) and Javadoc and implementation contradictions at 50-91%, yet show a systematic blind spot when only the implementation drifts while the documentation remains plausible, with detection dropping by 7-42 percentage points. Confidence is poorly calibrated for six of seven models. These findings suggest that current LLMs are better at auditing natural-language specifications than at detecting subtle code-level drift, motivating explicit artifact-level trust reasoning before correctness-critical downstream use.

</details>


### [279] [Inside the Scaffold: A Source-Code Taxonomy of Coding Agent Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03515)
*Benjamin Rombaut*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过对13个开源代码智能体脚手架的源代码级分析，提出了一个包含12个维度、三层架构的分类体系。研究发现脚手架架构难以离散分类，控制策略从固定管道到蒙特卡洛树搜索不等，上下文压缩策略有7种，且5个循环原语（ReAct、generate-test-repair、plan-execute、multi-attempt retry、tree search）可组合使用，11/13的智能体采用多原语组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码智能体调查仅按抽象能力分类，无法区分架构差异；轨迹研究仅观察行为而未深入决定行为的脚手架代码。脚手架代码（控制循环、工具定义、状态管理、上下文策略）对智能体行为至关重要但缺乏系统研究。

Method: 对13个开源代码智能体脚手架（固定提交哈希）进行源代码级分析，从三个层面提取12个维度的特征：控制架构层、工具与环境接口层、资源管理层。所有分类主张均基于文件路径和行号进行可验证标注。

Result: 脚手架架构呈连续分布而非离散分类；控制策略跨度大（固定管道→MCTS）；工具数量0-37个；上下文压缩7种策略；5个循环原语可组合，11/13智能体采用多原语组合；在外部约束主导领域（工具能力类别、编辑格式、执行隔离）趋同，在开放设计问题（上下文压缩、状态管理、多模型路由）处发散。

Conclusion: 代码智能体脚手架采用组合式构建而非单一控制结构；维度收敛与发散揭示了设计边界；基于文件路径和行号的分类体系为研究者和实践者提供了可复用的参考框架。

Abstract: LLM-based coding agents can localize bugs, generate patches, and run tests with diminishing human oversight, yet the scaffolding code that surrounds the language model (the control loop, tool definitions, state management, and context strategy) remains poorly understood. Existing surveys classify agents by abstract capabilities (tool use, planning, reflection) that cannot distinguish between architecturally distinct systems, and trajectory studies observe what agents do without examining the scaffold code that determines why. This paper presents a source-code-level architectural taxonomy derived from analysis of 13 open-source coding agent scaffolds at pinned commit hashes. Each agent is characterized across 12 dimensions organized into three layers: control architecture, tool and environment interface, and resource management. The analysis reveals that scaffold architectures resist discrete classification: control strategies range from fixed pipelines to Monte Carlo Tree Search, tool counts range from 0 to 37, and context compaction spans seven distinct strategies. Five loop primitives (ReAct, generate-test-repair, plan-execute, multi-attempt retry, tree search) function as composable building blocks that agents layer in different combinations; 11 of 13 agents compose multiple primitives rather than relying on a single control structure. Dimensions converge where external constraints dominate (tool capability categories, edit formats, execution isolation) and diverge where open design questions remain (context compaction, state management, multi-model routing). All taxonomic claims are grounded in file paths and line numbers, providing a reusable reference for researchers studying agent behavior and practitioners designing new scaffolds.

</details>


### [280] [AgenticFlict: A Large-Scale Dataset of Merge Conflicts in AI Coding Agent Pull Requests on GitHub](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03551)
*Daniel Ogenrwot,John Businge*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了AgenticFlict数据集，研究AI编程智能体生成的Pull Request中的合并冲突问题，发现冲突率高达27.67%，表明AI生成代码的集成挑战亟需关注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编程智能体正从辅助工具转变为主动贡献者，但现有研究较少关注Agentic PR的合并冲突问题，而合并冲突是协作软件开发中的基础性挑战，亟需深入理解。

Method: 构建了大规模数据收集pipeline，从59K+仓库中收集142K+ Agentic PR，通过确定性合并模拟处理107K+ PR，识别冲突PR并提取细粒度冲突区域。

Result: 识别出29K+存在合并冲突的PR，冲突率达27.67%，提取了336K+个细粒度冲突区域。初步分析表明AI生成贡献中的合并冲突频繁且规模显著，不同智能体间存在差异。

Conclusion: AI生成代码的合并冲突问题普遍且严重，需要更好地理解和管理AI辅助软件开发中的集成挑战。数据集、代码及补充材料已在Zenodo公开发布。

Abstract: Software Engineering 3.0 marks a paradigm shift in software development, in which AI coding agents are no longer just assistive tools but active contributors. While prior empirical studies have examined productivity gains and acceptance patterns in AI-assisted development, the challenges associated with integrating agent-generated contributions remain less understood. In particular, merge conflicts, a fundamental aspect of collaborative software development, remain underexplored in this context. In this paper, we present AgenticFlict, a large-scale dataset of textual merge conflicts in AI coding agent pull requests (Agentic PRs). The dataset comprises 142K+ Agentic PRs collected from 59K+ repositories, of which 107K+ are successfully processed through deterministic merge simulation. Our pipeline identifies 29K+ PRs exhibiting merge conflicts, yielding a conflict rate of 27.67%, and extracts 336K+ fine-grained conflict regions across these instances. Our preliminary exploratory analysis indicates that merge conflicts are both frequent and often substantial in AI-generated contributions, with noticeable variation across agents, emphasizing the need to better understand and manage integration challenges in AI-assisted software development. The dataset, code and supplementary materials are available in zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19396917.

</details>


### [281] [From UI to Code: Mobile Ads Detection via LLM-Unified Static-Dynamic Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03561)
*Shang Ma,Wei Cheng,Yanfang Ye,Xusheng Xiao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: AdWise 是一个基于 LLM 统一静态分析与动态 UI 探索的移动广告检测与监管框架：先用静态分析识别承载广告的 UI 控件（ad widget）并构建窗口转换图（WTG），再由 LLM 依据 WTG 路径、语义（用户意图）与结构（RAG 相似广告布局）三类引导信号做面向广告的 UI 探索，从而触发广告并依据规则判定违规。在 100 个基准应用（271 个广告控件）上，广告控件检测率 60.52%，比最强基线高 25.83 个百分点，检出 133 个违规（比最佳基线多 34.34%），单控件触发延迟 10.00s；并在 2,047 个真实应用中发现 383 个违规，已向 Google Play 与 Meta Bug Bounty 报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动广告动态从远端服务器获取并渲染在多样 UI 中，运行时难以定位与触发，导致广告监管违规（位置、交互、内容三类）难以规模化合规审查。现有基于 UI 探索的方法存在两个根本缺陷：(1) 通用探索以代码覆盖率为目标，将资源浪费在不通向广告的路径上；(2) 仅依赖内容匹配检查，广告内容可随重载变化而轻易绕过检测。同时，纯静态分析虽能指出"要找什么"（ad widget），却难以给出可行路径（"到哪里找"）。作者观察到广告控件放置存在两种未被静态分析捕获的模式：语义模式（与 App 功能紧密相关的用户高频路径，如音乐 App 播放列表中的弹窗广告）与结构模式（跨 App 复用的通用布局，如加载期插屏广告、设置菜单），而 LLM 因其对真实 UI 与代码的大量训练，恰好能分别通过 App 元数据理解用户意图、通过 RAG 识别开发者惯用布局。

Method: 框架分两阶段。离线静态广告分析：建模控件 w(v, id, I)（视图类、resource-id、方法调用集合），采用 Soot+FlowDroid 的过近似数据流分析——先由 findViewById 建立 x→id 映射，再做类型分析得 x→v，再做引用分析收集别名上的全部方法调用得 x→I；随后依据推理规则判定三类广告控件：ℛ_a 视图类属于广告库视图集合（adview，41 个广告库），ℛ_p 存在调用广告库 API 的调用（popup），ℛ_n 存在指向应用市场/网站的 Intent（native）。规则为必要非充分条件，故意牺牲精度（52.27%）以最大化召回，误报在动态阶段廉价过滤。同时静态构建 WTG G=(Win,E,ε)：通过 setContentView、Dialog.show、MenuInflater.inflate 及 FragmentTransaction.add/replace 识别窗口，为 startActivity/FragmentTransaction 等导航调用添加边并以触发该转换的控件标注边。
运行时面向广告的 UI 探索（Algorithm 1）：先按 resource-id 与事件触发当前 UI 中的广告控件并收集广告内容；再计算三类上下文引导并交给 LLM 选控件：(1) WTG 引导——用 Dijkstra 计算当前 UI 到可达广告 UI 的最短路径，将图编码为文本；(2) 语义引导——基于应用市场元数据（名称、类别、描述）让 LLM 总结功能，生成类目标用户行为的指令，并附加"点击通向其他应用或广告内容的按钮/链接"以覆盖菜单/退出处的 native widget；(3) 结构引导——RAG 从广告 UI 知识库检索 top-k 相似 UI，生成其中控件摘要以匹配开发者惯例。再配合两项接地机制：动作反思（对比动作前后 UI 判断是否成功，标记失败动作并写入短期历史，避免重复循环），UI 状态校验（过滤不可点击、被遮挡、越界控件以压缩动作空间、抑制幻觉）。循环直到所有广告控件被触发或达到步数预算。最后基于广告控件属性用规则检测违规：位置类（广告占屏 >30% 为超尺寸；与可交互控件 bounds 重叠为遮挡）、交互类（启动/退出前后的插屏广告为干扰性；全屏广告连续两次动作无法关闭为不可跳过）、内容类（记录落地 URL 并用 VirusTotal 至少 3 个引擎判定为恶意广告；用多模态 LLM 判定标题党）。

Result: 在 100 个基准应用、271 个广告控件（122 adview / 51 popup / 98 native）上，AdWise 检出率分别为 68.85%、58.82%、51.02%，微平均 60.52%，较 Monkey、AdGPE、MadDroid、DARPA 分别高 36.53、37.27、34.32、50.55 个百分点，较 GoalExplorer 高 25.83、较 Guardian 高 41.33 个百分点。PWDL 为 10.00s，比 Monkey/MadDroid/AdGPE/GoalExplorer/Guardian 分别快 24.12%/34.21%/20.13%/8.68%/53.23%。违规检测共 133 个（位置 43、交互 27、内容 63），最强基线 GoalExplorer 为 99，多 34.34%。RQ2：静态分析可独立达到 63.47%（adview 81.15%），并为 Monkey/MadDroid/AdGPE/Guardian 分别带来 8.86/7.01/7.01/15.50 个百分点提升，AdWise 自身提升最大（39.85%→60.52%，+20.66）。RQ3 消融：结构引导贡献最大（35.06%→60.52%，+25.46），WTG 引导 +13.28，语义引导 +16.61；将 Dijkstra 换为 KHop(k=2) 反而下降至 45.39%，因局部视图导致贪心困于邻域；换用 Gemini-2.5 Pro 得 59.41%、Llama-4 Maverick 得 55.72%，显示良好泛化性。RQ4 在野研究：借 Meta Bug Bounty Specialized Abuse Track 授权，在 AndroZoo 中用 AndroGuard 筛出 2,047 个集成 Meta Ads SDK 的应用，发现 383 个违规（位置 97、交互 86、内容 200），每类抽样 10 例人工验证全部成立，并已向 Google Play 与 Meta Bug Bounty 报告（审核中）。

Conclusion: AdWise 证明 LLM 能够有效统一静态广告分析与动态 UI 探索，弥补了纯静态（路径不可行）与纯动态（内容易变、探索低效）两条路线的缺陷，是首个同时覆盖位置、交互、内容三类广告监管要求的学术方法，并具备可落地的合规审查价值：已产出向平台方报告的真实违规案例。局限与未来方向：静态分析的推理规则仅是必要条件，精度仅 52.27%，需依赖动态阶段过滤误报；Fragment 尚未完全建模为 WTG 窗口；暂不支持闭源的 iOS 应用（作者认为可沿用现有 iOS 测试工作迁移）；可引入更强的 LLM Agent 以提升规划能力，但需权衡额外运行时开销；检测规则集可按不同政策与平台规格扩展。作者亦指出该思路可推广到移动支付等面向特定组件/API 的 GUI 测试任务。

Abstract: Mobile advertisements (ads) are essential to the app economy, yet detecting them is challenging because ad content is dynamically fetched from remote servers and rendered through diverse user interfaces (UIs), making ads difficult to locate and trigger at runtime. To address this challenge, we present ADWISE, a novel framework that formulates mobile ads detection as LLM-guided, ad-oriented UI exploration. ADWISE first performs static program analysis to identify UI widgets used to place ads, which we call ad widgets. It then uses a grounded LLM reasoning loop to navigate toward and trigger these widgets under three complementary domain guidance signals: (1) WTG-based guidance, which provides global transition priors from a statically constructed window transition graph (WTG); (2) semantic guidance, which reasons over app functionality to prioritize user-likely interaction paths; and (3) structural guidance, which applies retrieval-augmented generation to match the current UI against recurring ad-heavy layouts from a knowledge base. By combining static program analysis with LLM-based reasoning over UI structure, app semantics, and retrieved analogies, ADWISE enables more effective ads detection in complex mobile UIs. Experiments on 100 benchmark apps show that ADWISE outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by 25.60% in ad widget detection. In addition, ADWISE uncovers 34.34% more ad regulation violations across six categories, directly benefiting downstream ad regulation.

</details>


### [282] [DebugHarness: Emulating Human Dynamic Debugging for Autonomous Program Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03610)
*Maolin Sun,Yibiao Yang,Xuanlin Liu,Yuming Zhou,Baowen Xu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: DebugHarness 是一个由 LLM 驱动的自主调试代理框架，模仿人类系统工程师的交互式动态调试流程：通过解析 sanitizer 崩溃签名做「签名驱动初始化」，注入针对漏洞类型的排查指南；再借助 GDB / pwndbg / rr 等工具进行「交互式状态内省」，主动探查内存与执行路径；最后在「补丁生成—编译—PoC/测试套件验证」的闭环中迭代修复。在 SEC-bench（200 个真实 C/C++ 漏洞）上修复率约 89.5%~94.5%，相对最强基线 VulnResolver（67.5%）提升超过 30 个百分点，且单漏洞平均成本仅约 $0.09。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 漏洞「发现」已由模糊测试等工具自动化，但「修复」环节严重依赖人工专家分析，尤其是 use-after-free、内存破坏等深层低层故障。现有 LLM 修复代理（PatchAgent、SAN2PATCH、VulnResolver、Agentless 等）本质把修复当作静态代码生成任务，仅使用 issue 报告、栈轨迹与源码、语言服务器等静态产物，缺乏对程序运行时状态与内存布局的可见性。论文以 mruby 的 CVE-2022-1286 为例：ASan 栈轨迹只能定位到 vm.c 中的间接调用「症状点」，而真正根因（class.c 中 mrb_remove_method 缺失 mrb_mc_clear_by_class 缓存失效）发生得更早且根本不在栈轨迹中，静态方法（连同其跨文件定义追踪）无法建立症状到根因的时空关联；而人类专家会直接在调试器中设置 watchpoint、回溯内存生命周期即可定位。因此需要让 LLM 具备与人类同等的动态调试原语。

Method: 采用 PoC 驱动的修复设定：输入为有缺陷项目 P、测试套件 T、可复现 PoC 输入 I_poc 与 sanitizer 报告 R_san。三阶段闭环：(1) 签名驱动初始化——解析 R_san 判定漏洞类别（UAF、堆溢出等）与出错指令，向系统提示注入类别专属的排查启发式，并施加「必须先提出根因假设、未经动态验证禁止改码」的规则，以约束搜索空间、抑制幻觉；(2) 交互式状态内省——通过 LSP（clangd + compilation database）将 sanitizer 栈帧/符号映射为源码位置提供静态上下文，同时以 MCP（JSON-RPC over stdio）暴露 GDB（执行控制）、pwndbg（堆与内存内省）、rr（确定性录制回放与反向执行）供 LLM 编排，形成「提出假设—调工具验证」的迭代循环；因 GDB 只能前向执行且错误单步会不可逆破坏状态，rr 使 reverse-continue 可精确回溯内存破坏的时间原点，尤其适合 double-free 等时序型缺陷；为防幻觉命令，提供具体调试接口与命令校验层；针对调试器冗长输出导致上下文爆炸，引入上下文压缩：LLM 可直接生成沙箱内 Python 脚本对原始输出做模式提取（如统计被破坏 chunk、遍历链表）并返回语义化摘要；(3) 补丁与验证——LLM 输出多 hunk unified diff，先用确定性补丁修正算法（以最小编辑距离滑动目标片段重建上下文行、就近打破平局）修复结构错位，再在隔离环境重编译并重跑 PoC 与功能测试，失败时将编译告警/新崩溃日志经 LLM 蒸馏后回灌上下文，迭代至通过或达到迭代上限。实现为客户端—服务器解耦架构，LangChain 管理 agent 流程。

Result: RQ1：在 SEC-bench 200 个漏洞上，DeepSeek-V3.2 达 89.5%（179/200），Gemini-3-Flash 92.5%（185/200），GLM-5 94.5%（189/200），三者并集可覆盖 97.5%；超过 70% 的漏洞在 30 轮内修复，迭代超过 40 轮后成功率急剧下降。成本：DeepSeek-V3.2 平均 $0.09/漏洞（最经济），Gemini-3-Flash $0.64，GLM-5 $0.17；调试器交互本身仅占总修复时间的约 11%。RQ2（同为 DeepSeek-V3.2 骨干）：通用代理 SWE-agent 37.5%、OpenHands 20%、Aider 20%；专用修复工具 PatchAgent 57.5%（$0.10）、VulnResolver 67.5%（$0.07）；DebugHarness 89.5%（$0.09），相对最强基线提升超 30 个百分点且成本相当。RQ3 消融：GDB-only（去掉 rr 与 pwndbg）降至 82.0%（−7.5pp，χ²=4.60，p<0.05）；w/o debugger（完全去掉动态调试，仅保留签名驱动提示）降至 77.0%（−12.5pp，χ²=11.21，p<0.001），但仍高于 PatchAgent，说明签名驱动策略本身贡献显著；消融变体与完整配置的迭代次数无显著差异，迭代数主要由 LLM 推理过程决定。按漏洞类型看，Heap UAF 从 86.7% 降到 70.6%（时序型缺陷最依赖反向执行），Null Pointer Dereference 90.8%→70.8%（跌幅最大），堆溢出 92.9%→84.7%，内存泄漏 66.7%→53.3%，而栈溢出基本不受影响（局部空间型缺陷可仅凭 sanitizer 报告修复）。此外有 5 个漏洞仅 w/o debugger 能解，因编译器优化导致调试信息失真/不可用，反而误导带动态调试的 agent。

Conclusion: 动态、交互式调试对自主修复真实世界内存安全漏洞是必需的：DebugHarness 通过「签名驱动初始化 + 交互式状态内省 + 闭环验证」的组合，把 APR 从静态猜测推进到基于运行证据的诊断，在多骨干 LLM 上稳定取得 89.5%~94.5% 修复率，且成本低廉、跨模型鲁棒（差异仅 5pp），消融实验证实两大组件协同有效。局限包括：高度依赖编译器优化的二进制（指令重排、内联、寄存器分配）会造成「变量 optimized out」与行号错配，误导 agent 产生幻觉根因（缓解方案：自动调整编译选项、对重度优化区域关闭调试支持）；动态调试带来额外时延，仅适用于非紧急修复场景。未来方向：扩展到并发缺陷（数据竞争）、逻辑缺陷与性能瓶颈，通过独立 MCP 服务器接入 Valgrind、strace 等诊断工具，推广到 Linux 内核与其他语言项目，并尝试对真实未修复漏洞以 Pull Request 形式提交补丁。

Abstract: Patching severe security flaws in complex software remains a major challenge. While automated tools like fuzzers efficiently discover bugs, fixing deep-rooted low-level faults (e.g., use-after-free and memory corruption) still requires labor-intensive manual analysis by experts. Emerging Large Language Model (LLM) agents attempt to automate this pipeline, but they typically treat bug fixing as a purely static code-generation task. Relying solely on static artifacts, these methods miss the dynamic execution context strictly necessary for diagnosing intricate memory safety violations. To overcome these limitations, we introduce DebugHarness, an autonomous LLM-powered debugging agent harness that resolves complex vulnerabilities by emulating the interactive debugging practices of human systems engineers. Instead of merely examining static code, DebugHarness actively queries the live runtime environment. Driven by a reproducible crash, it utilizes a pattern-guided investigation strategy to formulate hypotheses, interactively probes program memory states and execution paths, and synthesizes patches via a closed-loop validation cycle. We evaluate DebugHarness on SEC-bench, a rigorous dataset of real-world C/C++ security vulnerabilities. DebugHarness successfully patches approximately 90% of the evaluated bugs. This yields a relative improvement of over 30% compared to state-of-the-art baselines, demonstrating that dynamic debugging significantly enhances LLM diagnostic capabilities. Overall, DebugHarness establishes a novel paradigm for automated program repair, bridging the gap between static LLM reasoning and the dynamic intricacies of low-level systems programming.

</details>


### [283] [Toward Executable Repository-Level Code Generation via Environment Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03622)
*Ruwei Pan,Junlei Shen,Linhao Wu,Yueheng Zhu,Zixiong Yang,Yakun Zhang,Lu Zhang,Hongyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: EnvGraph通过将仓库可执行性形式化为环境对齐问题来解决大型语言模型在仓库级代码生成中的挑战。该框架联合建模外部依赖满足和内部引用解析两个条件，在迭代对齐循环中通过统一的目标修订机制引导代码生成，显著提升了仓库级代码生成的功能正确性和非功能性质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代码生成方法在仓库级代码生成中表现不佳。现有的基于代码片段合理性的评估方式无法保证生成的多文件仓库能够成功安装、解析依赖和内部引用、启动并在真实执行环境中通过验证。

Method: EnvGraph提出双层环境表示，联合建模外部依赖满足和仓库内部引用解析两个成功执行条件；使用执行证据进行归因分析；通过统一的目标修订机制在迭代对齐循环中引导仓库生成。

Result: EnvGraph在三个代表性骨干LLM上均取得最佳性能。相比最强的非EnvGraph基线，功能正确性提升5.72-5.87个百分点，非功能性质量提升4.58-8.66个百分点。

Conclusion: EnvGraph通过环境对齐方法有效解决了仓库级代码生成的可执行性验证问题，为LLM在复杂软件工程任务中的应用提供了新的技术路径。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance on code generation, but existing methods still struggle with repository-level code generation under executable validation. Under this evaluation setting, success is determined not by the plausibility of isolated code fragments, but by whether a generated multi-file repository can be successfully installed, have its dependencies and internal references resolved, be launched, and be validated in a real execution environment. To address this challenge, we propose EnvGraph, a framework for repository-level code generation that formulates repository executability as an environment alignment problem. EnvGraph jointly models two coupled conditions for successful repository execution, namely external dependency satisfaction and repository-internal reference resolution. It maintains a dual-layer environment representation, uses execution evidence to perform execution-evidence-based attribution, and guides repository generation through a unified targeted revision mechanism within an iterative alignment loop. We evaluate EnvGraph on repository-level code generation with three representative backbone LLMs and compare it against representative environment-aware and repository-level baselines. Experimental results show that EnvGraph consistently achieves the best performance on these repository-level benchmarks. In particular, it outperforms the strongest non-EnvGraph baseline by an absolute margin of 5.72--5.87 percentage points in Functional Correctness and 4.58--8.66 percentage points in Non-Functional Quality.

</details>


### [284] [Persistent Cross-Attempt State Optimization for Repository-Level Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03632)
*Ruwei Pan,Jiangshuai Wang,Qisheng Zhang,Yueheng Zhu,Linhao Wu,Zixiong Yang,Yakun Zhang,Lu Zhang,Hongyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: LiveCoder是一个基于跨尝试知识优化的仓库级代码生成框架，通过维护成功知识、失败知识和历史最佳仓库来保持任务状态，实现重复生成的持续优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法孤立优化每次尝试，未能跨尝试保留和复用任务特定状态，而仓库级代码生成任务通常需要多次尝试才能解决。

Method: LiveCoder维持三类持久化任务状态：(1)成功知识——捕获先前成功仓库的可复用信号；(2)失败知识——记录不成功结果及其诊断信号；(3)历史最佳仓库——保存迄今发现的最优结果以防止回归。

Result: 在RAL-Bench上，功能得分提升22.94个百分点，仓库复用率达81.58%，成本降低53.63%；在两个基准测试、四个前沿LLM上均保持非功能质量稳定。

Conclusion: LiveCoder将重复仓库生成转化为持久化、知识驱动的优化过程，在多个LLM和基准测试上验证了有效性和效率。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved substantial progress in repository-level code generation. However, solving the same repository-level task often requires multiple attempts, while existing methods still optimize each attempt in isolation and do not preserve or reuse task-specific state across attempts. In this paper, we propose LiveCoder, a novel framework for repository-level code generation based on cross-attempt knowledge optimization. LiveCoder maintains persistent task-specific state from prior attempts to guide subsequent generation. This state includes success knowledge, which captures reusable signals from previously strong repositories, failure knowledge, which records unsuccessful outcomes and their diagnostic signals, and a historical-best repository, which preserves the strongest result found so far and prevents regression. These components collectively transform repeated repository generation into a persistent, knowledge-driven optimization process. We evaluate LiveCoder using four frontier LLMs on two representative repository-level code generation benchmarks. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of LiveCoder, improving the functional score by up to 22.94 percentage points, increasing repository reuse to 81.58%, and reducing cost by up to 53.63% on RAL-Bench while maintaining broadly stable non-functional quality.

</details>


### [285] [Automata Learning versus Process Mining: The Case for User Journeys](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03686)
*Paul Kobialka,Andrea Pferscher,Bernhard K. Aichernig,Einar Broch Johnsen,Silvia Lizeth Tapia Tarifa*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究了从服务事件日志自动生成用户旅程行为模型的两种技术（自动机学习与过程挖掘），并提出了一种结合两者优势的混合方法。研究表明，过程挖掘依赖专家知识，自动机学习依赖事件分布，而混合方法能自动选择最优技术及参数设置，生成更精确的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着企业服务化转型，深入理解用户如何体验服务成为关键成功因素。现有软件工程过程缺乏用户反馈机制，而用户旅程行为模型可以描述用户与服务交互的体验过程，有助于服务改进。因此需要自动化技术从用户交互事件日志中提取行为模型。

Method: 首先比较了两种经典的行为模型生成技术：自动机学习（automata learning）和过程挖掘（process mining）。随后提出了一种混合方法，结合两种技术的优势。实验通过真实世界的数字服务事件日志进行评估。

Result: 过程挖掘技术依赖专家知识，而自动机学习技术依赖事件日志中的事件分布。混合方法能够自动为给定事件日志选择最佳方法和参数设置，生成高精度的用户旅程模型。

Conclusion: 混合方法有效结合了过程挖掘和自动机学习的优势，可自动选择最优技术方案，在用户旅程模型提取任务中表现优于单一方法，具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: With the servitization of business, understanding how users experience services becomes a crucial success factor for companies. Therefore, there is a need to include feedback from user experiences in the software engineering process. Behavioral models of user journeys, describing how users experience their interaction with a service, can provide insights and potentially improve services. In this paper, we investigate techniques that allow the automatic generation of behavioral models from user interactions with a service, recorded in an event log. We first compare two established techniques that generate behavioral models from a given event log: automata learning and process mining. Afterward, we present a novel, hybrid method that combines both automata learning and process mining methods to overcome their limitations. For the existing techniques, we present methods to learn models of user journeys and evaluate the accuracy of the resulting models. We then compare these techniques with our novel method for the automatic extraction of user journey models from the event logs of digital services. We assess the practical applicability of all techniques by evaluating real-world applications. Our results show that process mining techniques rely on expert knowledge, while automata learning techniques depend on the distribution of events in the given event log. We further show that the proposed hybrid technique combines the strengths of both process mining and automata learning, automatically selecting the best method and parameter settings for a given event log to learn very accurate models.

</details>


### [286] [Runtime Enforcement for Operationalizing Ethics in Autonomous Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03714)
*Martina De Sanctis,Gianluca Filippone,Paola Inverardi,Raffaela Mirandola,Sara Pettinari,Patrizia Scandurra*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: This paper addresses the challenge of operationalizing ethics in autonomous systems through runtime enforcement. It first conceptualizes the system's ethical space and outlines a structured ethics assurance process. Building on this foundation, it introduces an enforcement subsystem that operationalizes ethical rules, specifically social, legal, ethical, empathetic, and cultural (SLEEC) requirements, through the Abstract State Machine (ASM) formalism. The enforcement subsystem is built on the MAPE-K control-loop architecture for monitoring and controlling the system's ethical behavior, and it relies on an ASM-based runtime model of the ethical rules to enforce. This enables the dynamic evaluation, adaptation, and enforcement of ethical behavior within a runtime formal model. The overall approach, named SLEEC@run.time, is demonstrated on an assistive robot scenario, showcasing how both the robot's behavior and the governing ethical rules can dynamically adapt to contextual changes. By leveraging a flexible runtime model, SLEEC@run.time accommodates changes such as the addition or removal of SLEEC rules, ensuring a robust and evolvable approach to ethical assurance in autonomous systems. The evaluation of SLEEC@run.time shows that it effectively ensures the system's adherence to ethical principles with negligible execution time overhead.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Method: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Result: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Conclusion: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of operationalizing ethics in autonomous systems through runtime enforcement. It first conceptualizes the system's ethical space and outlines a structured ethics assurance process. Building on this foundation, it introduces an enforcement subsystem that operationalizes ethical rules, specifically social, legal, ethical, empathetic, and cultural (SLEEC) requirements, through the Abstract State Machine (ASM) formalism. The enforcement subsystem is built on the MAPE-K control-loop architecture for monitoring and controlling the system's ethical behavior, and it relies on an ASM-based runtime model of the ethical rules to enforce. This enables the dynamic evaluation, adaptation, and enforcement of ethical behavior within a runtime formal model. The overall approach, named SLEEC@run.time, is demonstrated on an assistive robot scenario, showcasing how both the robot's behavior and the governing ethical rules can dynamically adapt to contextual changes. By leveraging a flexible runtime model, SLEEC@run.time accommodates changes such as the addition or removal of SLEEC rules, ensuring a robust and evolvable approach to ethical assurance in autonomous systems. The evaluation of SLEEC@run.time shows that it effectively ensures the system's adherence to ethical principles with negligible execution time overhead.

</details>


### [287] [AutoReSpec: A Framework for Generating Specification using Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03758)
*Ragib Shahariar Ayon,Shibbir Ahmed*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: AutoReSpec是一个协作框架，通过动态选择LLM组合和提示配置来生成可验证的形式化规格说明。当主LLM失败时，调用协作模型并利用验证器反馈进行修正。在72个Java程序的基准测试中，该方法达到67次成功，58.2%成功率和69.2%完整性，同时将评估时间缩短26.89%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM生成的形式化规格说明存在语法错误、逻辑不准确和不完整推理等问题，尤其在处理循环和分支逻辑时更为严重。现有方法（如SpecGen和FormalBench）依赖静态提示，缺乏失败恢复机制。

Method: 提出AutoReSpec协作框架：1）根据输入程序结构动态选择LLM对和提示配置；2）两级设计——主LLM生成初始规格说明，验证器检测错误；3）若主LLM失败，调用协作模型利用验证器反馈进行修正。

Result: 在72个真实和合成Java程序的基准测试中达到67次成功（93.1%通过率），58.2%成功率和69.2%完整性评分，较SpecGen和FormalBench显著提升，同时平均减少26.89%评估时间。

Conclusion: AutoReSpec为LLM驱动的形式化规格说明生成提供了一种可扩展、高效且可靠的方法，通过动态适应和协作修正机制有效解决了现有方法的局限性。

Abstract: Formal specification generation has recently drawn attention in software engineering as a way to improve program correctness without requiring manual annotations. Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in this area, but early results reveal several limitations. Generated specifications often fail verification due to syntax errors, logical inaccuracies, or incomplete reasoning, especially in programs with loops or branching logic. Techniques like SpecGen and FormalBench attempt to address this through prompting and benchmarking, but they typically rely on static prompts and do not offer mechanisms for recovering from failure or adapting to different program structures. In this paper, we present AutoReSpec, a collaborative framework that combines open and closed-source LLMs for verifiable specification generation. AutoReSpec dynamically chooses an LLM pair and prompt configuration based on the structure of the input program. If the primary LLM fails to produce a valid output, a collaborative model is invoked, using validator feedback to refine and correct the specification. This two-stage design enables both speed and robustness. We evaluate AutoReSpec on a new benchmark of 72 real-world and synthetic Java programs. Our results show that it achieves 67 passes out of 72, outperforming SpecGen and FormalBench in both Success Probability and Completeness. Our experimental evaluation achieves a 58.2% success probability and a 69.2% completeness score, while cutting evaluation time by 26.89% on average compared to prior methods. Together, these results demonstrate that AutoReSpec offers a scalable, efficient, and reliable approach to LLM-based formal specification generation.

</details>


### [288] [The Last APK: Retiring Android SDK Development for Institutional Software Using Python-Django, HTMX, and a WebView Bridge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03808)
*Rahul Patel*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文挑战了移动企业软件必须使用原生Android开发的传统假设，展示了基于HTMX-Django技术栈构建的校园管理系统。该系统无需Android SDK代码，通过Docker Compose自托管部署，在42名校园员工测试中，开发时间减少54%，HTTP负载降低91%，用户满意度达4.2/5.0。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统观点认为移动企业软件必须使用原生Android SDK开发，但作者认为这一假设对于机构部署场景已过时——既浪费经济成本，又技术上不必要。作者希望通过实际项目证明Web技术（HTMX+Django）可以有效替代原生移动开发。

Method: 采用Python-Django作为后端框架，HTMX实现超媒体驱动的移动端响应式局部DOM更新，使用Docker Compose实现自托管部署，完全不依赖外部云服务。系统涵盖后勤任务调度、库存管理、园艺跟踪、工人考勤、多级请假流程及客户端照片自动压缩等功能。

Result: 通过架构分析、HTTP载荷测量和用户评估验证：(1)开发时间减少约54%；(2)相比整页刷新，平均HTTP载荷降低91%；(3)42名校园员工用户满意度评分4.2/5.0。

Conclusion: HTMX-Django方案在校园管理类移动应用中具有显著优势，可有效替代原生Android开发，降低开发成本的同时提供良好的用户体验和系统性能。

Abstract: The assumption that mobile enterprise software requires native Android SDK development has persisted for over a decade, but for institutional deployments, this assumption is not merely outdated: it is economically wasteful and technically unnecessary. This paper presents a campus management system built during an internship at the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IIT Gandhinagar), covering housekeeping task scheduling, inventory management, horticulture tracking, worker attendance, multi-stage leave workflows, and client-side photo capture with automatic compression. The core stack uses Python-Django as the backend framework and HTMX for hypermedia-driven, mobile-responsive partial DOM updates, containing zero lines of Android SDK application logic. The entire system runs as a self-hosted Docker Compose deployment with no dependency on any external cloud service. Through architectural analysis, HTTP payload measurement, and user experience evaluation with 42 campus staff, we demonstrate that the HTMX-Django approach reduces development time by approximately 54%, reduces average HTTP payload by 91% versus full-page reload, and achieves user satisfaction scores of 4.2/5.0.

</details>


### [289] [Context Matters: Evaluating Context Strategies for Automated ADR Generation Using LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03826)
*Aviral Gupta,Rudra Dhar,Daniel Feitosa,Karthik Vaidhyanathan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文研究了大语言模型（LLM）在自动生成架构决策记录（ADR）中的应用，并系统评估了五种上下文选择策略对生成质量的影响。研究基于750个开源仓库的ADR语料库，发现上下文感知的提示策略显著提升ADR生成质量，较小的近因窗口（3-5条历史记录）可实现质量与效率的最佳平衡，而检索增强的上下文选择在典型线性ADR工作流中无显著优势。研究结论强调上下文工程比模型规模对ADR自动化更为关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 架构决策记录（ADR）对于保存系统设计背后的rationale至关重要，但其创建和维护常因编写成本高而被忽视，导致项目历史文档缺失，影响长期维护和知识传承。

Method: 研究团队从750个开源仓库中整理并验证了大量顺序ADR语料库，系统性地评估了五种上下文选择策略（无上下文、全历史、First-K、Last-K、RAFG），并在多个模型家族上进行了对比实验。

Result: 上下文感知的提示显著提升ADR生成质量；较小的近因窗口（通常3-5条历史记录）在质量和效率间达到最佳平衡；基于检索的上下文选择在非顺序或跨领域决策场景中仅有边际收益，在典型线性ADR工作流中无统计显著优势。

Conclusion: 上下文工程（而非模型规模）是有效ADR自动化的主导因素；研究为工具开发者提供了实用的默认配置，并为复杂架构场景提供了有针对性的检索回退方案。

Abstract: Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) play a critical role in preserving the rationale behind system design, yet their creation and maintenance are often neglected due to the associated authoring overhead. This paper investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can mitigate this burden and, more importantly, how different strategies for presenting historical ADRs as context influence generation quality. We curate and validate a large corpus of sequential ADRs drawn from 750 open-source repositories and systematically evaluate five context selection strategies (no context, All-history, First-K, Last-K, and RAFG) across multiple model families. Our results show that context-aware prompting substantially improves ADR generation fidelity, with a small recency window (typically 3-5 prior records) providing the best balance between quality and efficiency. Retrieval-based context selection yields marginal gains primarily in non-sequential or cross-cutting decision scenarios, while offering no statistically significant advantage in typical linear ADR workflows. Overall, our findings demonstrate that context engineering, rather than model scale alone, is the dominant factor in effective ADR automation, and we outline practical defaults for tool builders along with targeted retrieval fallbacks for complex architectural settings.

</details>


### [290] [Mapping GitHub Sponsorships: A Longitudinal Observatory for Open-Source Sustainability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03846)
*Rylan Hiltz,Taher A. Ghaleb*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文开发了一个用于跟踪和分析GitHub Sponsors生态系统的实时观测平台，通过优先级图遍历和增量更新采集数据，提供交互式仪表板和CSV导出功能。72小时样本捕获了49K+用户和144个国家的数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源软件融资研究缺乏系统性方法；GitHub Sponsors缺乏批量API访问接口，限制了大尺度研究的开展。

Method: 基于优先级的图遍历算法实现；每日增量更新机制；实时数据标准化；提供交互式仪表板和CSV导出接口。

Result: 72小时样本捕获49K+用户，覆盖144个国家；发现显著参与不对称性和地理集中特征。

Conclusion: 该平台可作为开源软件融资研究的工具基础，揭示了GitHub Sponsors生态系统中的参与模式和地理分布特征，为后续研究提供了数据支撑和分析路径。

Abstract: Financial sustainability is vital for open-source software, yet systematic research on funding remains limited. GitHub Sponsors, launched in 2019 as a direct developer-to-developer funding model, lacks bulk API access, hindering large-scale studies. This paper introduces a live, continuously operating observatory for tracking and analyzing the GitHub Sponsors ecosystem. The observatory performs priority-based graph traversal with daily incremental updates, real-time normalization, and exposes collected data through an interactive dashboard and analysis-ready CSV exports. A sample dataset collected during a 72-hour run captures 49K+ users across 144 countries and serves as an example of the tool's output, not a fixed deliverable. An interactive dashboard (https://github-sponsorships.com) enables practitioners and researchers to explore sponsorship patterns, filter by geography and demographics, and benchmark against funded peers. Preliminary results on the sample show strong participation asymmetries and geographic concentration, suggesting several research directions.

</details>


### [291] [Beyond Crash-to-Patch: Patch Evolution for Linux Kernel Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03851)
*Luyao Bai,Kenan Alghythee,Hang Zhang,Xiaoguang Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出PatchAdvisor框架，通过分析6946个内核补丁的迭代演化过程，利用检索式记忆和诊断Advisor引导编码Agent生成符合审查者期望的内核修复补丁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化内核修复方法将崩溃报告直接映射到代码补丁，忽视了补丁在邮件列表中经历迭代修订这一关键过程。审查者反馈对补丁的正确性、并发处理和API合规性有重要约束作用，这些信息在崩溃报告中并不存在。

Method: 大规模追踪syzbot相关的6946个bug修复生命周期，整合崩溃报告、重现器、邮件列表讨论、修订历史和合并补丁等多源数据。开发PatchAdvisor框架，集成检索式记忆库和微调诊断Advisor，引导编码Agent生成符合审查者约束的补丁。

Result: 分析证实接受的修复通常是全局性的（非局部），受审查者强制约束而非仅依赖bug报告。评估表明，利用补丁演化历史的PatchAdvisor在时间留出测试集上，相比无指导和仅检索基线方法，在审查者对齐信号和端到端修复质量上均有显著提升。

Conclusion: 补丁演化历史包含的迭代修订知识对自动化修复具有重要价值；整合邮件列表讨论和审查者反馈能有效提升修复质量。

Abstract: Linux kernel bug repair is typically approached as a direct mapping from crash reports to code patches. In practice, however, kernel fixes undergo iterative revision on mailing lists before acceptance, with reviewer feedback shaping correctness, concurrency handling, and API compliance. This iterative refinement process encodes valuable repair knowledge that existing automated approaches overlook.
  We present a large-scale study of kernel patch evolution, reconstructing 6946 syzbot-linked bug-fix lifecycles that connect crash reports, reproducers, mailing-list discussions, revision histories, and merged fixes. Our analysis confirms that accepted repairs are frequently non-local and governed by reviewer-enforced constraints not present in bug reports. Building on these insights, we develop PatchAdvisor, a repair framework that integrates retrieval-based memory with a fine-tuned diagnostic advisor to guide a coding agent toward reviewer-aligned patches. Evaluation on temporally held-out syzbot cases demonstrates that leveraging patch-evolution history yields measurable gains in both reviewer-aligned refinement signals and end-to-end repair quality compared to unguided and retrieval-only baselines.

</details>


### [292] [COBOLAssist: Analyzing and Fixing Compilation Errors for LLM-Powered COBOL Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03978)
*Anh T. V. Dau,Shin Hwei Tan,Jinqiu Yang,Nghi D. Q. Bui,Anh Tuan Nguyen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对传统COBOL系统维护难题，提出基于大语言模型(LLM)的自动化调试框架COBOLAssist。该框架通过编译反馈引导迭代修复，将编译成功率从29.5%/41.8%分别提升至64.38%/95.89%，验证了LLM在遗留系统自动化调试中的实用价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统COBOL系统仍是业务计算的关键，但面临两大困境：熟练开发人员减少，以及错误修复需要深厚领域知识。这促使研究者探索使用LLM来自动处理COBOL编译错误。

Method: 研究首先将LLM生成的COBOL代码中的常见编译错误分为三类：不完全代码错误、语法错误和类型相关错误。随后提出COBOLAssist技术，利用编译反馈指导代码迭代修复。在GPT系列变体和mAInframer共5个LLM上进行了评估。

Result: COBOLAssist显著提升了编译成功率：GPT-4o-mini从29.5%升至64.38%，GPT-4o从41.8%升至95.89%。pass@1指标也有明显改善（如GPT-4o从9.1升至22.6）。值得注意的是，mAInframer-34B编译成功率最高，但功能正确性有限。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了当前LLM在COBOL处理上的局限性，同时展示了自动化调试在遗留系统中的可行路径，为传统系统现代化提供了实践方向。

Abstract: Legacy programming languages such as COBOL (Common Business-Oriented Language) remain critical in business computing. However, maintaining legacy COBOL systems is increasingly challenging due to a declining pool of skilled developers and the persistence of COBOL errors that require deep domain expertise to resolve. This paper investigates the challenges of COBOL compilation errors and introduces a framework leveraging large language models (LLMs) to address these issues. We first categorize the common compilation errors in LLM-generated COBOL code into three groups: incomplete code errors, syntax errors, and type-related errors. We further propose COBOLAssist, a technique to enhance code correctness through iterative repairs guided by compilation feedback. Our evaluation using five LLMs including GPT variants and mAInframer, shows a high prevalence of incorrect program structures and function usage in COBOL programs and demonstrates the effectiveness of COBOLAssist, with the compilation success rates increasing from 29.5\% to 64.38\% for GPT-4o-mini and from 41.8\% to 95.89\% for GPT-4o. It also improves pass@1 significantly, for example from 9.1 to 22.6 for GPT-4. Notably, while mAInframer-34B achieves the highest compilation success rate, its functional correctness remains limited. This research not only highlights the limitations in current LLMs for COBOL but also demonstrates a practical path forward for automated debugging in legacy systems.

</details>


### [293] [COBOL-Coder: Domain-Adapted Large Language Models for COBOL Code Generation and Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03986)
*Anh T. V. Dau,Shin Hwei Tan,Jinqiu Yang,Nghi D. Q. Bui,Anh Tuan Nguyen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型在COBOL代码生成和翻译任务中表现不佳的问题，提出了领域适配方案。通过构建编译器引导验证与多阶段相似度过滤的自动化数据整理流程，并基于高质量COBOL训练数据微调得到COBOL-Coder模型。该模型在代码生成任务中编译成功率达73.95%，在COBOL-Java双向翻译任务中也显著优于通用LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: COBOL作为核心 mainframe 语言，现有LLM在生成和翻译COBOL代码方面存在明显不足，需要开发领域适配的专业模型。

Method: (1) 开发自动化数据整理管道，结合编译器引导验证与多阶段相似度过滤构建高质量训练数据；(2) 基于该数据对LLM进行微调得到COBOL-Coder；(3) 在COBOLEval、COBOLCodeBench等基准和自建COBOL-JavaTrans数据集上评估。

Result: COBOL-Coder编译成功率达73.95%、Pass-1达49.33，显著优于GPT-4o（41.8%/16.4）。Java到COBOL翻译达34.93 Pass-1，通用LLM近乎零分。开发者调查显示其在COBOL意识、程序结构可靠性和企业实践对齐方面更优。

Conclusion: 通过领域适配和高质量数据整理，COBOL-Coder能有效解决专业领域代码生成问题，为COBOL现代化迁移提供可行方案。

Abstract: COBOL remains a critical language for mainframe systems, yet existing large language models (LLMs) struggle to generate and translate COBOL code correctly. This paper reports our experience in developing and evaluating domain-adapted LLMs for COBOL and mainframe software engineering. We introduce (1) an automated data curation pipeline that combines compiler-guided validation with multi-stage similarity-based filtering to construct high-quality COBOL training data, and (2) COBOL-Coder, a COBOL-specialized LLM fine-tuned on the curated COBOL domain data. We evaluate COBOL-Coder on two tasks: code generation (on COBOLEval and COBOLCodeBench) and code translation (on COBOL-JavaTrans, our proposed benchmark for bidirectional COBOL-Java translation). In our experiments, COBOL-Coder achieves up to a 73.95 percent compilation success rate and 49.33 Pass-1 on COBOLEval, compared to 41.8 percent and 16.4 for GPT-4o, while most open-source baselines (e.g., CodeGemma, CodeLlama, StarCoder2) fail to produce compilable programs. For Java-to-COBOL translation, COBOL-Coder reaches 34.93 Pass-1, whereas general-purpose LLMs achieve near-zero scores. To assess the usability of LLM-generated code in real-world settings, we conduct a survey with experienced COBOL developers. Participants consistently report that COBOL-Coder exhibits stronger COBOL awareness, has more reliable program structure, and is better aligned with enterprise practices than general-purpose LLMs.

</details>


### [294] [Benchmarking and Evaluating VLMs for Software Architecture Diagram Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04009)
*Shuyin Ouyang,Jie M. Zhang,Jingzhi Gong,Gunel Jahangirova,Mohammad Reza Mousavi,Jack Johns,Beum Seuk Lee,Adam Ziolkowski,Botond Virginas,Joost Noppen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SADU是一个用于评估视觉-语言模型（VLMs）理解软件架构图能力的基准测试。包含154张架构图和2431个问答任务，涵盖行为图、结构图和ER图。最佳模型gemini-3-flash-preview仅达到70.18%准确率，表明当前VLMs在软件架构图理解方面仍面临重大挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管大语言模型在代码生成、测试和维护等代码中心任务上取得进展，但现代视觉-语言模型理解软件架构图的能力尚未得到充分探索。软件架构图是软件开发生命周期中用于沟通系统结构、行为和数据组织的重要设计制品。

Method: 构建了包含154张精心策划的架构图数据集，涵盖行为图、结构图和ER图三类，配备结构化标注和2431个问答任务，涵盖计数和检索推理类型。评估了Gemini、Claude、GPT和Qwen家族的11个最先进VLMs。

Result: 最佳模型gemini-3-flash-preview仅达到70.18%准确率，而gpt-4o-mini仅达到17.77%准确率。结果揭示了当前模型在图推理和视觉关系定位方面的弱点。

Conclusion: 软件架构图理解对当前VLMs仍具挑战性，存在明显差距。SADU为未来图感知AI系统研究和更真实的AI辅助软件工程工作流程研究提供了基础。

Abstract: Software architecture diagrams are important design artifacts for communicating system structure, behavior, and data organization throughout the software development lifecycle. Although recent progress in large language models has substantially advanced code-centric software engineering tasks such as code generation, testing, and maintenance, the ability of modern vision-language models (VLMs) to understand software architecture diagrams remains underexplored. To address this gap, we present SADU, a benchmark for Software Architecture Diagram Understanding that evaluates VLMs on architecture diagrams as structured software engineering artifacts rather than generic images. SADU contains 154 carefully curated diagrams spanning behavioral, structural, and ER diagrams, paired with structured annotations and 2,431 question-answer tasks covering counting and retrieval reasoning. We evaluate 11 state-of-the-art VLMs from the Gemini, Claude, GPT, and Qwen families.
  Our results show that software architecture diagram understanding remains challenging for current models: the best-performing model gemini-3-flash-preview achieves only 70.18\% accuracy, while gpt-4o-mini only achieves 17.77\% accuracy. The results further reveal the weaknesses in diagram reasoning and visual relation grounding, highlighting a gap between current VLMs and the needs of design-stage software engineering. SADU provides a foundation for future research on diagram-aware AI systems and more faithful AI-assisted software engineering workflows.

</details>


### [295] [SmartPatchLinker: An Open-Source Tool to Linked Changes Detection for Code Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04045)
*Islem Khemissi,Moataz Chouchen,Dong Wang,Raula Gaikovina Kula*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SmartPatchLinker是一款基于Chrome扩展的代码审查工具，通过本地推理后端与Gerrit集成，帮助审查者在代码审查界面中直接发现语义相关的补丁，减少重复工作并加快审查流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大型软件生态系统中，语义相关的代码变更（如替代方案或重叠修改）往往在提交数天后才被发现，导致重复工作和审查延迟。

Method: 开发了一款轻量级Chrome扩展，集成本地推理后端，与Gerrit集成。工具支持审查者配置搜索范围、查看带置信度指标的排名候选结果，无需离开工作流程或依赖服务器端安装。

Result: 对工具进行了有用性和可用性评估，证明其能够支持代码审查过程中的相关补丁发现。

Conclusion: SmartPatchLinker为代码审查者提供了便捷的语义相关补丁发现能力，工具已开源发布。

Abstract: In large software ecosystems, semantically related code changes, such as alternative solutions or overlapping modifications are often discovered only days after submission, leading to duplicated effort and delayed reviews. We present SmartPatchLinker, a browser based tool that supports the discovery of related patches directly within the code review interface. SmartPatchLinker is implemented as a lightweight Chrome extension with a local inference backend and integrates with Gerrit to retrieve and rank semantically linked changes when a reviewer opens a patch. The tool allows reviewers to configure the search scope, view ranked candidates with confidence indicators, and examine related work without leaving their workflow or relying on server-side installations. We perform both usefulness and usability evaluations to study how SmartPatchLinker can support reviewers during code review.
  SmartPatchLinker is open source, and its source code, Docker containers, and the replication package used in our evaluation are publicly available on GitHub at https://github.com/islem-kms/gerrit-chrome-extension . A video demonstrating the tool is also available online at https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MCcTj5OSlT7lHVBFMq5m9iatas2joaGb

</details>


### [296] [Software Testing Beyond Closed Worlds: Open-World Games as an Extreme Case](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04047)
*Yusaku Kato,Norihiro Yoshida,Erina Makihara,Katsuro Inoue*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文以"开放世界游戏"为极端案例，探讨传统封闭世界测试假设在现代不确定性软件系统中的局限性，并提出超越封闭世界假设的软件测试愿景与研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统软件测试依赖封闭世界假设（有限状态空间、可重现执行、稳定测试预言机），但现代软件系统具有不确定性、非确定性和动态演化特性，这些假设不再适用。研究者需要一个极端案例来系统分析这些挑战。

Method: 通过文献调研和观察，将开放世界游戏作为测试边界案例，识别其核心特征：无限行为空间、非确定性执行结果、模糊行为边界、不稳定测试预言机。

Result: 识别出四大核心挑战：1) 不可穷尽的行为空间；2) 非确定性执行结果；3) 难以捉摸的行为边界；4) 不稳定的测试预言机。基于此提出超越封闭世界假设的测试愿景。

Conclusion: 开放世界游戏虽作为动机领域，但识别出的挑战和研究方向（自动化测试生成、评估指标、实证研究设计）可推广至更广泛的动态不确定环境软件系统。

Abstract: Software testing research has traditionally relied on closed-world assumptions, such as finite state spaces, reproducible executions, and stable test oracles. However, many modern software systems operate under uncertainty, non-determinism, and evolving conditions, challenging these assumptions. This paper uses open-world games as an extreme case to examine the limitations of closed-world testing. Through a set of observations grounded in prior work, we identify recurring characteristics that complicate testing in such systems, including inexhaustible behavior spaces, non-deterministic execution outcomes, elusive behavioral boundaries, and unstable test oracles. Based on these observations, we articulate a vision of software testing beyond closed-world assumptions, in which testing supports the characterization and interpretation of system behavior under uncertainty. We further discuss research directions for automated test generation, evaluation metrics, and empirical study design. Although open-world games serve as the motivating domain, the challenges and directions discussed in this paper extend to a broader class of software systems operating in dynamic and uncertain environments.

</details>


### [297] [Humans Integrate, Agents Fix: How Agent-Authored Pull Requests Are Referenced in Practice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04059)
*Islem Khemissi,Moataz Chouchen,Dong Wang,Raula Gaikovina Kula*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本研究通过分析AIDev数据集中的agent-authored PR引用，构建了一个用于表征Human-to-Agent和Agent-to-Agent交互意图的分类法。研究发现人类启动了大部分对AI生成PR的引用，但大量交互实际上是AI辅助的，表明元协作工作流的兴起。人类主要通过引用构建新功能，而AI主要通过引用修复错误。引用/被引用的PR相比孤立PR具有更长的生命周期和审查时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管编码智能体(coding agents)为协作软件开发引入了新的协调动态，但实践中的人机交互细节仍缺乏探索，尤其是代码审查过程中的交互模式尚未被充分研究。

Method: 从AIDev数据集中挖掘agent-authored PR引用，构建分类法来表征Pull Requests形式下Human-to-Agent和Agent-to-Agent交互的意图，并分析引用PR的时间特征（生命周期和审查时间）。

Result: 1) 人类启动了对agent-authored PR的大部分引用，但大量交互实际上是AI辅助的，表明元协作工作流(meta-collaborative workflows)的出现；2) 人类主要通过引用构建新功能，AI主要通过引用修复错误；3) 引用/被引用的PR与孤立PR相比具有更长的生命周期和审查时间，表明更高的协调或集成成本。

Conclusion: 引用/被引用PR需要更高的协调或集成努力。研究提出三个关键要点作为未来研究方向，旨在利用这些动态优化代码审查过程中的AI编码智能体。

Abstract: Although coding agents have introduced new coordination dynamics in collaborative software development, detailed interactions in practice remain underexplored, especially for the code review process. In this study, we mine agent-authored PR references from the AIDev dataset and introduce a taxonomy to characterize the intent of these references across Human-to-Agent and Agent-to-Agent interactions in the form of Pull Requests (i.e. PRs). Our analysis shows that while humans initiate most references to agent-authored PRs, a substantial portion of these interactions are AI-assisted, indicating the emergence of meta-collaborative workflows, where humans mostly use references to build new features, whereas agents make them to fix errors. We further find that referencing/referenced PRs are associated with substantially longer lifespans and review times compared to isolated PRs, suggesting higher coordination or integration effort. We then list three key takeaways as potential future research directions into how to utilize these dynamics for optimizing AI coding agents in the code review process.

</details>


### [298] [Toward a Sustainable Software Architecture Community: Evaluating ICSA's Environmental Impact](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04096)
*Mahyar T. Moghaddam,Mina Alipour,Torben Worm,Mikkel Baun Kjærgaard*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文首次系统性地审计了软件架构研究社区中生成式AI（GenAI）工具使用的碳足迹，以及IEEE软件架构国际会议（ICSA）的传统会议活动碳足迹。研究采用两种不同的系统边界进行碳排放核算：一是探索性地估算研究论文中GenAI推理使用的碳排放，二是评估ICSA 2025会议的参会和运营碳排放（涵盖差旅、住宿、餐饮、场地能源和材料消耗）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI工具在软件架构研究中的应用日益广泛，但其计算使用的环境影响尚未得到系统记录。研究者认为有必要量化GenAI使用带来的"数字足迹"，同时反思传统学术会议活动对环境的影响，以支持更气候友好的研究文化。

Method: 研究采用两种独立的碳排放核算方法：1）使用研究-制品边界（research-artifact boundary）探索性估算已接收论文中GenAI推理使用的碳足迹；2）使用会议时间边界（conference time boundary）核算ICSA 2025的参会和运营碳排放，涵盖差旅、住宿、餐饮、场地能源消耗和材料使用。

Result: 研究提出了两个碳排放清单，展示了软件架构研究社区的数字碳足迹和物理会议活动碳足迹的不同规模，为社区透明度和反思提供数据支撑。

Conclusion: 研究讨论了可持续软件架构的启示，提出三项建议：提高GenAI使用的透明度、规划更环保的会议活动、以及提升GenAI操作的能源效率。研究成果旨在推动ICSA社区及更广泛学术界形成更气候友好的研究文化。

Abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) tools are increasingly integrated into software architecture research, yet the environmental impact of their computational usage remains largely undocumented. This study presents the first systematic audit of the carbon footprint of both the digital footprint from GenAI usage in research papers, and the traditional footprint from conference activities within the context of the IEEE International Conference on Software Architecture (ICSA). We report two separate carbon inventories relevant to the software architecture research community: i) an exploratory estimate of the footprint of GenAI inference usage associated with accepted papers within a research-artifact boundary, and ii) the conference attendance and operations footprint of ICSA 2025 (travel, accommodation, catering, venue energy, and materials) within the conference time boundary. These two inventories, with different system boundaries and completeness, support transparency and community reflection. We discuss implications for sustainable software architecture, including recommendations for transparency, greener conference planning, and improved energy efficiency in GenAI operations. Our work supports a more climate-conscious research culture within the ICSA community and beyond

</details>


### [299] [C2|Q>: A Robust Framework for Bridging Classical and Quantum Software Development -- RCR Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04112)
*Boshuai Ye,Arif Ali Khan,Teemu Pihkakoski,Peng Liang,Muhammad Azeem Akbar,Matti Silveri,Lauri Malmi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: This is the Replicated Computational Results (RCR) Report for the paper C2|Q>: A Robust Framework for Bridging Classical and Quantum Software Development. The paper introduces a modular, hardware-agnostic framework that translates classical problem specifications - Python code or structured JSON - into executable quantum programs across ten problem families and multiple hardware backends. We release the framework source code on GitHub at https://github.com/C2-Q/C2Q, a pretrained parser model on Zenodo at https://zenodo.org/records/19061125, evaluation data in a separate Zenodo record at https://zenodo.org/records/17071667, and a PyPI package at https://pypi.org/project/c2q-framework/ for lightweight CLI and API use. Experiment 1 is supported through a released pretrained model and training notebook, while Experiments 2 and 3 are directly executable via documented make targets. This report describes the artifact structure, setup instructions, and the mapping from each execution route to the corresponding experiment.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Method: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Result: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Conclusion: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Abstract: This is the Replicated Computational Results (RCR) Report for the paper C2|Q>: A Robust Framework for Bridging Classical and Quantum Software Development. The paper introduces a modular, hardware-agnostic framework that translates classical problem specifications - Python code or structured JSON - into executable quantum programs across ten problem families and multiple hardware backends. We release the framework source code on GitHub at https://github.com/C2-Q/C2Q, a pretrained parser model on Zenodo at https://zenodo.org/records/19061125, evaluation data in a separate Zenodo record at https://zenodo.org/records/17071667, and a PyPI package at https://pypi.org/project/c2q-framework/ for lightweight CLI and API use. Experiment 1 is supported through a released pretrained model and training notebook, while Experiments 2 and 3 are directly executable via documented make targets. This report describes the artifact structure, setup instructions, and the mapping from each execution route to the corresponding experiment.

</details>


### [300] [Beyond Fixed Tests: Repository-Level Issue Resolution as Coevolution of Code and Behavioral Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04580)
*Kefan Li,Yuan Yuan,Mengfei Wang,Shihao Zheng,Wei Wang,Ping Yang,Mu Li,Weifeng Lv*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出Agent-CoEvo框架，针对现有LLM修复系统将测试视为不可变约束的局限，采用代码补丁与测试补丁协同进化的多智能体方法，在SWE-bench Lite和SWT-bench Lite上优于现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代码修复系统采用线性流程，将测试作为事后验证的"静态预言机"，忽视了实际软件工程中开发者会同时迭代修订代码和测试的行为。这导致搜索空间过大、修复结果脆弱或过拟合。

Method: 提出Agent-CoEvo协同进化多智能体框架，核心思想是将代码补丁和测试补丁联合探索、迭代优化。框架不将测试视为不可变约束，而是建模为动态约束——既引导修复过程，又被修复过程修订。通过互评和语义重组，候选代码与测试逐步收敛至符合问题描述的行为空间。

Result: 在SWE-bench Lite和SWT-bench Lite基准上，Agent-CoEvo在修复成功率和测试复现质量两个维度均一致超越当前最先进的智能体方法和无智能体方法基线。

Conclusion: 修复智能体应能修订行为约束而非仅优化代码。未来的可靠问题解决需要从"仅优化代码"转向"实现与规范的协同进化"范式。

Abstract: Software engineers resolving repository-level issues do not treat existing tests as immutable correctness oracles. Instead, they iteratively refine both code and the tests used to characterize intended behavior, as new modifications expose missing assumptions or misinterpreted failure conditions. In contrast, most existing large language model (LLM)-based repair systems adopt a linear pipeline in which tests or other validation signals act mostly as post-hoc filters, treating behavioral constraints as fixed during repair. This formulation reduces repair to optimizing code under static and potentially misaligned constraints, leading to under-constrained search and brittle or overfitted fixes. We argue that repository-level issue resolution is fundamentally not optimization under fixed tests, but search over evolving behavioral constraints. To operationalize this view, we propose Agent-CoEvo, a coevolutionary multi-agent framework in which candidate code patches and test patches are jointly explored and iteratively refined. Rather than treating tests as immutable oracles, our framework models them as dynamic constraints that both guide and are revised by the repair process. Through mutual evaluation and semantic recombination, code and test candidates progressively narrow the space of behavior consistent with the issue description. Evaluated on SWE-bench Lite and SWT-bench Lite, Agent-CoEvo consistently outperforms state-of-the-art agent-based and agentless baselines in both repair success and test reproduction quality. Our findings suggest that enabling repair agents to revise behavioral constraints during search is critical for reliable issue resolution, pointing toward a shift from code-only optimization to coevolution of implementation and specification.

</details>


### [301] [MIRAGE: Online LLM Simulation for Microservice Dependency Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04806)
*XinRan Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出在线LLM模拟方法（MIRAGE），在测试运行时动态生成微服务依赖响应，无需预先生成模拟规范。通过让LLM直接读取依赖源码、调用方代码和生产轨迹来实现按需模拟。在110个测试场景中，白盒模式下达到99%的状态码保真度和99%响应结构保真度，远超传统record-replay方法的62%和16%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有微服务依赖模拟方法（record-replay、模式挖掘、规范驱动桩）在测试执行前生成静态产物，缺乏灵活性和跨请求状态维护能力。开发者常面临mock维护成本高、覆盖不全、无法适应动态场景等问题，需要一种更灵活、更高保真度的运行时模拟方案。

Method: 研究提出在线LLM模拟方法，由LLM在运行时直接响应每个依赖请求，维护跨请求状态。实现工具MIRAGE，无需预生成mock规范，模型读取依赖源码、调用方代码和生产轨迹后按需模拟依赖行为。实验在Google Online Boutique、Weaveworks Sock Shop和一个自定义系统上测试14对调用者-依赖关系共110个场景。对比record-replay基线，评估状态码保真度、响应结构保真度和端到端集成测试通过率，并进行信号消融实验（源码、typed IR约束等）。

Result: 白盒模式下MIRAGE达99%状态码保真度（109/110）和99%响应结构保真度，record-replay仅62%和16%。端到端集成测试中8/8场景与真实依赖结果一致。消融实验显示：仅依赖源码可达100%保真度；无源码时错误码正确率94%但结构准确率降至75%；使用typed IR约束输出在复杂有状态服务上仅55%保真度，简单API上86%。三种LLM家族结果稳定（差异<3%），成本$0.16-$0.82/依赖。

Conclusion: 在线LLM模拟方法在微服务依赖模拟中显著优于传统record-replay技术，依赖源码是关键的保真度驱动因素，运行时隐式状态追踪对复杂有状态服务至关重要。方法在保持高保真度的同时提供了比预生成规范更灵活的自适应能力，具备实际应用价值。

Abstract: Existing approaches to microservice dependency simulation--record-replay, pattern-mining, and specification-driven stubs--generate static artifacts before test execution. We propose online LLM simulation, a runtime approach where the LLM directly answers each dependency request as it arrives, maintaining cross-request state throughout a test scenario. No mock specification is pre-generated; the model reads the dependency's source code, caller code, and production traces, then simulates dependency behavior on demand. We instantiate this approach in MIRAGE and evaluate it on 110 test scenarios spanning 14 caller-dependency pairs across three microservice systems (Google's Online Boutique, Weaveworks' Sock Shop, and a custom system). In white-box mode (dependency source available), MIRAGE achieves 99% status-code fidelity (109/110) and 99% response-shape fidelity, compared to 62% / 16% for record-replay. End-to-end, caller integration tests produce the same pass/fail outcomes with MIRAGE as with real dependencies (8/8 scenarios). A signal ablation shows dependency source code is often sufficient for high-fidelity runtime simulation (100% alone); without it, the model still infers correct error codes (94%) but loses response-structure accuracy (75%). Constraining LLM output through typed intermediate representations reduces fidelity on complex stateful services (55%) while performing adequately on simple APIs (86%), suggesting that the runtime approach's implicit state tracking matters for behavioral complexity. Results are stable across three LLM families (within 3%) at $0.16--$0.82 per dependency.

</details>


### [302] [A Validated Taxonomy on Software Energy Smells](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04809)
*Mohammadjavad Mehditabar,Saurabhsingh Rajput,Tushar Sharma*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个全面的、与语言无关的软件能源异味（energy smells）分类体系，通过对60篇论文的系统文献综述将320个低效模式编码为12种主要能源异味和65个根本原因，并通过对21,000+个Python代码对的能量测试和LLM分类管道进行实证验证。研究发现71%的样本存在多种共现的能源异味，内存相关异味修复后节能效果最显著，且能量优化不能简单地等同于性能优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着软件在各领域的广泛普及，其总体能源足迹已成为重大环境问题。开发者需要识别和重构"能源异味"——即导致计算资源低效使用的源代码实现、设计选择或编程实践。现有能源异味目录存在局限性：领域特定、仅关注性能反模式、缺乏细粒度根本原因分类，或未针对实际测量数据进行验证。

Method: 1. 系统文献综述：对60篇论文进行系统综述及雪球抽样法；2. 分类体系构建：将320个低效模式编码为12种主要能源异味和65个根本原因；3. 实证验证：对21,000+个功能等效的Python代码对进行能量、时间、内存性能分析；4. LLM分类：使用多步骤LLM管道对前3000对代码按能量差异分类，将65个根本原因中的55个映射到实际代码。

Result: 1. 71%的样本表现出多种共现的能源异味；2. 内存相关异味修复后每项修复的节能效果最高；3. 不同模式间的功耗变化证实能量优化不能简单归约为性能优化；4. 将55个根本原因成功映射到真实代码。

Conclusion: 本研究提供了共享词汇表、可操作的重构指南和实证基础，支持能源异味检测、能源高效代码生成及绿色软件工程。研究发布了包含能量配置和推理轨迹的标注数据集，为该领域后续研究奠定基础。

Abstract: As software proliferates across domains, its aggregate energy footprint has become a major concern. To reduce software's growing environmental footprint, developers need to identify and refactor energy smells: source code implementations, design choices, or programming practices that lead to inefficient use of computing resources. Existing catalogs of such smells are either domain-specific, limited to performance anti-patterns, lack fine-grained root cause classification, or remain unvalidated against measured energy data. In this paper, we present a comprehensive, language-agnostic, taxonomy of software energy smells. Through a systematic literature review of 60 papers and exhaustive snowballing, we coded 320 inefficiency patterns into 12 primary energy smells and 65 root causes mapped to the primary smells. To empirically validate this taxonomy, we profile over 21,000 functionally equivalent Python code pairs for energy, time, and memory, and classified the top 3000 pairs by energy difference using a multi-step LLM pipeline, mapping 55 of the 65 root causes to real code. The analysis reveals that 71% of samples exhibit multiple co-occurring smells, memory-related smells yield the highest per-fix energy savings, while power draw variation across patterns confirms that energy optimization cannot be reduced to performance optimization alone. Along with the taxonomy, we release the labeled dataset, including energy profiles and reasoning traces, to the community. Together, they provide a shared vocabulary, actionable refactoring guidelines, and an empirical foundation for energy smell detection, energy-efficient code generation, and green software engineering at large.

</details>


### [303] [SysTradeBench: An Iterative Build-Test-Patch Benchmark for Strategy-to-Code Trading Systems with Drift-Aware Diagnostics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04812)
*Yuchen Cao,Hanlin Zhang,Jacky Wai Keung,Yang Chen,Linqi Song*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as quantitative research copilots to translate natural-language strategy specifications into executable trading code. Yet most existing evaluations either focus on static financial knowledge or summarize performance with a single profitability metric, leaving a gap for benchmarking strategy-to-code trading systems as governed, auditable software. We introduce SysTradeBench (SysTB), an iterative build-test-patch benchmark that evaluates LLM-generated trading systems under drift-aware diagnostics. Given a standardized Base Strategy Doc and frozen semantics, each model must produce (i) a strategy card, (ii) executable code, and (iii) mandatory audit logs. A sandboxed harness runs determinism and anti-leakage checks, detects rule drift across iterations, and returns evidence bundles to support constrained patches. SysTradeBench reports multi-dimensional scorecards for spec fidelity, risk discipline, reliability, and out-of-sample robustness indicators, together with cost-effectiveness signals. We evaluate 17 models across 12 strategies. Top models achieve validity above 91.7 percent with strong aggregate scores, but evidence-driven iteration also induces code convergence by Iter2. These findings suggest that LLM iteration complements rather than replaces human quantitative researcher governance: LLMs excel at rapid prototyping and shallow bug fixes, while human oversight remains essential for critical strategies requiring solution diversity and ensemble robustness.
