### [304] [Assessing Large Language Models for Stabilizing Numerical Expression in Scientific Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04854)
*Tien Nguyen,Muhammad Ali Gulzar,Kirshanthan Sundararajah*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文系统评估了大语言模型（LLMs）在处理浮点数数值稳定性方面的能力，通过检测和稳定两个任务测试了6种LLM在近2470个数值结构上的表现。结果显示LLMs在传统方法失效的97.9%案例中成功稳定了表达式，且在65.4%的表达式上实现了比基线更大的稳定性，但在控制流和高精度字面量方面存在明显短板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学软件依赖高精度计算，但有限浮点表示会引入精度误差并传播。在安全关键领域风险尤甚。尽管LLM在科学应用中日趋普及，但其在处理浮点数值稳定性方面的可靠性尚未得到系统评估。

Method: 通过两个数值稳定任务评估：(1) 检测任务：生成诱发错误的输入来检测数值表达式的不稳定性；(2) 稳定任务：重写表达式以提升数值稳定性。使用主流数值基准测试，对6种LLM在约2470个数值结构上进行评估，涵盖嵌套条件、高精度字面量和多变量算术。

Result: LLMs在检测和稳定数值不稳定计算方面与传统最先进方法效果相当。关键发现：①在基线方法无法改善精度的17.4%（431个）表达式中，LLMs成功稳定了其中97.9%（422个）；②在65.4%（1615个）的所有表达式上LLMs实现了比基线更大的稳定性。然而，LLMs在控制流和高精度字面量方面表现不佳，倾向于直接移除这些结构而非推理其数值含义。

Conclusion: LLMs能够有效稳定经典技术无法处理的表达式，但在精确数值量级和控制流语义推理方面存在局限。这些缺陷可能源于训练数据中缺乏此类具体模式。该研究提示LLMs可作为数值稳定性增强工具，但需针对数值精确性进行专项优化。

Abstract: Scientific software relies on high-precision computation, yet finite floating-point representations can introduce precision errors that propagate in safety-critical domains. Despite the growing use of large language models (LLMs) in scientific applications, their reliability in handling floating-point numerical stability has not been systematically evaluated. This paper evaluates LLMs' reasoning on high-precision numerical computation through two numerical stabilization tasks: (1) detecting instability in numerical expressions by generating error-inducing inputs (detection), and (2) rewriting expressions to improve numerical stability (stabilization). Using popular numerical benchmarks, we assess six LLMs on nearly 2,470 numerical structures, including nested conditionals, high-precision literals, and multi-variable arithmetic.
  Our results show that LLMs are equally effective as state-of-the-art traditional approaches in detecting and stabilizing numerically unstable computations. More notably, LLMs outperform baseline methods precisely where the latter fail: in 17.4% (431) of expressions where the baseline does not improve accuracy, LLMs successfully stabilize 422 (97.9%) of them, and achieve greater stability than the baseline across 65.4% (1,615) of all expressions. However, LLMs struggle with control flow and high-precision literals, consistently removing such structures rather than reasoning about their numerical implications, whereas they perform substantially better on purely symbolic expressions. Together, these findings suggest that LLMs are effective at stabilizing expressions that classical techniques cannot, yet struggle when exact numerical magnitudes and control flow semantics must be precisely reasoned about, as such concrete patterns are rarely encountered during training.

</details>


### [305] [StatsClaw: An AI-Collaborative Workflow for Statistical Software Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04871)
*Tianzhu Qin,Yiqing Xu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: StatsClaw通过多智能体架构解决AI生成统计软件代码的可信性问题，通过信息隔离机制确保实现、模拟和测试的独立性，并在probit估计包和多个R/Python包上验证了方法有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统计方法的软件实现是定量研究中的持久瓶颈，现有AI代码生成工具虽能快速生成代码，但无法保证忠实实现统计方法，这是统计软件的关键需求。

Method: 提出StatsClaw多智能体架构，在Claude Code上强制实施信息隔离：规划智能体生成独立规格分发给三个隔离智能体——构建者（不了解真实参数）、模拟器（不了解算法）、测试者（使用确定性标准验证）。

Result: 在probit估计包上完成端到端演示，并在三个R和Python包应用中进行评估，验证了结构化AI辅助工作流可吸收软件生命周期工程开销，同时保留研究者对方法论决策的控制权。

Conclusion: 结构化AI辅助工作流能够承担软件生命周期工程负担，同时保持研究者对每个实质性方法论决策的控制。

Abstract: Translating statistical methods into reliable software is a persistent bottleneck in quantitative research. Existing AI code-generation tools produce code quickly but cannot guarantee faithful implementation -- a critical requirement for statistical software. We introduce StatsClaw, a multi-agent architecture for Claude Code that enforces information barriers between code generation and validation. A planning agent produces independent specifications for implementation, simulation, and testing, dispatching them to separate agents that cannot see each other's instructions: the builder implements without knowing the ground-truth parameters, the simulator generates data without knowing the algorithm, and the tester validates using deterministic criteria. We describe the approach, demonstrate it end-to-end on a probit estimation package, and evaluate it across three applications to the authors' own R and Python packages. The results show that structured AI-assisted workflows can absorb the engineering overhead of the software lifecycle while preserving researcher control over every substantive methodological decision.

</details>


### [306] [ENCRUST: Encapsulated Substitution and Agentic Refinement on a Live Scaffold for Safe C-to-Rust Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04527)
*Hohyun Sim,Hyeonjoong Cho,Ali Shokri,Zhoulai Fu,Binoy Ravindran*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: We present Encapsulated Substitution and Agentic Refinement on a Live Scaffold for Safe C-to-Rust Translation, a two-phase pipeline for translating real-world C projects to safe Rust. Existing approaches either produce unsafe output without memory-safety guarantees or translate functions in isolation, failing to detect cross-unit type mismatches or handle unsafe constructs requiring whole-program reasoning. Furthermore, function-level LLM pipelines require coordinated caller updates when type signatures change, while project-scale systems often fail to produce compilable output under real-world dependency complexity. Encrust addresses these limitations by decoupling boundary adaptation from function logic via an Application Binary Interface (ABI)-preserving wrapper pattern and validating each intermediate state against the integrated codebase. Phase 1 (Encapsulated Substitution) translates each function using an ABI-preserving wrapper that splits it into two components: a caller-transparent shim retaining the original raw-pointer signature, and a safe inner function targeted by the LLM with a clean, scope-limited prompt. This enables independent per-function type changes with automatic rollback on failure, without coordinated caller updates. A deterministic, type-directed wrapper elimination pass then removes wrappers after successful translation. Phase 2 (Agentic Refinement) resolves unsafe constructs beyond per-function scope, including static mut globals, skipped wrapper pairs, and failed translations, using an LLM agent operating on the whole codebase under a baseline-aware verification gate. We evaluate Encrust on 7 GNU Coreutils programs and 8 libraries from the Laertes benchmark, showing substantial unsafe-construct reduction across all 15 programs while maintaining full test-vector correctness.

### [307] [Integrating Artificial Intelligence, Physics, and Internet of Things: A Framework for Cultural Heritage Conservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03233)
*Carmine Valentino,Federico Pichi,Francesco Colace,Dajana Conte,Gianluigi Rozza*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向文化遗产保护的四层数字孪生（DT）框架，将IoT传感数据、人工智能与物理机理知识统一到同一工作流中：基于Blender API自动处理文化资产的3D数字副本（自动三角化、网格生成、边界/内部配点采样、XDMF可视化），以有限元（RBniCS/FEniCS）离线生成快照并用POD构造降阶模型（ROM），再以物理信息神经网络（PINNs，含RBA-PINN、硬约束与加权损失）完成参数辨识（反问题）与场重构（直接问题），在岩石、柱子、庙宇三类真实几何上通过四个基准问题验证，代码全部开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文化遗产的监测与预测性维护正越来越多依赖DT、IoT传感与AI，但文献综述（Table 1：Shabani、Zhang、Dabiri、Sebouti、Anghelută、Kong & Hucks等）显示现有工作分属三类流程——基于FE数值模拟的DT、HBIM+IoT+AI的语义工作流、纯数字化文档与可视化——没有一篇能同时整合传感器数据、数据驱动方法与物理知识，导致模拟的可靠性与预测速度难以兼顾。同时，修复专家关于材料与劣化机理的领域知识（物理机理、参数标定）长期被丢弃在数据驱动模型之外；SciML（Scientific Machine Learning）的兴起提供了将物理鲁棒性、预测能力、可解释性与领域知识在不同层级融合的新范式。此外，可靠模拟的前置条件是能自动处理形状复杂、拓扑不规则的文化资产数字副本（激光扫描/摄影测量所得），现有工具链缺乏将3D模型自动接入PINN/FEM/ROM流水线的标准与流程。

Method: （1）四层功能架构：①获取层（Sensor Module采集温湿度/腐蚀/污染等环境与物理量，经IoT平台以key-value形式存储并以REST API暴露；API & Open Data接入外部环境数据；3D Model Module处理用户上传的.blend文件）；②知识库层（数据库存储传感数据、开放数据、网格、采样表、XDMF文件，含缺失值异常检测的预处理模块）；③推理引擎层（Offline Module：FEM子模块解参数化PDE生成快照，ROM Saving存储降阶基与算子；Online Module：ROM Loading与Online Solver在低维空间求解并提升回原空间；PINN Module：Inverse Problem与Direct Problem子模块；msh2xdmf模块生成可视化文件）；④应用层（Dashboard、Simulation、Upload/Download）。（2）3D模型处理：基于Blender的bpy API对模型三角化，提取点、面、尺度、位置与面法线，组织为半结构化key-value（JSON）描述；bl2msh调用GMSH自动生成网格（.msh），bl2pina将几何域描述接入PINA库以定义边界与内部积分/采样策略并支持多物体模型（岩石1个、柱子3个、庙宇9个），采样点以表格形式入库；msh2xdmf结合HDF5生成XDMF文件以分离元数据与数值数据。（3）ROM：参数化PDE A[u(x,t;μ),t;μ]=0经弱形式离散，POD（基于SVD）对快照矩阵S∈R^{N_h×M}取主模态（按保留能量阈值，默认容差1e-6），Galerkin投影到降阶空间实现多查询/实时在线求解；时间相关问题将时间视为附加参数做嵌套降阶。（4）PINN：损失由PDE残差、边界残差、初值残差与数据项加权构成（L=w_res·L_res+w_data·L_data），逆问题将物理/几何参数并入网络权重向量联合优化，测试采用RBA-PINN（Residual Feed-Forward + Transformer式残差注意力）与SWA优化器；时变问题采用硬约束û=T₀+t·u自动满足初值，并引入损失平衡与因果性策略的文献综述。（5）实验：4个基准问题（岩石Poisson、柱子抛物型系统、岩石温度监测直接问题、柱子扩散-反应系统），全部为模拟数据，代码与GitHub开源。

Result: 岩石Poisson问题（42343节点、P1元、100快照、k=25）：ROM相对全阶解误差仅4.56e-7，相对解析解的总误差7.77e-3（主要来自离散化）；PINN反问题对(λ,α,β)=(0.1,0.2,0.5)的识别相对误差分别为5.84e-3、1.20e-2、6.36e-3，训练中参数单调收敛至真值，且用辨识得到的近似参数代入降阶求解仍保持高精度。柱子抛物型系统（12375节点、20快照、k=24、N=21时间步）：奇异值指数衰减、误差随模态数指数改善；参数识别误差λ=4.05e-2、α=7.16e-3、β=5.17e-3，约5000轮即收敛；降阶解相对全阶解L²相对误差4.39e-6与2.41e-6，相对解析解为2.16e-2与9.90e-3。直接问题1（岩石24小时温度监测，9900边界数据点+400配点，30000轮，硬约束满足初值）：PINN解相对FEM基准的L²相对误差8.70e-3，验证了IoT数据与物理约束的统一融合。直接问题2（柱子扩散-反应系统，模拟腐蚀/污染物浓度）：纯物理与数据融合两方案结果相当，u^(1)误差1.18e-2→7.42e-3、u^(2)误差4.88e-3→1.01e-3、幅值误差7.60e-3→4.10e-3，证实引入传感器数据可提升真实场景监测精度。3D模型模块在岩石/柱子/庙宇三种不同拓扑复杂度上均能自动提取并生成准确网格。总体参数识别与场重构误差均在10^-2量级以下，POD显著提升计算效率以支持在线实时评估。

Conclusion: 该框架证明了融合IoT、AI与物理知识的模块化DT架构在文化遗产保护与预测性维护中的可行性与有效性：统一了3D模型自动处理、数据存储、混合仿真与专家可视化服务，以SciML（PINNs+ROMs）桥接纯数据驱动与纯物理建模，在直接与反问题、稳态与瞬态、多参数系统上均获得可靠结果，且全流程开源可复现，便于迁移到不同资产。局限与展望：框架性能强依赖输入3D模型与传感器数据的质量、一致性与几何分辨率（需在离线成本与精度间权衡）；PINN对网络架构与训练动态敏感（损失项对应NTK特征值量级差异导致收敛失衡、时间因果性、时变与多物理问题中的刚性），降阶方法也依赖解流形低维假设；未来将发展在缺乏既定物理模型时直接从数据推断动力学的策略、面向不同类别文化资产与历史建筑的专用工作流，并推广至结构健康监测与长期风险评估等更广领域。

Abstract: The conservation of cultural heritage increasingly relies on integrating technological innovation with domain expertise to ensure effective monitoring and predictive maintenance. This paper presents a novel framework to support the preservation of cultural assets, combining Internet of Things (IoT) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies, enhanced with the physical knowledge of phenomena. The framework is structured into four functional layers that permit the analysis of 3D models of cultural assets and elaborate simulations based on the knowledge acquired from data and physics. A central component of the proposed framework consists of Scientific Machine Learning, particularly Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), which incorporate physical laws into deep learning models. To enhance computational efficiency, the framework also integrates Reduced Order Methods (ROMs), specifically Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD), and is also compatible with classical Finite Element (FE) methods. Additionally, it includes tools to automatically manage and process 3D digital replicas, enabling their direct use in simulations. The proposed approach offers three main contributions: a methodology for processing 3D models of cultural assets for reliable simulation; the application of PINNs to combine data-driven and physics-based approaches in cultural heritage conservation; and the integration of PINNs with ROMs to efficiently model degradation processes influenced by environmental and material parameters. The reproducible and open-access experimental phase exploits simulated scenarios on complex and real-life geometries to test the efficacy of the proposed framework in each of its key components, allowing the possibility of dealing with both direct and inverse problems. Code availability: https://github.com/valc89/PhysicsInformedCulturalHeritage

</details>


### [308] [Scaling DPPs for RAG: Density Meets Diversity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03240)
*Xun Sun,Baiheng Xie,Li Huang,Qiang Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ScalDPP，一种基于确定性子集过程(DPP)的多样性感知的RAG检索机制，通过轻量级P-Adapter建模检索候选项间的依赖关系，并提出Diverse Margin Loss (DML)损失函数优化多样性与密度平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前RAG系统采用逐点评分方式构建上下文，忽略了检索候选项之间的交互关系，导致检索结果冗余、信息密度低且缺乏互补性证据覆盖。

Method: 1) 引入确定性子集过程(DPP)建模chunks间的依赖关系；2) 设计轻量级P-Adapter实现可扩展的多样性建模；3) 提出Diverse Margin Loss (DML)set级目标函数，在DPP几何空间强制正样本互补证据链优于等规模冗余替代方案。

Result: 实验结果验证了ScalDPP的优越性，表明该方法能有效提升检索上下文的密度与多样性覆盖。

Conclusion: 多样化检索对RAG系统至关重要，ScalDPP通过DPP和DML实现了密度与多样性的联合优化，为RAG检索提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) by grounding generation in external knowledge, yielding relevance responses that are aligned with factual evidence and evolving corpora. Standard RAG pipelines construct context through relevance ranking, performing point-wise scoring between the user query and each corpora chunk. This formulation, however, ignores interactions among retrieved candidates, leading to redundant contexts that dilute density and fail to surface complementary evidence. We argue that effective retrieval should optimize jointly for both density and diversity, ensuring the grounding evidence that is dense in information yet diverse in coverage. In this study, we propose ScalDPP, a diversity-aware retrieval mechanism for RAG that incorporates Determinantal Point Processes (DPPs) through a lightweight P-Adapter, enabling scalable modeling of inter-chunk dependencies and complementary context selection. In addition, we develop a novel set-level objective, Diverse Margin Loss (DML), that enforces ground-truth complementary evidence chains to dominate any equally sized redundant alternatives under DPP geometry. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of ScalDPP, substantiating our core statement in practice.

</details>


### [309] [DRAFT: Task Decoupled Latent Reasoning for Agent Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03242)
*Lin Wang,Junfeng Fang,Dan Zhang,Fei Shen,Xiang Wang,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DRAFT提出了一种用于工具使用LLM智能体安全监控的潜在推理框架，通过解耦的Extractor和Reasoner两阶段结构，在长轨迹中稀疏的风险证据中实现高效安全判断，准确率从63.27%提升至91.18%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具使用型LLM智能体产生长而嘈杂的交互轨迹，其中风险关键证据稀疏，标准二元监督方法难以进行有效的信用分配，需要新的安全监控范式。

Method: DRAFT将安全判断解耦为两个可训练阶段：Extractor将完整轨迹提炼为紧凑的连续潜在向量，Reasoner联合关注潜在向量和原始轨迹进行安全预测。通过在潜在空间进行证据聚合，避免了传统的"先总结后判断"的有损管道，实现端到端可微训练。

Result: 在ASSEBench和R-Judge等基准上，DRAFT持续优于强基线，平均准确率从63.27%（LoRA）提升至91.18%，且学习到更具可分性的表示。消融实验证实Extractor和Reasoner之间存在明显协同效应。

Conclusion: 在长上下文监督和稀疏证据条件下，先进行连续潜在推理再读取判断是实现鲁棒智能体安全的可行路径。

Abstract: The advent of tool-using LLM agents shifts safety monitoring from output moderation to auditing long, noisy interaction trajectories, where risk-critical evidence is sparse-making standard binary supervision poorly suited for credit assignment. To address this, we propose DRAFT (Task Decoupled Latent Reasoning for Agent Safety), a latent reasoning framework that decouples safety judgment into two trainable stages: an Extractor that distills the full trajectory into a compact continuous latent draft, and a Reasoner that jointly attends to the draft and the original trajectory to predict safety. DRAFT avoids lossy explicit summarize-then-judge pipelines by performing evidence aggregation in latent space, enabling end-to-end differentiable training.Across benchmarks including ASSEBench and R-Judge, DRAFT consistently outperforms strong baselines, improving accuracy from 63.27% (LoRA) to 91.18% averaged over benchmarks, and learns more separable representations. Ablations demonstrate a clear synergy between the Extractor and the Reasoner.Overall, DRAFT suggests that continuous latent reasoning prior to readout is a practical path to robust agent safety under long-context supervision with sparse evidence.

</details>


### [310] [General Explicit Network (GEN): A novel deep learning architecture for solving partial differential equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03321)
*Genwei Ma,Ting Luo,Ping Yang,Xing Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"通用显式网络"（GEN），将 PINN 的"点对点拟合"范式改为"点对函数拟合"：先按 PDE 物理先验显式构造时空基函数（三角函数/高斯函数），再用可训练网络非线性合成最终解，从而在保持 PINN 无需数据标签优势的同时，显著提升解的外推能力（可扩展性）与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数值方法（有限差分/有限元等）计算成本随问题维数呈指数增长，遭遇"维数灾难"；以 DeepONet、FNO、LNO、MGNO 等为代表的算子学习范式严重依赖大规模数值模拟数据、忽视 PDE 内蕴物理规律且训练开销大；以 Raissi 等 (2019) PINN 为代表的物理信息网络虽将 PDE 约束嵌入网络，但存在根本性缺陷：(1) 点对点（point-to-point）拟合，训练域内相邻点缺乏邻域相关性，导致外推区域灾难性失效；(2) 连续激活函数赋予网络"局部"特性，破坏真实解的稳定性、周期性与物理性质；(3) 现有改进（PF-PINN 的归一化+NTK 加权、SincKAN、Fourier PINN、PINO 等）仅在训练层面优化，无法从网络架构层面根除问题；(4) 学术界对 ML 解 PDE 的基准测试与价值存在广泛质疑（McGreivy & Hakim 对 82 项流体研究的元分析），PINN 甚至在简单玩具问题上不收敛。因此需要一种在架构层面显式承载解的结构性先验、具备可扩展性与鲁棒性的新范式。

Method: 核心思想：模仿级数展开（傅里叶/幂级数）的表示机制，将解写为 u = K((f_1(x),...,f_m(x)),(g_1(t),...,g_n(t)))，其中 K_θ 为可训练的合成算子（类比级数展开中的线性叠加），通过 tanh 激活实现跨基函数的非线性耦合与隐藏层状态驱动的时空调制。空间基函数 f_i 采用受频谱约束的正弦型 f_i = a_i sin(ω_i x + φ_i) + b_i；时间基函数 g_j 采用自适应局部化的高斯型 g_j = α_j exp(-(t-μ_j)²/2σ_j²)。基函数选择由 PDE 先验驱动：热方程依指数衰减先验仅约束空间维（SineGEN：N=25 个 a_i e^{-ω_i² t} sin(ω_i x)+b；GaussGEN：m=n=5 的时空高斯基乘积）；波动方程依双曲型特征线结构 x∓ct 构造方向性复合基 ψ± = φ_1(x-ct)+φ_2(x+ct)（保有限传播速度 |dx/dt|=c）；Burgers 方程无强先验，采用时空混合基并对比 25 与 100 个基。基函数参数按均匀分布初始化（a_i~U(0,1)，ω_i~iπ·U(0,1)，σ_i、μ_i~U(0,1) 及坐标域线性映射）。网络规格：输入维 M+N（基函数拼接）、单隐层 20 神经元 tanh、输出线性层。损失函数与 PINN 一致：L = MSE_PDE + λ·MSE_BC + γ·MSE_IC，通过自动微分计算 PDE 残差。PyTorch 实现，单卡 RTX 4090，Adam（β1=0.9, β2=0.999），学习率 1e-3，训练 100000 迭代。

Result: 1) 热方程：PINN 与两种 GEN 在训练域内均达到满意精度，但 PINN 在 t>2.0 的外推区出现显著偏离，仅为局部拟合；GEN 因解结构与基函数对齐，外推更稳定、精度更高；即使基函数选择不佳，GEN 精度仍与 PINN 相当，而外推能力取决于基函数性质；学到的 25 个基函数在频率/幅值上呈现类似傅里叶变换的可分析结构。2) 波动方程：训练域内 PINN 与三角基 GEN 均 satisfactory；但 PINN 与高斯基在外推区因周期延拓特性出现病态行为，而三角基的固有周期性有效保持周期延拓；高斯基在 x=1 峰值处保持光滑过渡而非尖锐转折，凸显基函数选择与人类先验的关键作用。3) Burgers 方程：三角基在 25 与 100 个基函数下均取得高精度；基函数较少时（GEN 25）在极大/极小值附近的局部细节存在可见误差，基函数增多（GEN 100）后细粒度特征捕捉能力提升——说明较少基函数即可实现全局（大规模）拟合，更多基函数改善局部细节分辨率。总体结论：GEN 在保持物理约束训练范式的同时，实现了超越 PINN 的鲁棒性与可扩展性，并为 DNN 解 PDE 建立了分析性框架。

Conclusion: GEN 通过将基函数作为架构约束系统性嵌入解的构造过程，使 DNN 解出的解携带真实解的物理结构（稳定性、周期性、可延拓性），从而兼具 PINN 的无数据标签优势与更好的外推/鲁棒性能。核心优势有三：级数表示实现区域延拓（有限项基函数借助其定义域与全局解析关系保证局部连续性与稳定）；PDE 驱动的基函数设计（将对称性、周期性等内在性质显式编码）；显式解结构可分析（借助三角谱分析可进行维度约简与优化过程中的剪枝）。局限与展望：(1) 基函数选择依赖经验启发式、尚未最优，需 PDE 领域研究者持续探索；(2) 训练收敛慢（需 100000 迭代，远超常规 PINN），需开发加速优化算法；(3) 基函数数目敏感，存在精度—参数冗余权衡，缺乏自适应的基数-参数联合优化。作者声明本人非 PDE 领域研究者，该想法源于三年前但不再继续投入，期望后续研究者完善该方法。

Abstract: Machine learning, especially physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and their neural network variants, has been widely used to solve problems involving partial differential equations (PDEs). The successful deployment of such methods beyond academic research remains limited. For example, PINN methods primarily consider discrete point-to-point fitting and fail to account for the potential properties of real solutions. The adoption of continuous activation functions in these approaches leads to local characteristics that align with the equation solutions while resulting in poor extensibility and robustness. A general explicit network (GEN) that implements point-to-function PDE solving is proposed in this paper. The "function" component can be constructed based on our prior knowledge of the original PDEs through corresponding basis functions for fitting. The experimental results demonstrate that this approach enables solutions with high robustness and strong extensibility to be obtained.

</details>


### [311] [Apparent Age Estimation: Challenges and Outcomes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03335)
*Justin Rainier Go,Lorenz Bernard Marqueses,Mikaella Kaye Martinez,John Kevin Patrick Sarmiento,Abien Fred Agarap*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本论文针对人脸图像 apparent age estimation（表观年龄估计）中的 demographic bias（人口统计偏差）问题，对 DEX 方法进行改进（集成 MVL 和 AMRL 分布学习技术），在 IMDB-WIKI、APPA-REAL 和 FairFace 数据集上验证表明：尽管 AMRL 达到 SOTA 精度，但在不同人口统计群体（Asian、African American）上性能显著下降，且 saliency maps 显示模型对不同人群的特征关注不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Apparent age estimation 在商业个性化场景中具有重要应用价值，但现有模型普遍存在 demographic bias（人口统计偏差），即对特定种族/族裔群体的估计精度明显偏低，这限制了技术的公平部署。

Method: 采用 distribution learning（分布学习）方法改进 DEX（Deep EXpectation）框架，具体使用 Mean-Variance Loss (MVL) 和 Adaptive Mean-Residue Loss (AMRL) 两种策略；在 FairFace 数据集上进行 fairness 评估，并利用 UMAP 降维分析年龄聚类特征，通过 saliency maps 可视化模型对不同 demographic groups 的特征关注模式。

Result: AMRL 在 accuracy 上达到 SOTA 水平，但在 precision 和 demographic equity 之间存在明显 trade-off；尽管 UMAP embedding 呈现清晰的年龄聚类，saliency maps 显示模型对 Asian 和 African American 人群的特征关注模式不一致，导致这些群体的性能显著下降。

Conclusion: 单纯的技术改进（如 loss function 优化）不足以解决公平性问题；实现 accurate and fair apparent age estimation 需要：1) 整合 localized and diverse datasets（本地化、多样化数据集），2) 严格遵循 fairness validation protocols（公平性验证协议）。

Abstract: Apparent age estimation is a valuable tool for business personalization, yet current models frequently exhibit demographic biases. We review prior works on the DEX method by applying distribution learning techniques such as Mean-Variance Loss (MVL) and Adaptive Mean-Residue Loss (AMRL), and evaluate them in both accuracy and fairness. Using IMDB-WIKI, APPA-REAL, and FairFace, we demonstrate that while AMRL achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, trade-offs between precision and demographic equity persist. Despite clear age clustering in UMAP embeddings, our saliency maps indicate inconsistent feature focus across demographics, leading to significant performance degradation for Asian and African American populations. We argue that technical improvements alone are insufficient; accurate and fair apparent age estimation requires the integration of localized and diverse datasets, and strict adherence to fairness validation protocols.

</details>


### [312] [NativeTernary: A Self-Delimiting Binary Encoding with Unary Run-Length Hierarchy Markers for Ternary Neural Network Weights, Structured Data, and General Computing Infrastructure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03336)
*Maharshi Savdhariya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NativeTernary 是一种面向二进制链路的自定界编码方案：将 2-bit 码字空间划分为 3 个数据符号（承载平衡三进制 {-1,0,+1} 或无符号 {0,1,2}）与 1 个保留分隔符；核心思想是用连续 N 个分隔符对（unary run-length）编码语义层级深度，字符/词/句/段/主题边界分别仅耗 2/4/6/8/10 bit，使边界开销与边界稀有度成正比。分隔符对的选择是设计参数（{11} 主方案、{00} 面向超低功耗 CMOS）。相较 GGUF，2-bit/权重视为 Q2_K 的 0.76×，在真实 BitNet b1.58 2B4T 架构上全部结构边界仅占 91 字节，比 GGUF 张量头（约 42 KB）小 460×；编解码吞吐分别 47–69 MB/s 与 35–45 MB/s，参考实现为 10 行无状态状态机（C，MIT 许可）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BitNet b1.58 等模型已证明大语言模型可完全运行在 {-1,0,+1} 三进制权重上，但其权重仍被塞入面向浮点数据的二进制容器（GGUF/SafeTensors），缺乏原生的三进制取值与层/张量边界概念，结构信息只能以外部头部、长度字段等固定宽度元数据形式叠加，成为纯开销。论文由此提出核心问题：在不更换任何硬件的前提下，能否让现有二进制基础设施在同一比特流中同时承载三进制数据与多级语义结构（其思想动机来自人类语音中的停顿结构：短停顿=词、长停顿=句、更长停顿=话题转折）。作者还记录了两条被放弃的路线：以时钟周期数（1.5 周期/2 周期）携带三态的硬件方案（受限于全球二进制基础设施与时钟抖动脆弱性而失败），以及“剥离前导零→基 3 表示→重编码”的压缩实验（三进制到二进制的转换开销抵消了大部分增益）。

Method: （1）主方案：穷举划分 2-bit 空间，{00}=符号0、{01}=符号1、{10}=符号2、{11}=保留为结构分隔符；层级由连续分隔符对的数量（unary run-length）给出，N 个对即 N 级边界，成本 2N bit，可无限扩展而无须修订规范；由于自然语言/结构化信号中边界频率随深度指数下降，总分隔符开销为 O(log N)。（2）双起始符变体：{10}、{11} 作为两类符号命名空间起始符，{00}/{01} 承载数据位，支持两套字母表或两条交织流共存于同一比特流（数据密度降为 0.5 bits/bit）。（3）平衡 vs 无符号三进制分析：无符号值 2（编码为 {10}）与分隔符 {11} 仅隔一个比特翻转，噪声信道下会产生“假边界”的非对称错误；平衡三进制无此缺陷，高噪声信道推荐平衡映射，解码器不变、语义层由流头声明。（4）遗留二进制转码路径：n bit 二进制→基 3→每 trit 用 2-bit 对，随机二进制数据约膨胀 26%，是迁移路径而非压缩路径。（5）分隔符选择：四对均可作分隔符，{11} 用或门检测、通用；{00} 用 NOR 门且零翻转活动、功耗最低，面向植入式医疗、sub-μA LoRa 节点、深空探测器；{01}/{10} 需 XNOR，留待标准化。（6）解码器：10 行无状态状态机，读 2 bit，非分隔符即发数据，遇分隔符则前瞻计数并发边界事件；分隔符由流头参数化，遇任意分隔符对即可重同步，具备抗比特流损坏能力；编译后 <200 字节，可跑在 Cortex-M/RISC-V/AVR/PIC。（7）四阶段基础设施迁移路径：应用库→OS 驱动（文件系统 inode/FAT、缓存与 NUMA 域、网络协议分帧、指令流基本块/函数边界）→固件（网卡、内存/存储控制器）→可选硅加速（2-bit 寄存器+层级计数器）。

Result: 信息论性质：数据符号信息密度 log2(3)/2 ≈ 0.792 bit/bit，为二进制信道承载三进制字母表的理论最优；英文文本中每字符分隔符开销约 0.44 bit，低于 BERT 系 [SEP]/[CLS] 固定 8–16 bit/边界；双起始符变体密度 0.5 bit/bit。存储基准：每权重 2.000 bit，对 GGUF Q2_K 2.625 bit（0.76×，省 24%）、Q4_0 4.5 bit（0.44×）、int8 8 bit（0.25×）；1M/125M/1B 三种规模下体积均同比例（250 MB vs 329 MB vs 563 MB）。吞吐：编码 46.8/69.2/62.6 MB/s，解码 35.3/45.1/35.7 MB/s（单核通用硬件）。真实 BitNet b1.58 2B4T（2B 参数、24 层、2048 隐层、FFN 5632、约 170 个张量）上，GGUF 每张量约 256 字节元数据头合计约 43,520 字节（≈42 KB）纯结构开销，而 NativeTernary 用层边界 1 对（2 bit）、张量边界 2 对（4 bit）编码 24+170 处边界共 728 bit = 91 字节，开销比 <0.0001%，较 GGUF 头小 460×，且权重数据 500 MB vs Q2_K 656 MB vs int8 2000 MB。作者明确列出四条基准假设（Q2_K 2.625 bit/权重视为估算、张量头 256 字节为估算、合成权重服从均匀 {-1,0,1} 分布而真实权重约 50% 为零、吞吐为单核数据），并称对已发布的 BitNet 2B4T 官方 checkpoint 的验证留待后续版本；C 参考实现已开源于 GitHub（MIT 许可）。

Conclusion: NativeTernary 将三进制数据与多级语义结构统一在同一 2-bit 码流中：核心机制“保留分隔符对的 unary run-length 编码层级深度”简洁且有信息论动机（类比对结构而非符号做 Huffman 编码，罕见边界分配更长码长），解码器复杂度极低（2-bit 寄存器+层级计数器）。分隔符对的四种选择均为可专利化设计参数：{11} 便于或门检测的通用主方案，{00} 面向超低功耗 CMOS 的零翻转活动变体。该方案不是通用压缩：随机稠密数据下 0.792 bit/bit 密度相对原始二进制是严格开销，仅当数据天然三进制或可化为三进制增量、层级结构有意义、且重视抗损坏自同步时才最优；无符号映射存在“数据符号与分隔符相差一个比特翻转”导致假边界的非对称噪声脆弱性，平衡映射可消除，具体部署须做信道噪声分析。向通用三进制原生计算基础设施的落地依赖库与驱动先行、再到固件、最后可选硅加速，各阶段均可增量且向后兼容。应用面涵盖三进制神经网络权重存储、层次化自然语言编码（无需改动架构即可让注意力跨度按边界层级条件化、局部位置编码按边界复位）、边缘计算与微控制器、IoT 与工业传感器（自同步带来丢包后免重传的帧恢复）、汽车 CAN/LIN/车载以太网、医疗植入与可穿戴（{00} 变体延长电池寿命）、卫星与深空遥测（1–9 kbps 高误码无重传链路）、游戏状态同步与高频交易 tick 方向流。作者同时声明已向印度专利局提交临时专利申请（2026），并披露相关利益冲突。

Abstract: BitNet b1.58 (Ma et al., 2024) demonstrates that large language models can operate entirely on ternary weights {-1, 0, +1}, yet no native binary wire format exists for such models. NativeTernary closes this gap. We present NativeTernary, a binary encoding scheme that partitions the 2-bit pair space into three data symbols representing ternary values -- either balanced {-1, 0, +1} or unsigned {0, 1, 2} -- and a reserved structural delimiter. The central contribution is the use of unary run-length encoding to represent semantic hierarchy depth: a sequence of N consecutive delimiter pairs denotes a boundary of level N, encoding character, word, sentence, paragraph, and topic boundaries at cost 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 bits respectively -- proportional to boundary rarity. The choice of which 2-bit pair serves as the delimiter is a design parameter: {11} is the primary embodiment, offering simple OR-gate detection; {00} is an alternative embodiment optimised for ultra-low-power CMOS systems, minimising switching activity. All four bit-pair choices are covered by the patent claims. We present three encoding variants: (1) the primary scheme with {11} as sole delimiter; (2) a dual-starter variant where both {10} and {11} initiate distinct symbol namespaces; and (3) an analysis of unsigned versus balanced ternary data mappings. We describe a path toward ternary-native general computing infrastructure requiring no hardware changes, and outline applications spanning ternary neural network weight storage, hierarchical natural language encoding, edge computing, IoT and satellite telemetry, industrial sensors, automotive systems, medical devices, gaming, and financial tick data. The decoder is a 10-line stateless state machine resilient to bitstream corruption.

</details>


### [313] [Towards Intelligent Energy Security: A Unified Spatio-Temporal and Graph Learning Framework for Scalable Electricity Theft Detection in Smart Grids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03344)
*AbdulQoyum A. Olowookere,Usman A. Oguntola,Ebenezer. Leke Odekanle,Maridiyah A. Madehin,Aisha A. Adesope*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出智能电网人工智能框架SGEIS（SmartGuard Energy Intelligence System），融合监督学习、深度时序建模、非侵入式负荷监测（NILM）与图学习，实现窃电与非技术损耗（NTL）检测。梯度提升分类器ROC-AUC达0.894，图模型识别高风险节点准确率超96%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 窃电与非技术损耗（NTL）造成重大经济损失并威胁电网可靠性。传统方法（如人工审计、单一分类器）难以同时刻画时间维度用电模式、拓扑空间关联与负荷级可解释性，误报率高、难以规模化部署。因此需要一种多源融合、可解释、可扩展的智能检测框架，以支撑智能电网的实际在线监测需求。

Method: 构建SGEIS综合数据处理与建模流水线：(1) 特征工程与多尺度时间分析，结合基于规则的异常标注生成监督标签；(2) 深度学习时序模块，采用LSTM、TCN与Autoencoder学习正常用电基线并检测异常消费模式；(3) 集成学习分类模块，包括Random Forest、Gradient Boosting、XGBoost、LightGBM进行窃电分类；(4) 图学习模块，以GNN建模电网拓扑与节点间空间依赖，识别互联节点上的相关异常；(5) NILM模块进行负荷分解，将聚合信号拆解至电器级消费以增强可解释性。最终将时序、统计与空间三类智能进行混合集成输出高风险节点判定。

Result: 实验表明该框架性能强劲：Gradient Boosting取得0.894的ROC-AUC；图学习模型在识别高风险节点上准确率超过96%。集成深度时序模型与图模型后，检测在时序异常、统计异常与空间关联异常上均具较好鲁棒性；NILM分解提供了电器级归因，使告警结果具备可解释性，验证了框架在真实智能电网场景中的可行性。

Conclusion: SGEIS作为一个可扩展、实用的窃电检测与智能能源监测方案，通过融合时序、统计与空间智能显著提升检测准确性与可解释性，具备在真实智能电网中部署的潜力。局限在于结果基于实验数据集验证，跨区域/跨数据集泛化性与大规模实时在线推理的工程开销仍需进一步评估。

Abstract: Electricity theft and non-technical losses (NTLs) remain critical challenges in modern smart grids, causing significant economic losses and compromising grid reliability. This study introduces the SmartGuard Energy Intelligence System (SGEIS), an integrated artificial intelligence framework for electricity theft detection and intelligent energy monitoring. The proposed system combines supervised machine learning, deep learning-based time-series modeling, Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM), and graph-based learning to capture both temporal and spatial consumption patterns. A comprehensive data processing pipeline is developed, incorporating feature engineering, multi-scale temporal analysis, and rule-based anomaly labeling. Deep learning models, including Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN), and Autoencoders, are employed to detect abnormal usage patterns. In parallel, ensemble learning methods such as Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, and LightGBM are utilized for classification. To model grid topology and spatial dependencies, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are applied to identify correlated anomalies across interconnected nodes. The NILM module enhances interpretability by disaggregating appliance-level consumption from aggregate signals. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance, with Gradient Boosting achieving a ROC-AUC of 0.894, while graph-based models attain over 96% accuracy in identifying high-risk nodes. The hybrid framework improves detection robustness by integrating temporal, statistical, and spatial intelligence. Overall, SGEIS provides a scalable and practical solution for electricity theft detection, offering high accuracy, improved interpretability, and strong potential for real-world smart grid deployment.

</details>


### [314] [Hardware-Oriented Inference Complexity of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03345)
*Bilal Khalid,Pedro Freire,Sergei K. Turitsyn,Jaroslaw E. Prilepsky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一套与平台无关的 KAN 硬件推理复杂度解析评估框架，用实数乘法数 (RM)、位运算数 (BOP)、加法与移位数 (NABS) 三个指标替代 FLOPs 与 LUT/FF/BRAM 等综合资源指标，并推导出 B-spline、GRBF、Chebyshev、Fourier 四类 KAN 变体的逐边与逐层闭式公式；结果显示同宽同深下 KAN 的硬件开销约为 MLP 的 5–6 倍，等复杂度预算下 KAN 必须采用更窄的网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KAN 将可学习激活函数置于边上，其硬件开销长期存疑。现有文献多用 FLOPs 衡量复杂度，这是面向 GPU 稠密张量训练/推理的视角；但在光通信非线性补偿、无线信道状态估计等延迟敏感、功耗受限的部署场景中，模型离线训练、推理在 FPGA/ASIC 上执行，真正瓶颈是乘法器/加法器的实例化数量，且 B 样条的局部支撑稀疏性使按 G 线性增长的 FLOPs 严重高估硬件代价。已有的硬件实现研究虽报告 BRAM/FF/LUT 等真实资源指标，但需完成完整综合流程，无法用于早期架构选型与跨平台对比，也掩盖了底层算法成本。因此需要一组可直接由网络结构算出、与平台无关的解析硬件复杂度指标。

Method: 作者沿用作者先前工作 [29] 的 RM/BOP/NABS 指标体系，对 KAN 边函数做统一的三段式分解：固定开销 C_fixed（基路径 w_b·σ(x) 及必要的输入归一化/网格索引）+ 线性组合开销 C_lin（活跃基函数与控制系数的加权点积）+ 基函数求值开销 C_basis。基函数均假设以 LUT 实现：全精度直接查表时 C_basis 的 RM/BOP 贡献为 0；若采用小表+线性插值，则给出统一的 LUT 代价 RM_LUT=1、BOP_LUT=b_δ·b_tab+Acc(2,…)、NABS_LUT 形式，并可按每边查表次数 N_LUT 累加。累加器位宽定义为 Acc(n_i,b_w,b_i)=b_w+b_i+⌈log2 n_i⌉（无溢出），并讨论了饱和截断的次阶项 C_sat/C_rnd。B-spline 采用稀疏感知实现（局部支撑，仅 k+1 项非零；Cox–de Boor 递归给出 RM_edge=(k+1)^2，改用基数样条 ROM 查表后降为 k+3），GRBF 考虑实时计算 (3N_c+1) 与 LUT 复用 (N_c+1) 两种情形，Chebyshev 为 n+2，Fourier 为 2G+1；逐层公式再叠加输出端 n_i 条边的累加位增长项。数值实验取 8 位均匀量化，网络 [3,16,16,2] 与 [3,X,X,2]（X=4…64），并以 [3,64,64,2] MLP 为基线做等复杂度（iso-complexity）扫描。

Result: 给出三类指标的逐边/逐层闭式公式（Table I）：MLP 每层 RM=n_n·n_i；B-spline n_n n_i(k+3)；GRBF n_n n_i(N_c+1)；Chebyshev n_n n_i(n+2)；Fourier n_n n_i(2G+1)；BOP/NABS 由统一的 Acc() 累加器模型扩展并按活跃项数 M_* 生成。定量结论：在 [3,16,16,2] 且 k=3、N_c=5、n=5、G=5 的设定下，B-spline KAN 相对 MLP 的 RM/BOP/NABS 开销约为 6×、5.5×、5.1×；复杂度与活跃基函数个数正相关，故 B-spline（4 项）< GRBF（5）< Chebyshev（6）< Fourier（10）。宽度扫描显示所有架构随宽度呈二次增长，KAN/MLP 开销比不随规模变化。等复杂度分析中，与 [3,64,64,2] MLP 同预算时，B-spline KAN 可用宽度约 25–29，Fourier KAN 仅 18–19，GRBF 与 Chebyshev 居中；三种指标给出的等效宽度高度一致，验证了公式体系的自洽性。

Conclusion: 该框架首次以与平台无关的解析方式统一量化四类 KAN 的推理硬件复杂度，弥补了 FLOPs 视角高估与综合后资源指标不便用于早期设计的两个缺口，可直接支持快速设计空间探索与 KAN/DNN 公平比较。结论是：同等规模下 KAN 的算术代价明显高于 MLP，若限定运算预算，KAN 必须使用更窄的网络；但这只是复杂度层面的预算约束，能否保持精度仍取决于任务，作者明确将精度—复杂度联合评估、与综合后资源指标的实际对照、以及与其他现代 DNN 的对比列为未来工作。局限性包括：不建模数据搬运与存储带宽（KAN 因每边多系数更早进入 off-chip 带宽瓶颈）、不反映时序/吞吐与流水线参数、尚未与真实 FPGA/ASIC 综合结果校验，且仅覆盖四类主流基函数族（Fractional/Wavelet 等可用同一分解方法推广）。

Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) have recently emerged as a powerful architecture for various machine learning applications. However, their unique structure raises significant concerns regarding their computational overhead. Existing studies primarily evaluate KAN complexity in terms of Floating-Point Operations (FLOPs) required for GPU-based training and inference. However, in many latency-sensitive and power-constrained deployment scenarios, such as neural network-driven non-linearity mitigation in optical communications or channel state estimation in wireless communications, training is performed offline and dedicated hardware accelerators are preferred over GPUs for inference. Recent hardware implementation studies report KAN complexity using platform-specific resource consumption metrics, such as Look-Up Tables, Flip-Flops, and Block RAMs. However, these metrics require a full hardware design and synthesis stage that limits their utility for early-stage architectural decisions and cross-platform comparisons. To address this, we derive generalized, platform-independent formulae for evaluating the hardware inference complexity of KANs in terms of Real Multiplications (RM), Bit Operations (BOP), and Number of Additions and Bit-Shifts (NABS). We extend our analysis across multiple KAN variants, including B-spline, Gaussian Radial Basis Function (GRBF), Chebyshev, and Fourier KANs. The proposed metrics can be computed directly from the network structure and enable a fair and straightforward inference complexity comparison between KAN and other neural network architectures.

</details>


### [315] [From Model-Based Screening to Data-Driven Surrogates: A Multi-Stage Workflow for Exploring Stochastic Agent-Based Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03350)
*Paul Saves,Matthieu Mastio,Nicolas Verstaevel,Benoit Gaudou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一套"多阶段"ABM探索流水线：先用基于模型的筛选（线性/树方法）识别主导变量与阈值并收缩参数空间，再用机器学习代理模型（MLP分类器）做非线性全局敏感性分析（Sobol指数）、局部解释（PDP/ICE）与不确定性量化（共形预测），从而在随机、高维的ABM中自动定位由多变量非线性交互导致的"不稳定区"与临界相变点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机Agent-Based Models（ABM）的系统性探索受制于两个核心困难：维度灾难（高维参数空间与昂贵仿真）以及内生随机性（aleatoric不确定性）。传统全局敏感性分析（GSA，如方差分解、Sobol指数）依赖大规模蒙特卡洛采样，成本高昂；局部单因子扰动（OAT）无法捕捉生态与社会仿真中典型的非单调响应和交互效应，易得出误导性参数重要性结论。此外，已有代理模型研究常把仿真器当作确定性黑箱，忽视随机种子带来的偶然不确定性与代理模型数据不足导致的认知不确定性（epistemic），在不稳定区给出过度自信的预测；同时黑箱代理缺乏可解释性，难以定位阈值与相变。论文目标不是经验校准或精确预测，而是提供可迁移、可复现、"免手工"的探索性分析与"what-if"推理框架，支持敏感性分析与政策测试。

Method: 案例研究为NetLogo实现的空间显式捕食者-食饵模型（bandicoots–foxes–grass），60×60环形网格、1000 ticks、13个连续参数加1个随机种子变量，输出为序数型种群状态（extinction=0 / prey_survival=0.5 / coexistence=1）。流水线分两阶段：Phase 1（模型驱动筛选）——LHS采样N=650配置×n=5个种子共3250次运行；以"组中位数一致率"定义理论可预测性上限（Bayes误差）得95.3%；对OLS广义线性模型做Type II ANOVA（PH解释约25.7%方差，R²=43%），χ²检验表明种子无偏（Cohen's f=1.25）；用CART回归树识别阈值（PH≈31%为临界点）；基于样本均值渐近正态性与CLT公式 n*=(Z·σ̂/ε)²、ε=±0.1、95%置信度估计所需重复数 n*=20.58，固定 n=20，并将PH∈[0,30]%、BH∈[0,20]%、BG∈[5,20]收缩聚焦共存区。Phase 2（数据驱动分析）——新LHS 650点×20次=13000次仿真，类别分布改善为16%/26%/58%，理论精度上限89.6%；训练2×128 ReLU的MLP分类器并用L2正则、分组分层10折交叉验证（精度80.1%），误差集中于共存与捕食者灭绝的亚稳边界；以预测的P(y=coexistence)作为连续韧性代理；用Sobol一阶S1与全阶ST做非线性GSA并与ANOVA对照；用PDP/ICE刻画局部响应函数；用双随机森林实现的共形预测分离σ_epistemic与σ_aleatoric，按σ_total=√(σ_aleatoric²+σ_epistemic²)合成总不确定性以定位相变区。全部代码、NetLogo模型与数据集开源。

Result: Phase 1揭示：线性模型仅解释43%方差（残差56.5%），说明高阶非线性交互占主导；PH为主导因素（≈25.7%），BH（9%）、BG（7%）次之；种子项可忽略，χ²=1.25、p>0.99表明随机初始化不改变种群区制。CART给出初级临界点PH≈31%，超过后若BH>18%则系统趋于完全灭绝（均值8%）；低狩猎区下BG<4%亦导致全灭绝（7%）。Phase 2结果：理论精度上限89.6%（至少约10%不可约随机性），MLP代理精度80.1%，误判主要位于元稳定边界；Sobol指数显示ANOVA残差>85%、几乎所有参数在1%水平下不显著，而Sobol识别BG(S_T=45.9%)、PH(38.7%)、FG(28.6%)、Gr(27.4%)、FH(21.8%)、PR(17.8%)为驱动因子，S1之和仅约31%，即69%方差来自高阶交互；二阶交互贡献55%且几乎只与前6个变量相关，三变量及以上交互仅17%；BF是特例——低阶不显著但在高阶中起"连接变量"作用。PDP/ICE给出具体阈值：BG在10–15E间进入稳定平台，FG在≈25E处非单调峰值（过低+低BG为高不稳定，过高FG导致过度捕食）；PH在≈15%出现相变点（≈12%处不确定性骤降），呈"人类干预悖论"——仅在代谢强健生态中狩猎有益，脆弱生态中加速崩塌；FH在≈35%配额前促进共存；Gr与BG交互贡献7%方差，Gr≈28%处发生区制转换（"代谢陷阱"：资源增加只在BG足够高时才促进共存）；PR在9E/t处不确定性骤降，低于此值系统对资源空间随机分布高度敏感。共形预测分解出的总不确定性峰值精确定位了结构不稳定区。总体结论是：线性方法可用于初始筛选，但无法刻画决定生态韧性的关键非线性代谢交互与阈值效应，模型行为受自上而下（捕食）与自下而上（猎物代谢与资源）双重控制共同调节。

Conclusion: 该工作贡献了一个从"基于模型的筛选"到"数据驱动的代理模型"的多阶段、层级式"zoom-in"探索框架，在保持可解释性的同时利用机器学习处理非线性，把DoE与ML代理、方差型GSA、PDP/ICE解释以及共形预测的不确定性分解统一到一条可复现流水线中，从而为随机高维ABM提供自动化的敏感性分析与政策测试手段。作者同时强调方法选择的灵活性（ANOVA vs Sobol、RF vs MLP 依模型结构而定）以及可迁移性：框架适用于存在可操作外部杠杆（监管、法律、制度约束）的仿真模型，未来将接入AutoXAI流水线自动选择分析工具。未来工作三条主线：(1) 主动学习回路——以末阶段的不确定性图作为采集函数，迭代细化输入空间探索、显著减少仿真成本；(2) 基于代理模型可微性的梯度式策略优化，自动发现稳健管理策略，用于更复杂的社会-环境数字孪生；(3) 从手工、点式校准转向对模型行为空间的自动化全局刻画。局限方面：输出0/0.5/1的序数线性编码为近似处理；初始设计存在严重类别不平衡（60%灭绝、仅13%共存）；部分参数（如FG）呈非单调效应，给出的是相关性式机制描述而非严格因果识别；代理架构与GSA方法的选择依赖具体问题。

Abstract: Systematic exploration of Agent-Based Models (ABMs) is challenged by the curse of dimensionality and their inherent stochasticity. We present a multi-stage pipeline integrating the systematic design of experiments with machine learning surrogates. Using a predator-prey case study, our methodology proceeds in two steps. First, an automated model-based screening identifies dominant variables, assesses outcome variability, and segments the parameter space. Second, we train Machine Learning models to map the remaining nonlinear interaction effects. This approach automates the discovery of unstable regions where system outcomes are highly dependent on nonlinear interactions between many variables. Thus, this work provides modelers with a rigorous, hands-off framework for sensitivity analysis and policy testing, even when dealing with high-dimensional stochastic simulators.

</details>


### [316] [The limits of bio-molecular modeling with large language models : a cross-scale evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03361)
*Yaxin Xu,Yue Zhou,Tianyu Zhao,Fengwei An,Zhixiang Ren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BioMol-LLM-Bench是一个跨尺度生物分子基准测试，包含26个下游任务和4个难度级别，用于系统评估LLM在生物分子发现中的能力。评估13个模型后发现：思维链数据收益有限；Mamba-Attention混合架构更适合长序列；监督微调以牺牲泛化能力为代价提升专业性能；LLM在分类任务表现良好但回归任务较弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物分子系统跨分子尺度的建模是科学研究的中心挑战，现有LLM在生物分子发现中的应用缺乏系统性评估，且工具增强能力的严格评估不足。

Method: 提出BioMol-LLM-Bench跨尺度生物分子基准测试，包含26个下游任务、4个难度级别，并集成计算工具进行综合评估。

Result: 对13个代表性模型的评估揭示4个主要发现：(1)思维链数据对生物任务收益有限甚至降低性能；(2)混合Mamba-Attention架构对长序列更有效；(3)监督微调以泛化能力为代价换取专业化；(4)当前LLM分类任务表现良好但回归任务较弱。

Conclusion: 该研究为未来基于LLM的分子系统建模提供了实践指导，揭示了LLM性能与机械理解之间存在系统性差距。

Abstract: The modeling of bio-molecular system across molecular scales remains a central challenge in scientific research. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to bio-molecular discovery, yet systematic evaluation across multi-scale biological problems and rigorous assessment of their tool-augmented capabilities remain limited. We reveal a systematic gap between LLM performance and mechanistic understanding through the proposed cross-scale bio-molecular benchmark: BioMol-LLM-Bench, a unified framework comprising 26 downstream tasks that covers 4 distinct difficulty levels, and computational tools are integrated for a more comprehensive evaluation. Evaluation on 13 representative models reveals 4 main findings: chain-of-thought data provides limited benefit and may even reduce performance on biological tasks; hybrid mamba-attention architectures are more effective for long bio-molecular sequences; supervised fine-tuning improves specialization at the cost of generalization; and current LLMs perform well on classification tasks but remain weak on challenging regression tasks. Together, these findings provide practical guidance for future LLM-based modeling of molecular systems.

</details>


### [317] [Scalable Variational Bayesian Fine-Tuning of LLMs via Orthogonalized Low-Rank Adapters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03388)
*Haotian Xiang,Bingcong Li,Qin Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PoLAR-VBLL框架，通过将极分解低秩适配器（PoLAR）与贝叶斯最后一层（BLL）模型结合，使用变分推断进行可扩展的贝叶斯微调，旨在解决大语言模型在安全关键应用中参数高效微调后的过度自信问题，同时实现可扩展的不确定性量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型部署到安全关键应用时存在过度自信问题，尤其是在使用参数高效微调（PEFT）处理下游领域特定任务时表现更为严重。现有方法存在局限性：基于拉普拉斯近似的后验框架可能产生次优校准；变分贝叶斯训练需要在推理时多次完整前向传播整个LLM backbone，计算成本高。

Method: 1）采用贝叶斯最后一层（BLL）模型架构，将LLM作为确定性特征提取器，仅对最后一层参数进行贝叶斯推断；2）针对LoRA的秩崩溃问题，提出极分解低秩适配器表示（PoLAR），采用正交参数化结合黎曼优化提升表达能力和稳定性；3）在VBLL框架下，通过交替优化联合学习PoLAR参数和最后一层参数的后验近似。

Result: 实验结果表明，PoLAR-VBLL在多种常识推理任务的分布内和分布外数据上，均能有效提升模型的泛化能力和不确定性估计性能。

Conclusion: PoLAR-VBLL是一个灵活的框架，成功将架构增强优化与可扩展贝叶斯推断相结合，能够为LLM提供校准良好的不确定性量化能力，在保持PEFT效率的同时有效缓解过度自信问题。

Abstract: When deploying large language models (LLMs) to safety-critical applications, uncertainty quantification (UQ) is of utmost importance to self-assess the reliability of the LLM-based decisions. However, such decisions typically suffer from overconfidence, particularly after parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) for downstream domain-specific tasks with limited data. Existing methods to alleviate this issue either rely on Laplace approximation based post-hoc framework, which may yield suboptimal calibration depending on the training trajectory, or variational Bayesian training that requires multiple complete forward passes through the entire LLM backbone at inference time for Monte Carlo estimation, posing scalability challenges for deployment. To address these limitations, we build on the Bayesian last layer (BLL) model, where the LLM-based deterministic feature extractor is followed by random last layer parameters for uncertainty reasoning. Since existing low-rank adapters (LoRA) for PEFT have limited expressiveness due to rank collapse, we address this with Polar-decomposed Low-rank Adapter Representation (PoLAR), an orthogonalized parameterization paired with Riemannian optimization to enable more stable and expressive adaptation. Building on this PoLAR-BLL model, we leverage the variational (V) inference framework to put forth a scalable Bayesian fine-tuning approach which jointly seeks the PoLAR parameters and approximate posterior of the last layer parameters via alternating optimization. The resulting PoLAR-VBLL is a flexible framework that nicely integrates architecture-enhanced optimization with scalable Bayesian inference to endow LLMs with well-calibrated UQ. Our empirical results verify the effectiveness of PoLAR-VBLL in terms of generalization and uncertainty estimation on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data for various common-sense reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [318] [Beauty in the Eye of AI: Aligning LLMs and Vision Models with Human Aesthetics in Network Visualization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03417)
*Peng Zhang,Xuefeng Li,Xiaoqi Wang,Han-Wei Shen,Yifan Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Network visualization has traditionally relied on heuristic metrics, such as stress, under the assumption that optimizing them leads to aesthetic and informative layouts. However, no single metric consistently produces the most effective results. A data-driven alternative is to learn from human preferences, where annotators select their favored visualization among multiple layouts of the same graphs. These human-preference labels can then be used to train a generative model that approximates human aesthetic preferences. However, obtaining human labels at scale is costly and time-consuming. As a result, this generative approach has so far been tested only with machine-labeled data. In this paper, we explore the use of large language models (LLMs) and vision models (VMs) as proxies for human judgment. Through a carefully designed user study involving 27 participants, we curated a large set of human preference labels. We used this data both to better understand human preferences and to bootstrap LLM/VM labelers. We show that prompt engineering that combines few-shot examples and diverse input formats, such as image embeddings, significantly improves LLM-human alignment, and additional filtering by the confidence score of the LLM pushes the alignment to human-human levels. Furthermore, we demonstrate that carefully trained VMs can achieve VM-human alignment at a level comparable to that between human annotators. Our results suggest that AI can feasibly serve as a scalable proxy for human labelers.

### [319] [Adaptive Threshold-Driven Continuous Greedy Method for Scalable Submodular Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03419)
*Mohammadreza Rostami,Solmaz S. Kia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Submodular maximization under matroid constraints is a fundamental problem in combinatorial optimization with applications in sensing, data summarization, active learning, and resource allocation. While the Sequential Greedy (SG) algorithm achieves only a $\frac{1}{2}$-approximation due to irrevocable selections, Continuous Greedy (CG) attains the optimal $\bigl(1-\frac{1}{e}\bigr)$-approximation via the multilinear relaxation, at the cost of a progressively dense decision vector that forces agents to exchange feature embeddings for nearly every ground-set element. We propose \textit{ATCG} (\underline{A}daptive \underline{T}hresholded \underline{C}ontinuous \underline{G}reedy), which gates gradient evaluations behind a per-partition progress ratio $η_i$, expanding each agent's active set only when current candidates fail to capture sufficient marginal gain, thereby directly bounding which feature embeddings are ever transmitted. Theoretical analysis establishes a curvature-aware approximation guarantee with effective factor $τ_{\mathrm{eff}}=\max\{τ,1-c\}$, interpolating between the threshold-based guarantee and the low-curvature regime where \textit{ATCG} recovers the performance of CG. Experiments on a class-balanced prototype selection problem over a subset of the CIFAR-10 animal dataset show that \textit{ATCG} achieves objective values comparable to those of the full CG method while substantially reducing communication overhead through adaptive active-set expansion.

### [320] [Adversarial Robustness of Deep State Space Models for Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03427)
*Sribalaji C. Anand,George J. Pappas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: State-space model (SSM) for time-series forecasting have demonstrated strong empirical performance on benchmark datasets, yet their robustness under adversarial perturbations is poorly understood. We address this gap through a control-theoretic lens, focusing on the recently proposed Spacetime SSM forecaster. We first establish that the decoder-only Spacetime architecture can represent the optimal Kalman predictor when the underlying data-generating process is autoregressive - a property no other SSM possesses. Building on this, we formulate robust forecaster design as a Stackelberg game against worst-case stealthy adversaries constrained by a detection budget, and solve it via adversarial training. We derive closed-form bounds on adversarial forecasting error that expose how open-loop instability, closed-loop instability, and decoder state dimension each amplify vulnerability - offering actionable principles towards robust forecaster design. Finally, we show that even adversaries with no access to the forecaster can nonetheless construct effective attacks by exploiting the model's locally linear input-output behavior, bypassing gradient computations entirely. Experiments on the Monash benchmark datasets highlight that model-free attacks, without any gradient computation, can cause at least 33% more error than projected gradient descent with a small step size.

### [321] [Representational Collapse in Multi-Agent LLM Committees: Measurement and Diversity-Aware Consensus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03809)
*Dipkumar Patel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Multi-agent LLM committees replicate the same model under different role prompts and aggregate outputs by majority vote, implicitly assuming that agents contribute complementary evidence. We embed each agent's chain-of-thought rationale and measure pairwise similarity: across 100 GSM8K questions with three Qwen2.5-14B agents, mean cosine similarity is 0.888 and effective rank is 2.17 out of 3.0, a failure mode we term representational collapse. DALC, a training-free consensus protocol that computes diversity weights from embedding geometry, reaches 87% on GSM8K versus 84% for self-consistency at 26% lower token cost. Ablation experiments reveal 1-3 point per-protocol run-to-run variance, confirm that hint sharing contributes more than diversity weighting alone, and show that encoder choice strongly modulates collapse severity (cosine 0.908 with mxbai versus 0.888 with nomic) and downstream accuracy. The more robust finding is that collapse is measurable, worsens on harder tasks, and that the choice of embedding proxy is a first-order design decision for any latent communication protocol.

### [322] [MetaSAEs: Joint Training with a Decomposability Penalty Produces More Atomic Sparse Autoencoder Latents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03436)
*Matthew Levinson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种联合训练目标，通过小型meta SAE重建主SAE的解码器列来惩罚子空间混合问题，使SAE潜在特征更加原子化（每个潜在特征代表单一一致概念）。在GPT-2 large上，mean |φ|降低7.5%，fuzzing分数提升7.6%；在Gemma 2 9B上，ΔFuzz提升8.6%。定性分析证实多语义token上的特征被分解为语义distinct的子特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前SAE的潜在特征存在"子空间混合"问题——单一特征可能在语义上distinct且无共同表征基础的不同上下文中激活，导致特征不够原子化。这对安全相关应用（对齐检测、模型引导）造成困扰。

Method: 引入小型meta SAE与主SAE联合训练：meta SAE的任务是稀疏重建主SAE的解码器方向。当主SAE的解码器方向位于其他解码器方向张成的子空间中时，容易被meta字典稀疏压缩，此时对主SAE施加惩罚。这创造梯度压力促使解码器方向更加相互独立，从而抵抗稀疏meta压缩。

Result: 在GPT-2 large (layer 20)上，mean |φ|降低7.5%（相对于相同数据和架构的solo SAE基线），fuzzing分数提升7.6%。在Gemma 2 9B上，ΔFuzz提升8.6%。定性分析显示，多语义token上的特征被分解为语义distinct的子特征。

Conclusion: 通过meta SAE辅助的联合训练目标可有效减少SAE的子空间混合问题，提高特征的原子性，且重构开销适中，方法具有一定的跨模型迁移性。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are increasingly used for safety-relevant applications including alignment detection and model steering. These use cases require SAE latents to be as atomic as possible. Each latent should represent a single coherent concept drawn from a single underlying representational subspace. In practice, SAE latents blend representational subspaces together. A single feature can activate across semantically distinct contexts that share no true common representation, muddying an already complex picture of model computation. We introduce a joint training objective that directly penalizes this subspace blending. A small meta SAE is trained alongside the primary SAE to sparsely reconstruct the primary SAE's decoder columns; the primary SAE is penalized whenever its decoder directions are easy to reconstruct from the meta dictionary. This occurs whenever latent directions lie in a subspace spanned by other primary directions. This creates gradient pressure toward more mutually independent decoder directions that resist sparse meta-compression.
  On GPT-2 large (layer 20), the selected configuration reduces mean $|\varphi|$ by 7.5% relative to an identical solo SAE trained on the same data. Automated interpretability (fuzzing) scores improve by 7.6%, providing external validation of the atomicity gain independent of the training and co-occurrence metrics. Reconstruction overhead is modest. Results on Gemma 2 9B are directional. On not-fully-converged SAEs, the same parameterization yields the best results, a $+8.6\%$ $Δ$Fuzz. Though directional, this is an encouraging sign that the method transfers to a larger model. Qualitative analysis confirms that features firing on polysemantic tokens are split into semantically distinct sub-features, each specializing in a distinct representational subspace.

</details>


### [323] [Olmo Hybrid: From Theory to Practice and Back](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03444)
*William Merrill,Yanhong Li,Tyler Romero,Anej Svete,Caia Costello,Pradeep Dasigi,Dirk Groeneveld,David Heineman,Bailey Kuehl,Nathan Lambert,Jacob Morrison,Luca Soldaini,Finbarr Timbers,Pete Walsh,Noah A. Smith,Hannaneh Hajishirzi,Ashish Sabharwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文论证了混合注意力与线性RNN的混合模型相比纯Transformer的优势。理论上证明混合模型可表达超越两者的任务（如代码执行），实践上训练了7B参数的Olmo Hybrid模型，在标准预训练和中期训练评估中优于Olmo 3，且Scaling效率显著更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非Transformer语言模型（尤其是线性RNN和混合模型）展现出潜力，但学界对是否值得投入资源Scaling这些架构缺乏共识。现需证据证明混合模型的优势是否足以弥补其风险和努力。

Method: 1. 理论层面：证明混合模型不仅继承Transformer和线性RNN的表达力，还能表达超越两者的任务（如代码执行）。2. 实践层面：训练Olmo Hybrid（7B参数），将滑动窗口层替换为Gated DeltaNet层，与Olmo 3 7B进行对比实验。3. 理论分析：解释为何更强的表达力应转化为更好的Scaling效率。

Result: 1. 混合模型在理论上可超越Transformer和线性RNN的表达能力边界。2. Olmo Hybrid在标准预训练和中期训练评估中优于Olmo 3。3. 混合模型的Scaling效率显著高于Transformer。4. 理论解释了更强表达力与更好Scaling之间的联系。

Conclusion: 混合注意力与循环层的模型是语言建模范式的强力扩展。其价值不仅是推理时降低内存，更是作为获得更具表达力模型的基本方式，能在预训练阶段实现更好的Scaling。混合模型是未来大规模语言模型的重要发展方向。

Abstract: Recent work has demonstrated the potential of non-transformer language models, especially linear recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and hybrid models that mix recurrence and attention. Yet there is no consensus on whether the potential benefits of these new architectures justify the risk and effort of scaling them up. To address this, we provide evidence for the advantages of hybrid models over pure transformers on several fronts. First, theoretically, we show that hybrid models do not merely inherit the expressivity of transformers and linear RNNs, but can express tasks beyond both, such as code execution. Putting this theory to practice, we train Olmo Hybrid, a 7B-parameter model largely comparable to Olmo 3 7B but with the sliding window layers replaced by Gated DeltaNet layers. We show that Olmo Hybrid outperforms Olmo 3 across standard pretraining and mid-training evaluations, demonstrating the benefit of hybrid models in a controlled, large-scale setting. We find that the hybrid model scales significantly more efficiently than the transformer, explaining its higher performance. However, its unclear why greater expressivity on specific formal problems should result in better scaling or superior performance on downstream tasks unrelated to those problems. To explain this apparent gap, we return to theory and argue why increased expressivity should translate to better scaling efficiency, completing the loop. Overall, our results suggest that hybrid models mixing attention and recurrent layers are a powerful extension to the language modeling paradigm: not merely to reduce memory during inference, but as a fundamental way to obtain more expressive models that scale better during pretraining.

</details>


### [324] [Sampling Parallelism for Fast and Efficient Bayesian Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04736)
*Asena Karolin Özdemir,Lars H. Heyen,Arvid Weyrauch,Achim Streit,Markus Götz,Charlotte Debus*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Machine learning models, and deep neural networks in particular, are increasingly deployed in risk-sensitive domains such as healthcare, environmental forecasting, and finance, where reliable quantification of predictive uncertainty is essential. However, many uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods remain difficult to apply due to their substantial computational cost. Sampling-based Bayesian learning approaches, such as Bayesian neural networks (BNNs), are particularly expensive since drawing and evaluating multiple parameter samples rapidly exhausts memory and compute resources. These constraints have limited the accessibility and exploration of Bayesian techniques thus far. To address these challenges, we introduce sampling parallelism, a simple yet powerful parallelization strategy that targets the primary bottleneck of sampling-based Bayesian learning: the samples themselves. By distributing sample evaluations across multiple GPUs, our method reduces memory pressure and training time without requiring architectural changes or extensive hyperparameter tuning. We detail the methodology and evaluate its performance on a few example tasks and architectures, comparing against distributed data parallelism (DDP) as a baseline. We further demonstrate that sampling parallelism is complementary to existing strategies by implementing a hybrid approach that combines sample and data parallelism. Our experiments show near-perfect scaling when the sample number is scaled proportionally to the computational resources, confirming that sample evaluations parallelize cleanly. Although DDP achieves better raw speedups under scaling with constant workload, sampling parallelism has a notable advantage: by applying independent stochastic augmentations to the same batch on each GPU, it increases augmentation diversity and thus reduces the number of epochs required for convergence.

Conclusion: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

### [325] [Neural Operators for Multi-Task Control and Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03449)
*David Sewell,Xingjian Li,Stepan Tretiakov,Krishna Kumar,David Fridovich-Keil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Neural operator methods have emerged as powerful tools for learning mappings between infinite-dimensional function spaces, yet their potential in optimal control remains largely unexplored. We focus on multi-task control problems, whose solution is a mapping from task description (e.g., cost or dynamics functions) to optimal control law (e.g., feedback policy). We approximate these solution operators using a permutation-invariant neural operator architecture. Across a range of parametric optimal control environments and a locomotion benchmark, a single operator trained via behavioral cloning accurately approximates the solution operator and generalizes to unseen tasks, out-of-distribution settings, and varying amounts of task observations. We further show that the branch-trunk structure of our neural operator architecture enables efficient and flexible adaptation to new tasks. We develop structured adaptation strategies ranging from lightweight updates to full-network fine-tuning, achieving strong performance across different data and compute settings. Finally, we introduce meta-trained operator variants that optimize the initialization for few-shot adaptation. These methods enable rapid task adaptation with limited data and consistently outperform a popular meta-learning baseline. Together, our results demonstrate that neural operators provide a unified and efficient framework for multi-task control and adaptation.

### [326] [Three Phases of Expert Routing: How Load Balance Evolves During Mixture-of-Experts Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04230)
*Charafeddine Mouzouni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将MoE专家路由建模为拥塞博弈，通过单一参数γ_eff量化平衡-质量权衡。对OLMoE-1B-7B（20个检查点）和OpenMoE-8B（6个检查点）训练过程的追踪揭示了三阶段轨迹： surge phase（γ_eff: 14→36-39）、stabilization phase（B_0稳定在2.3-2.4）、relaxation phase（γ_eff: 27→9）。该非单调轨迹表明早期MoE训练优先平衡，晚期优先质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解MoE训练动态：从收敛模型的post-hoc分析无法揭示训练过程中的平衡-质量权衡演化，缺少统一理论框架。

Method: 1. 将MoE token路由建模为拥塞博弈（congestion game）
2. 引入单一有效参数γ_eff量化平衡-质量权衡
3. 跨训练检查点追踪γ_eff变化
4. 多类型扩展：基于token聚类的有效拥塞分解
5. 验证：16层平均提升30%负载预测精度，四种独立质量估计器验证（r≥0.89）

Result: 发现三阶段轨迹：Surge phase（γ_eff: 14→36-39，step 30K-40K峰值）→ Stabilization phase（B_0: 2.4→2.3，step 100K-400K）→ Relaxation phase（γ_eff: 27→9，step 400K-1.2M）。单类型均衡退化为温度缩放softmax（L1: MFG=0.199 vs softmax=0.200）。

Conclusion: 1. 博弈论揭示了温度参数的演化含义，而非替代softmax预测
2. 早期训练优先平衡（surge），晚期训练优先质量（relaxation）
3. 该非单调轨迹对收敛模型的post-hoc分析不可见
4. 多类型扩展有效提升负载预测（16层平均30%）

Abstract: We model Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) token routing as a congestion game with a single effective parameter, the congestion coefficient gamma_eff, that quantifies the balance-quality tradeoff. Tracking gamma_eff across training checkpoints of two open-source MoE models, OLMoE-1B-7B (20 checkpoints, with dense sampling in the surge region) and OpenMoE-8B (6 checkpoints), reveals a three-phase trajectory: a surge phase where the router learns to balance load (gamma_eff: 14 to 36-39, peaking in the step 30K-40K region), a stabilization phase where experts specialize under steady balance (B_0: 2.4 to 2.3, steps 100K-400K), and a relaxation phase where the router trades balance for quality as experts differentiate (gamma_eff: 27 to 9, steps 400K-1.2M). This non-monotone trajectory, invisible to post-hoc analysis of converged models, reveals that early MoE training prioritizes balance while late training prioritizes quality. The theoretical framework is honest about its limits: the single-type equilibrium reduces to temperature-scaled softmax (held-out L1: MFG = 0.199 vs. softmax = 0.200). The game is not a better predictor; it reveals what the temperature means and, critically, how that temperature evolves. We complement the dynamics with an effective congestion decomposition, a multi-type extension that improves load prediction via token clustering on all 16 layers (mean: 30%), scope diagnostics (K/M, epsilon_l), and robustness verification across four independent quality estimators (r >= 0.89). All confidence intervals are from bootstrap resampling over 50 independent text batches.

</details>


### [327] [Earth Embeddings Reveal Diverse Urban Signals from Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03456)
*Wenjing Gong,Udbhav Srivastava,Yuchen Wang,Yuhao Jia,Qifan Wu,Weishan Bai,Yifan Yang,Xiao Huang,Xinyue Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究基准测试了三种地球嵌入模型（AlphaEarth、Prithvi、Clay）在城市监测中的表现，发现这些模型能够有效从卫星图像预测社区级城市指标，尤其对与建成环境结构直接相关的指标（如慢性病负担、主要通勤模式）预测效果最佳，但对行为性指标（如骑行）预测困难。模型性能在不同城市间差异显著，但在时间维度上保持稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统城市指标（普查、调查、行政记录）存在成本高、空间不一致、更新慢等问题。地球嵌入模型（如AlphaEarth、Prithvi、Clay）能否成为可扩展、低成本的城市监测替代方案尚不明确。

Method: 在6个美国大都市区（2020-2023年）构建统一监督学习框架，使用地球嵌入预测14项社区级指标（犯罪、收入、健康、出行行为），设置全球、城市级、年份级、城市-年份级四种评估场景。

Result: （1）地球嵌入捕获大量城市变异；（2）与建成环境结构直接相关的指标（如慢性健康负担、主要通勤模式）预测效果最佳；（3）行为性/政策敏感性指标（如骑行）难以预测；（4）跨城市性能差异显著，跨年性能稳定；（5）64维AlphaEarth嵌入优于64维Prithvi/Clay。

Conclusion: 本研究为评估地球嵌入在城市遥感中的应用提供了基准，证明了其在可持续发展目标（SDG）对标的城市尺度监测中作为可扩展、低成本特征的潜力。

Abstract: Conventional urban indicators derived from censuses, surveys, and administrative records are often costly, spatially inconsistent, and slow to update. Recent geospatial foundation models enable Earth embeddings, compact satellite image representations transferable across downstream tasks, but their utility for neighborhood-scale urban monitoring remains unclear. Here, we benchmark three Earth embedding families, AlphaEarth, Prithvi, and Clay, for urban signal prediction across six U.S. metropolitan areas from 2020 to 2023. Using a unified supervised-learning framework, we predict 14 neighborhood-level indicators spanning crime, income, health, and travel behavior, and evaluate performance under four settings: global, city-wise, year-wise, and city-year. Results show that Earth embeddings capture substantial urban variation, with the highest predictive skill for outcomes more directly tied to built-environment structure, including chronic health burdens and dominant commuting modes. By contrast, indicators shaped more strongly by fine-scale behavior and local policy, such as cycling, remain difficult to infer. Predictive performance varies markedly across cities but remains comparatively stable across years, indicating strong spatial heterogeneity alongside temporal robustness. Exploratory analysis suggests that cross-city variation in predictive performance is associated with urban form in task-specific ways. Controlled dimensionality experiments show that representation efficiency is critical: compact 64-dimensional AlphaEarth embeddings remain more informative than 64-dimensional reductions of Prithvi and Clay. This study establishes a benchmark for evaluating Earth embeddings in urban remote sensing and demonstrates their potential as scalable, low-cost features for SDG-aligned neighborhood-scale urban monitoring.

</details>


### [328] [Super Agents and Confounders: Influence of surrounding agents on vehicle trajectory prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03463)
*Daniel Jost,Luca Paparusso,Martin Stoll,Jörg Wagner,Raghu Rajan,Joschka Bödecker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: In highly interactive driving scenes, trajectory prediction is conditioned on information from surrounding traffic participants such as cars and pedestrians. Our main contribution is a comprehensive analysis of state-of-the-art trajectory predictors, which reveals a surprising and critical flaw: many surrounding agents degrade prediction accuracy rather than improve it. Using Shapley-based attribution, we rigorously demonstrate that models learn unstable and non-causal decision-making schemes that vary significantly across training runs. Building on these insights, we propose to integrate a Conditional Information Bottleneck (CIB), which does not require additional supervision and is trained to effectively compress agent features as well as ignore those that are not beneficial for the prediction task. Comprehensive experiments using multiple datasets and model architectures demonstrate that this simple yet effective approach not only improves overall trajectory prediction performance in many cases but also increases robustness to different perturbations. Our results highlight the importance of selectively integrating contextual information, which can often contain spurious or misleading signals, in trajectory prediction. Moreover, we provide interpretable metrics for identifying non-robust behavior and present a promising avenue towards a solution.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Method: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Result: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Conclusion: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

### [329] [Investigating Data Interventions for Subgroup Fairness: An ICU Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03478)
*Erin Tan,Judy Hanwen Shen,Irene Y. Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究了医疗场景中组合不同数据源改善子群体模型性能的局限性，发现数据添加既可能改善也可能损害模型公平性与性能，且直觉性的数据选择策略往往不可靠，需要结合模型后校准与数据策略两种方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在医疗等高风险场景中，算法偏见会加剧对特定人群的伤害。尽管"修复数据"是常见干预手段，但实际中可用的额外数据源往往不理想，数据规模的增加可能被分布偏移所抵消，导致子群体性能改善具有不稳定性。

Method: 研究在eICU和MIMIC-IV两个数据集上，通过实验比较模型无关的后验校准（post-hoc calibration）与以数据为中心的添加策略（data-centric addition），评估不同数据组合方式对子群体性能与公平性的影响。

Result: 数据添加对模型公平性和性能的改善效果不稳定——既可能帮助也可能伤害模型；直觉性的数据选择策略不可靠；模型校准与数据策略相结合才能有效改善子群体表现。

Conclusion: 质疑"更好的数据"就能解决公平性挑战的传统观点，证明单纯依靠数据质量改进并不充分，必须同时采用数据策略与模型校准两种手段才能提升机器学习在敏感应用中的公平性。

Abstract: In high-stakes settings where machine learning models are used to automate decision-making about individuals, the presence of algorithmic bias can exacerbate systemic harm to certain subgroups of people. These biases often stem from the underlying training data. In practice, interventions to "fix the data" depend on the actual additional data sources available -- where many are less than ideal. In these cases, the effects of data scaling on subgroup performance become volatile, as the improvements from increased sample size are counteracted by the introduction of distribution shifts in the training set. In this paper, we investigate the limitations of combining data sources to improve subgroup performance within the context of healthcare. Clinical models are commonly trained on datasets comprised of patient electronic health record (EHR) data from different hospitals or admission departments. Across two such datasets, the eICU Collaborative Research Database and the MIMIC-IV dataset, we find that data addition can both help and hurt model fairness and performance, and many intuitive strategies for data selection are unreliable. We compare model-based post-hoc calibration and data-centric addition strategies to find that the combination of both is important to improve subgroup performance. Our work questions the traditional dogma of "better data" for overcoming fairness challenges by comparing and combining data- and model-based approaches.

</details>


### [330] [Improving Feasibility via Fast Autoencoder-Based Projections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03489)
*Maria Chzhen,Priya L. Donti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于自编码器的数据驱动方法，将非凸可行集映射到凸潜在空间实现快速约束修正。相比传统求解器，该方法计算成本低，适用于约束优化和强化学习问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在真实世界的学习和控制系统中，强制执行复杂（如非凸）操作约束是一项关键挑战。现有方法难以高效地强制执行一般类别的约束。

Method: 提出一种新的数据驱动摊销方法，使用训练好的自编码器作为近似投影器。具体地，使用对抗性目标训练自编码器，学习可行集的凸潜在表示，然后通过将潜在表示投影到简单凸形状上再解码回原始可行集来快速修正不可行预测。

Result: 该方法在具有挑战性非凸约束的约束优化和强化学习问题上进行了测试，结果表明该方法能以较低的计算成本有效强制执行约束。

Conclusion: 该方法为昂贵的传统求解器可行性修正技术提供了一种实用的替代方案。

Abstract: Enforcing complex (e.g., nonconvex) operational constraints is a critical challenge in real-world learning and control systems. However, existing methods struggle to efficiently enforce general classes of constraints. To address this, we propose a novel data-driven amortized approach that uses a trained autoencoder as an approximate projector to provide fast corrections to infeasible predictions. Specifically, we train an autoencoder using an adversarial objective to learn a structured, convex latent representation of the feasible set. This enables rapid correction of neural network outputs by projecting their associated latent representations onto a simple convex shape before decoding into the original feasible set. We test our approach on a diverse suite of constrained optimization and reinforcement learning problems with challenging nonconvex constraints. Results show that our method effectively enforces constraints at a low computational cost, offering a practical alternative to expensive feasibility correction techniques based on traditional solvers.

</details>


### [331] [Online learning of smooth functions on $\mathbb{R}$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03525)
*Jesse Geneson,Kuldeep Singh,Alexander Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究实数线上对抗性在线学习问题，考察累积p-损失下函数类G_q的学习难度。主要发现：标准模型在ℝ上对任意p≥1和q>1是不适定的（对手可强迫无限损失）。为此提出三种修改场景限制远离历史查询的影响，并在这些场景下获得尖锐特征。特别地，场景3存在相变现象；多维情形(d≥2)即使在修改场景下仍无法避免无限损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准对抗性在线学习模型在实数域ℝ上对函数类G_q（导数L^q范数有界的绝对连续函数）变得不适定：对于任意p≥1和q>1，对手可通过策略性查询强迫学习器产生无限累积损失。这促使作者探索三种修改场景来规避这一根本性障碍。

Method: 设计三种修改学习场景：(1)限制对手每次查询在历史查询的距离1以内；(2)仅对距离历史查询1以内的轮次计算损失；(3)引入与最近历史查询距离相关的衰减权重函数g(·)。对每种场景进行最坏情况分析，寻找对手策略与学习器最优上界的匹配下界。

Result: 场景1-2在多种机制下获得尖锐特征；场景3揭示清洁的相变现象——若g衰减过慢对手可强迫无限加权损失，而快速衰减如指数衰减g(z)=e^{-cz}在二次情形p=q=2下可获得有限且尖锐的保证；多维切片类G_{q,d}对任意d≥2，即使在三种修改场景下对手仍可强迫无限损失。

Conclusion: 一维情形在修改场景下可学习，核心在于限制查询的空间分散性；多维扩展本质性地失效，d≥2时切片类过于宽松。指数权重方案为防止无限损失提供了有效机制，研究为高维在线学习提供了重要的负面结果和正面保证。

Abstract: We study adversarial online learning of real-valued functions on $\mathbb{R}$. In each round the learner is queried at $x_t\in\mathbb{R}$, predicts $\hat y_t$, and then observes the true value $f(x_t)$; performance is measured by cumulative $p$-loss $\sum_{t\ge 1}|\hat y_t-f(x_t)|^p$. For the class \[ \mathcal{G}_q=\Bigl\{f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}\ \text{absolutely continuous}:\ \int_{\mathbb{R}}|f'(x)|^q\,dx\le 1\Bigr\}, \] we show that the standard model becomes ill-posed on $\mathbb{R}$: for every $p\ge 1$ and $q>1$, an adversary can force infinite loss. Motivated by this obstruction, we analyze three modified learning scenarios that limit the influence of queries that are far from previously observed inputs. In Scenario 1 the adversary must choose each new query within distance $1$ of some past query. In Scenario 2 the adversary may query anywhere, but the learner is penalized only on rounds whose query lies within distance $1$ of a past query. In Scenario 3 the loss in round $t$ is multiplied by a weight $g(\min_{j<t}|x_t-x_j|)$.
  We obtain sharp characterizations for Scenarios 1-2 in several regimes. For Scenario 3 we identify a clean threshold phenomenon: if $g$ decays too slowly, then the adversary can force infinite weighted loss. In contrast, for rapidly decaying weights such as $g(z)=e^{-cz}$ we obtain finite and sharp guarantees in the quadratic case $p=q=2$. Finally, we study a natural multivariable slice generalization $\mathcal{G}_{q,d}$ of $\mathcal{G}_q$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$ and show a sharp dichotomy: while the one-dimensional case admits finite opt-values in certain regimes, for every $d\ge 2$ the slice class $\mathcal{G}_{q,d}$ is too permissive, and even under Scenarios 1-3 an adversary can force infinite loss.

</details>


### [332] [Choosing the Right Regularizer for Applied ML: Simulation Benchmarks of Popular Scikit-learn Regularization Frameworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03541)
*Benjamin S. Knight,Ahsaas Bajaj*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究通过134,400次模拟实验，系统比较了Ridge、Lasso、ElasticNet和Post-Lasso OLS四种正则化框架的性能表现，为机器学习工程师提供基于特征空间属性的框架选择决策指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 正则化方法在机器学习中广泛使用，但不同框架在各种条件下的相对性能尚缺乏系统性实证比较，尤其是面对高条件数、多重共线性和低信噪比等挑战场景时。

Method: 基于8个生产级机器学习模型构建7维流形，执行134,400次蒙特卡洛模拟，系统评估四种经典正则化框架（Ridge、Lasso、ElasticNet、Post-Lasso OLS）。

Result: 当样本量充足（n/p ≥ 78）时，三种L1/L2正则化方法预测精度相近；但在高条件数（kappa）和低信噪比（SNR）条件下，Lasso召回率急剧下降至0.18，而ElasticNet仍维持0.93。

Conclusion: 建议在高条件数和小样本场景下避免使用Lasso或Post-Lasso OLS；提供目标驱动的决策流程图以指导scikit-learn框架选择。

Abstract: This study surveys the historical development of regularization, tracing its evolution from stepwise regression in the 1960s to recent advancements in formal error control, structured penalties for non-independent features, Bayesian methods, and l0-based regularization (among other techniques). We empirically evaluate the performance of four canonical frameworks -- Ridge, Lasso, ElasticNet, and Post-Lasso OLS -- across 134,400 simulations spanning a 7-dimensional manifold grounded in eight production-grade machine learning models. Our findings demonstrate that for prediction accuracy when the sample-to-feature ratio is sufficient (n/p >= 78), Ridge, Lasso, and ElasticNet are nearly interchangeable. However, we find that Lasso recall is highly fragile under multicollinearity; at high condition numbers (kappa) and low SNR, Lasso recall collapses to 0.18 while ElasticNet maintains 0.93. Consequently, we advise practitioners against using Lasso or Post-Lasso OLS at high kappa with small sample sizes. The analysis concludes with an objective-driven decision guide to assist machine learning engineers in selecting the optimal scikit-learn-supported framework based on observable feature space attributes.

</details>


### [333] [Simple yet Effective: Low-Rank Spatial Attention for Neural Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03582)
*Zherui Yang,Haiyang Xin,Tao Du,Ligang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Neural operators have emerged as data-driven surrogates for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), and their success hinges on efficiently modeling the long-range, global coupling among spatial points induced by the underlying physics. In many PDE regimes, the induced global interaction kernels are empirically compressible, exhibiting rapid spectral decay that admits low-rank approximations. We leverage this observation to unify representative global mixing modules in neural operators under a shared low-rank template: compressing high-dimensional pointwise features into a compact latent space, processing global interactions within it, and reconstructing the global context back to spatial points. Guided by this view, we introduce Low-Rank Spatial Attention (LRSA) as a clean and direct instantiation of this template. Crucially, unlike prior approaches that often rely on non-standard aggregation or normalization modules, LRSA is built purely from standard Transformer primitives, i.e., attention, normalization, and feed-forward networks, yielding a concise block that is straightforward to implement and directly compatible with hardware-optimized kernels. In our experiments, such a simple construction is sufficient to achieve high accuracy, yielding an average error reduction of over 17\% relative to second-best methods, while remaining stable and efficient in mixed-precision training.

### [334] [Evaluation of Bagging Predictors with Kernel Density Estimation and Bagging Score](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03599)
*Philipp Seitz,Jan Schmitt,Andreas Schiffler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: For a larger set of predictions of several differently trained machine learning models, known as bagging predictors, the mean of all predictions is taken by default. Nevertheless, this proceeding can deviate from the actual ground truth in certain parameter regions. An approach is presented to determine a representative y_BS from such a set of predictions using Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) in nonlinear regression with Neural Networks (NN) which simultaneously provides an associated quality criterion beta_BS, called Bagging Score (BS), that reflects the confidence of the obtained ensemble prediction. It is shown that working with the new approach better predictions can be made than working with the common use of mean or median. In addition to this, the used method is contrasted to several approaches of nonlinear regression from the literatur, resulting in a top ranking in each of the calculated error values without using any optimization or feature selection technique.
